Vacancy Details

Post Name No of Posts
General Duty Medical Officer (GDMO) 21

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification
  • A recognized Medical qualification included in the first or the second schedule or part -II of the third schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956. Holder of educational qualifications included in Part - II of the third schedule should also fulfil the conditions stipulated in sub-section (3) of the section 13 of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956.
  • Compulsory rotation internship.
  • Registration with Central/State Council.
  • Experience Experience certificate (if any)

Salary/ Stipend

  • When posted in Hospitals in Municipal and outside municipal area South Andaman District Rs. 99,000/- per month
  • When posted in Hospital in North & Middle Andaman District Rs. 1,00,000/- per month
  • When posted in Hospital in Nicobar group of Islands including Hut bay. Rs. 1,12,000/- per month

Age Limit (as on 30-01-2026)

  • Not exceeding 30 years

Important Dates

Last date for receipt of application through online 30 January 2026 till 4.00 P.M.
List of eligible candidates will be published in DHS website https://dhs.andamannicobar.gov.in/ on 06 February 2026
Tentative dates and time of walk-in interview 11 February 2026 to 12 February 2026 (Time 10.00 A.M to 4.00 P.M)

Selection Process

  • Walk-in Interview

General Information / Instructions

  • The appointment is purely on contract basis for a period of one year or till the regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier, with effect from the date of joining. Thereafter, the contract will lapse automatically. The appointment can also be terminated at any time, on either side, by giving one month's notice or by paying one month's salary, without assigning any reason or failure to complete three months to the satisfaction of the competent authority.
  • The appointee shall perform the duties assigned to him/her. The competent authority reserves the right to assign any duty as and when required. No extra/additional allowance will be admissible in case of such assignment.
  • The appointee shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc. or any other benefits available to the Government servants, appointed on regular basis.
  • Non-practicing allowance will not be admissible.
  • The appointee will not be granted any claim or right for regular appointment to any post under Central Health Service.
  • Only consolidated salary will be admissible. No Dearness Allowance and other allowances as are admissible to the Central Government servants shall be admissible.
  • The appointee shall be on the whole time appointment of the Medical Institution and shall not accept any other appointment, paid or otherwise and shall not engage himself in a private practice of any kind during the period of contract.
  • The appointment to the said post will be subject to the Medical Fitness from the competent Medical Board for which he/she will be sent to the designated Medical Authority by the concerned Institute/Hospital before joining the post.
  • The appointee is not entitled to any TA for joining the appointment.
  • Other conditions of service will be governed by relevant rules and orders issued from time to time.
  • They will have to work in any part of Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
  • If any declaration given or information furnished by him/her proves to be false or if he/she is found to have wilfully suppressed any material, information, he/she will be liable for removal from service and also such other action as the Government may deem necessary.

How to Apply

  • Interested eligible candidates should submit their application in the prescribed format available at DHS website https://dhs.andamannicobar.gov.in/ alongwith the soft copy of the relevant documents (self-attested) to DHS email ([email protected]).
  • The complete application should have the following documents along with the application (1) UG Degree Certificate (2) Compulsory rotation internship certificate (3) Registration Certificate (5) experience certificate (6) Aadhar Card (7) Pan Card.
  • Candidates appearing for the interview must possess the above-mentioned documents in original at the time of interview.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid for submission of application and attending the interview.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Education Qualification: Matriculation from a recognised Board
  • Sports Qualifications: Players who have participated in any International Competition/ National Competitions/ Inter-University Tournaments/ National Sports/ Games for Schools/ Khelo India University Games/ Khelo India Youth Games/ Khelo India Winter Games
  • Age as per Certificate: Only Matriculation certificate or Higher secondary school certificate will be accepted as proof for establishing age of the candidates
  • Certificate Requirements: All educational certificates other than Central Board/State Boards should be accompanied with Government notifications declaring the equivalence of such qualification for service under Central Government
  • Sports Certificate: Candidates must possess valid sports certificates from competent authorities as specified in the notification
  • Caste Certificate: Candidates seeking relaxation under SC/ST/OBC category should submit the certificate as per prescribed format
  • Document Possession: The candidates must fulfil all eligibility conditions and should be in possession of all sports and education certificates at the time of joining

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay scale and other allowances will be as admissible to Assam Rifles personnel as per 7th CPC
  • Candidates Provisionally Selected will be covered under New Pension Scheme (NPS)

Age Limit (as on 01/01/2026)

  • For General & OBC Candidates: 18 to 28 years as on 01 Jan 2026. Candidates should have not been born earlier than 01 Jan 1998 and later than 01 Jan 2008
  • For SC/ST Candidates: 18 to 33 years as on 01 Jan 2026. Candidates should have not been born earlier than 01 Jan 1993 and later than 01 Jan 2008
  • Upper Age Relaxation: For Gen/OBC is Five years and SC/ST is Ten years respectively for players who have participated in specified competitions

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 01/12/2025
Online Application Start Date 10/01/2026
Last Date for Online Application 09/02/2026
Recruitment Rally Period (Tentative) Feb 2026 to May 2026
Age Criteria Date 01/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidate Verification: Candidates in possession of valid call letters and photo ID proof like Voter ID, Driving License, Aadhaar Card will only be permitted to enter the recruitment rally site
  • Initial Documentation: All candidates will have to undergo documentation, in which candidates will have to produce all original documents/certificates pertaining to age, education, caste, sports and domicile/Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC)
  • RFID Based Physical Standard Test (PST): PST of candidates will be carried out by using Radio Frequency Identification Devices (RFID) with specific height, chest and weight standards
  • Motor Ability Test (MAT): MAT in all sports disciplines will be conducted by a Board of Officers at rally site as per norms of Lakshmibai National College of Physical Education (LNCPE) manual of Sports Authority of India (SAI)
  • Field Trial: Field Trial in all disciplines will be conducted by a Board of Officers at Rally site. Marks will be awarded to candidates as per their performance in the Field Trial
  • Detailed Medical Examination (DME): Candidates who qualify in Field Trial in respective sports discipline will undergo Detailed Medical Examination with specific visual acuity and medical standards
  • Review Medical Examination (RME): If a candidate is declared UNFIT in DME, they will be allowed to undergo RME provided they give written consent
  • Merit List: Candidates who qualify in all respects will be placed in Merit List. Final selection will be done on the basis of achievements and performance in Field Trials and level of participation
  • Pregnancy Disqualification: Pregnancy at the time of PST, MAT/Field Trial & DME will be considered a disqualification

General Information/Instructions

  • Online applications are invited from eligible male and female Indian citizens for filling up vacancies for the Post of Rifleman/Riflewomen (General Duty) under Sports Quota recruitment in Assam Rifles for the Year 2026
  • The Recruitment Rally will be held at various locations. RFID Based PST, MAT & Field Trial will be conducted at Assam Rifles Training Centre and School Dimapur (Nagaland), Sukhovi (Nagaland), HQ DGAR Laitkor Shillong (Meghalaya), and HQ IGAR(S) Mantripukhri, Imphal (Manipur)
  • Assam Rifles reserves the right to divert vacancies, wherein, in case of non availability of suitable candidates against the vacancies of male candidates, the same may be filled up by suitable female candidates in the same sports discipline and vice versa
  • Candidates should be in possession of personal sports dress/gear, kit, equipment and tools which are requisite for Field Trial in the sports discipline they applied for. No dress and kits will be provided by the Recruitment Agency
  • Candidates will not be considered for recruitment if involved/convicted/arrested in any criminal case under IPC or any other Act
  • Candidate belonging to the physically handicapped category is not eligible to apply for this recruitment
  • Mobiles and other electronic gadgets are banned within the premises of recruitment rally sites/trial centres
  • Assam Rifles authorities are not responsible for any type of arrangement of accommodation/food/transportation for the candidates during the recruitment process
  • Assam Rifles authorities will not be held responsible for any damage/injury/death/loss to the individual sustained during the entire recruitment process
  • Compassionate ground appointment scheme is not applicable to this Recruitment Rally
  • The first phase of the recruitment may take 40 to 60 days to complete
  • No TA/DA is admissible
  • To avoid over-crowding, only candidates will be permitted to enter Recruitment Rally Site. Parents/friends are advised not to accompany candidates
  • Providing functional/in use Email ID and mobile phone number in Online Application Form by the applicants is mandatory. The mobile phone number should not be DND activated
  • All further information regarding conduct of various events will be intimated through notification on website and email only

How to Apply

  • Application Mode: Online applications only
  • Application Portal: Visit the official website www.assamrifles.gov.in
  • Steps to Apply:
    • Click on "ONLINE APPLICATION" option on the web page
    • Fill up the online application with requisite details as prescribed in the application form
    • After filling the application, make online payment via the link given or alternatively payment can be made at any SBI Branch
    • Upload copy of the challan or receipt online
    • Download and print the completed Online Application Form and Call Letter
  • Documents Required While Reporting: Candidates must produce original copy of payment receipt/challan, printed copy of online Application Form duly completed, and copy of Call Letter downloaded from the website
  • Original Documents: During PST, MAT, Field Trial, DME & RME, candidates must produce all original documents/certificates pertaining to age, education, caste, sports and domicile/PRC
  • Important Note: In case of non uploading of receipt/challan during online registration, the candidature of such applicants will be rejected
  • Application Validity: The online applications portal will be functioning from 10 Jan 2026 to 09 Feb 2026
  • Late Applications: Applications received thereafter will not be entertained

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • Master's degree with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University or equivalent degree from an accredited Foreign University
    • Relaxation of 5% marks (from 55% to 50%) at Master's and Bachelor's Degree level for ST/SC candidates
  • Additional Requirements (Any One):
    • Cleared National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by UGC or CSIR
    • Cleared similar test accredited by UGC like SLET/SET
    • Awarded Ph.D. Degree in accordance with UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil/Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and amendments
    • Ph.D. Degree obtained from a Foreign University/Institution ranking among top 500 in World University Rankings by QS, THE, or ARWU
  • Exemption from NET/SLET/SET:
    • Candidates registered for Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009 (subject to specific conditions)
    • Candidates awarded Ph.D. degree as per UGC Regulations 2009
    • NET/SLET/SET not required for Master Programme in disciplines for which such tests are not conducted
  • Desirable:
    • Research publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals
    • Teaching/Post-Doctoral experience
    • Awards from International Organizations/Government of India recognized bodies

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Matrix Level: Level-10
  • Salary Range: Rs. 57,700/- to Rs. 1,82,400/- per month
  • Post Category: Group-A Gazetted (Non-Ministerial)
  • Department: Government Colleges under Department of Education, Government of Arunachal Pradesh
  • Other allowances and benefits as admissible under rules will be provided

Age Limit

  • General Candidates: Up to 30 years of age
  • ST/SC Candidates: Up to 35 years (5 years relaxation)
  • APST Candidates: Up to 37 years (7 years relaxation from general category)
  • PwBD Candidates: Age concession as per Government rules and regulations
  • Regular Government Servants of Arunachal Pradesh: Age relaxation as per Government rules
  • Age relaxation is in accordance with "Assistant Professor for Government Colleges of Arunachal Pradesh" Group 'A' Gazetted (Non-Ministerial) Recruitment Rules 2024

Application Fee

Category Application Fee
APST Candidates Rs. 150/- (Rupees One Hundred Fifty Only)
Other Applicants (General/ST/SC) Rs. 200/- (Rupees Two Hundred Only)
PwBD Candidates NIL (Exempted as per Section 19 of Arunachal Pradesh Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2018)

Important Dates

Event Date/Time
Notification Release Date 22/01/2026
Online Application Start Date 23/01/2026 (17:00 hours)
Last Date for Online Application Submission 23/02/2026 (11:00 hours)
Interview Date To be notified in due course

Selection Process

  • Selection Method: Through Viva-voce/Interview only
  • Total Interview Marks: 100 marks
  • Screening Committee: Commission will constitute a Screening Committee to shortlist candidates eligible for interview as per Appendix-II (Table 3B), UGC Regulations 2018
  • Interview Ratio: Eligible candidates will be invited for interview in the ratio of 1:3 subject to availability based on their score in Appendix-II (Table 3B)
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: Candidates must score minimum 50% of total marks in the interview to qualify for selection
  • Relaxation for PwBD: As per Government notification
  • Shortlisting Criteria: Academic score as specified in Appendix-II (Table 3B) for Colleges will be considered for shortlisting only; final selection based on interview performance
  • Final Selection: As per APPSC Manual for Conduct of Examination-2024

General Information/Instructions

  • APPSC invites online applications from citizens of India for Assistant Professor Examination-2026
  • The number of vacancies and reservation for APST and PwBD candidates are as per Requisition Proforma submitted by the indenting/requisitioning departments
  • Candidates must mandatorily register for One Time Registration (OTR) before filling online application
  • Those already registered in OTR need not register again and can directly login
  • Applicants in Government Service must upload intimation to Head of Department or NOC
  • Only single application should be submitted; if multiple applications submitted, highest Registration ID (RID) will be accepted
  • Fee paid against one RID shall not be adjusted against any other RID
  • Application form once submitted cannot be changed or modified
  • Candidates must carefully read the DISCLAIMER before final submission
  • Wrong information at any stage may lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Eligible candidates must produce all original certificates at the time of interview
  • Decision of Commission regarding eligibility is final
  • The Appointing Authority conducts medical test and verifies character, antecedents, authenticity of documents before appointment
  • Provisional recommendation does not confer right to appointment
  • PwBD candidates must submit disability certificate issued by certifying authority as per Section 57 of Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016
  • Medical Board for disability certificate must include specialty of particular disability as member
  • Selection process for PwBD candidates as per Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and Arunachal Pradesh Rules, 2018

How to Apply

  • Visit the official website: https://appsc.gov.in
  • Step 1: One Time Registration (OTR)
    • Before filling online application, candidates must mandatorily register for OTR
    • If already registered, use same user ID and password to login
  • Step 2: Fill Online Application Form
    • Login with OTR credentials
    • Fill all required details carefully and correctly
    • Application window active from 17:00 hours on 23/01/2026 till 11:00 hours on 23/02/2026
  • Step 3: Upload Required Documents
    • Signature on white paper with black ink (40-50 KB in JPG format)
    • Recent color passport size photo with white background (40-100 KB in JPG format)
    • Self-attested Matriculation Certificate/Marksheet with Date of Birth
    • Self-attested APST certificate (for APST candidates) or Aadhar Card/PRC/EPIC
    • Self-attested Bachelor's Degree certificates and marksheets
    • Self-attested Master's Degree certificates and marksheets
    • Self-attested NET/JRF/SLET/SET certificate
    • Self-attested M.Phil/Ph.D. certificates (if applicable)
    • Certificate from Registrar/Dean for Ph.D. prior to July 11, 2009 (Annexure-1 format)
    • Research publications in peer-reviewed journals
    • Teaching/Post-Doctoral experience certificates
    • Awards certificates
    • PwBD certificate (if applicable)
  • Step 4: Pay Application Fee
    • APST: Rs. 150/-
    • Others: Rs. 200/-
    • PwBD: Exempted
  • Step 5: Submit Application
    • Review all details before final submission
    • Once submitted, no changes allowed
    • Take printout for future reference
  • Detailed instructions for OTR and online application available on APPSC website

Documents Required for Upload

  • Signature of candidate on white paper with black ink pen (40-50 KB in JPG format)
  • Latest/Recent color passport size photo with white background, front faced without headgear and sunglasses (40-100 KB in JPG format)
  • Self-Attested photocopy of Matriculation Certificate/Marksheet with Date of Birth issued by Board
  • Self-Attested Photocopy of APST certificate for APST candidates and Aadhar Card/PRC/EPIC for other applicants
  • Self-Attested photocopy of Bachelor Degree certificates and Mark Sheets issued by Assistant Registrar/Registrar/Controller/Vice-Chancellor
  • Self-Attested photocopy of Master Degree certificates and Mark Sheets issued by concerned University authorities
  • Self-Attested NET with JRF/NET/SLET/SET certificate
  • Self-Attested photocopy of M.Phil/Ph.D. certificates as per UGC Regulations 2009 or 2016
  • Certificate from Registrar/Dean for Ph.D. prior to July 11, 2009 (Annexure-1 format)
  • Research Publications in Peer-Reviewed or UGC-listed Journals
  • Teaching/Post-Doctoral Experience certificates
  • Awards given by International Organizations/Government bodies
  • Disability certificate for PwBD candidates as per Section 57 of Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016

Interview process will be followed up for preparation of panel of advocates eligible to be appointed as District Government Pleader, amongst which the final selection / appointment will be done by the UT Administration of DNH&DD.

  5. The appointee shall not be entitled to any regular allowance as per rules.
  6. The appointee shall not be entitled to any allowance such as HRA reimbursement of call charges of Residential Telephone/mobile Transport facility, personal staff. etc.

  8. No TA/DA shall be admissible for joining or on it completion. However, shall be entitled for TA/DA for travel inside the Union Territory of DNH&DD in connection with official work.
  9. The engagement is of a temporary nature (nonofficial) and the engagement can be cancelled at any time by the department concerned without assigning any reasons and the same will be binding on them.
  10. An Undertaking has to be given that he/she will not defend any case against the U.T. Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu during the contract period.
  11. List of Eligible candidates will be published on official website i.e. "www.ddd.gov.in".
  12. For any details regarding interview (if any) or any of the changes will be intimated through official website i.e. "www.ddd.gov.in".

Candidate should have diploma in Coaching from SAI/NS NIS or from any other recognized Indian/Foreign University and should have represented India in Olympics/World Cup/World Championship. Central Government / State Government / PSU employees may be allowed to apply for the position. However, the applicable recruitment rules of the Department of Personnel & Training (DoPT) will be applicable for all such postings on deputation.

Desired Qualification:- 

  • Demonstrated experience in planning, organising and implementing a comprehensive high performance coaching programme for international teams and athletes.
  • Knowledge of leading trends in coaching, including coaching science, practices and the appropriate application of leading technology tools.

  • The ability to attain excellence from players, coaches, staff and all stakeholders through the establishment of a 'winning'culture.
  • Effective management skills that reflect ability to build and successfully implement longterm strategic plans that are supported by informed operational decisions.

Thereafter, candidates shall not draw any remuneration in case of his/her absence beyond30 days in a year. Also unveiled leave in a calendar year will lapse and will not be carried forward to the next calendar year.
  • In case he/she is required to proceed outstation from the place of posting on tour for official duty, he/she will be entitled to TA/DA as admissible under the rules.
  • In case the performance of Candidate is not found satisfactory, his/her services will be discontinued / terminated after giving one month notice.
  • Without any prejudice to the above condition, the candidate will be terminated from his services with immediate effect without any obligations, in case the candidate is found guilty of violating any of the conditions contained in the terms of employment or is guilty of any misconduct including negligence of duties, unauthorized absence, etc.
  • Decision of KISCE, DoS&YA, Silvassa in all matters regarding eligibility, selection and posting would be final and binding upon all candidates. No representation or correspondence will be entertained by KISCE, DoS&YA, Silvassa in this regard.

Eligibility Criteria for Special Assam TET 2026

Basic Eligibility Requirements

A. Residency: Candidates must be permanent residents of Assam.

B. Academic and Professional Qualifications: Candidates must meet NCTE-prescribed minimum qualifications.

Minimum Qualification for Lower Primary TET (Classes I to V)

Candidates must have any one of the following qualifications:

  1. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education
  2. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.)
  3. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education)
  4. Graduation + 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education

Minimum Qualification for Upper Primary TET (Classes VI to VIII)

Candidates must have any one of the following qualifications:

  1. Graduation + 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education
  2. At least 50% marks in Graduation + B.Ed.
  3. At least 55% marks in Post Graduation (or equivalent grade) + 3-year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed.
  4. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 4-year Bachelor in Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.)
  5. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 4-year B.A./B.Sc. Ed. or B.A. Ed./B.Sc. Ed.
  6. Graduation with at least 50% marks + 1-year B.Ed. (Special Education)

Important Note: Minimum percentage requirements in graduation do not apply to candidates who took admission to B.Ed. or B.El.Ed. or equivalent courses before July 29, 2011.

Total 150 MCQs 150

Exam Duration: 2 hours 30 minutes (150 minutes) for each paper Additional Time: 20 minutes per hour for visually impaired candidates Marking Scheme: Each question carries 1 mark Negative Marking: No negative marking

Qualifying Marks for Special Assam TET 2026

For General Category Candidates

  • Overall: 60% (90 marks out of 150)
  • Language-1 Section: 60% (18 marks out of 30)

For SC/ST/OBC/MOBC/PWD(PH) Candidates

  • Overall: 55% (83 marks out of 150) - 5% relaxation
  • Language-1 Section: 50% (15 marks out of 30) - 10% relaxation

Both conditions must be satisfied to qualify the examination.

Examination Fee Structure

Paper Category Fee
Paper I General ₹550
  SC/ST(P)/ST(H)/OBC/MOBC ₹450
  PWD(PH) ₹300
Paper II General ₹550
  SC/ST(P)/ST(H)/OBC/MOBC ₹450
  PWD(PH) ₹300

Important:

  • Candidates appearing for both papers must pay fees separately for each
  • Payment mode: Online only (net banking/credit card/debit card)
  • Fees once paid are non-refundable

Candidates must select one center district from the following options:

  1. Cachar
  2. Dibrugarh
  3. Kokrajhar
  4. Kamrup
  5. Kamrup Metro
  6. Hojai
  7. Sonitpur

Application Process

Steps to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website: https://sebaonline.org
  2. Read instructions carefully for submitting the online application
  3. Fill the application form with accurate details
  4. Upload documents:
    • Recent passport-size color photograph
    • Signature
    • Pass certificate of professional qualification
    • (Size specifications as mentioned in instructions)
  5. Pay examination fee through online banking/credit card/debit card
  6. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference

Important Application Guidelines

  • Portal opens on January 7, 2026
  • Exact dates for application submission and admit card release will be notified separately
  • Incomplete forms will be summarily rejected
  • No corrections will be entertained after submission
  • Carefully verify all details before final submission

Medium of Question Papers

The question papers will be available in the following languages:

  • Assamese
  • Bengali
  • Bodo
  • English

Validity of Certificate

The Special Assam TET 2026 certificate will remain valid for lifetime from the date of issue by the Empowered Committee, TET, Government of Assam (unless otherwise notified by the appropriate government).

Important Points to Remember

  1. No Automatic Appointment: Qualifying the Special Assam TET 2026 does not confer automatic right to appointment. Teacher recruitment in government/provincialized schools is a separate process conducted when vacancies arise.
  2. Document Verification: No document verification during examination. However, documents will be thoroughly verified during the teacher engagement process. False information can lead to criminal liability.
  3. State-Specific Validity: Qualified candidates can participate in teacher recruitment processes only in Assam.
  4. TET as Qualifying Criteria: TET is one of the qualifying criteria for teacher recruitment. Candidates must also meet other academic and professional qualifications as per NCTE norms.
  5. Both Papers: Candidates intending to appear in both Paper I and Paper II must submit separate applications and pay fees for each paper separately.
  6. Regular Updates: Candidates should regularly visit the official websites for updates on application dates, admit cards, and examination schedules.

The Special Assam TET 2026 is a significant opportunity for aspiring teachers in Bodo, Garo, Manipuri, and Hmar medium schools. This examination addresses the critical shortage of Language-1 teachers in these mediums across Assam. Eligible candidates should prepare thoroughly by reviewing the syllabus, understanding the exam pattern, and ensuring they meet all eligibility criteria before applying.

  • Stage-I Written examination: 120 marks The written examination (objective type multiple-choice) of 2 hours duration will be conducted on OMR sheets and will test the candidates' proficiency in English language, general knowledge, general aptitude, reasoning and Assamese language (20 marks).
  • The Assamese language proficiency segment will be of qualifying nature.   • There shall be negative marking in the written examination. For every incorrect answer, 0.25 mark (one-fourth of the marks allotted to the question) will be deducted.
  • Interview/Viva-Voce: 20 marks Candidates equal to 3 times the number of vacancies (1:3) in order of merit in the written examination will be called to appear in the Interview/Viva-Voce and verification of documents.   • The annual increase is given on satisfactory performance. For outstanding performance, a two-step (each step is Rs 5000) increase may be given to the Sr consultant. In any case the remuneration of a Sr Consultant will not increase beyond the highest range of the corresponding remuneration band. In such cases the remuneration of the Sr Consultant will remain stagnant.
  • The Selection Committee shall fix the consolidated remuneration for the offered position in the remuneration band based on the education, experience, remuneration being already drawn/ last pay drawn and other relevant factors. The remuneration will be consolidated and inclusive of all applicable taxes and no other allowance shall be provided.

Age Limit

  • 50 years for senior consultant
  • In case of retired Govt. employee, maximum age limit is 62 years
  • Retired government officials with matching education and experience, with maximum age of 62 years and who have held a position with grade pay of INR 7,600/ or more may also apply.

Important Dates

Notification Date 19 January 2026

General Information / Instructions

  • Essential/desirable educational qualifications and experiences will be verified with original certificates.
  • Important note: Incomplete application will not be considered and NDMA reserves the right to reject such applications without assigning any reason.
  • The NDMA can terminate the contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason for it. However, in the normal course it will provide one month's notice to the Individual Consultant. The Individual Consultant can also seek for termination of the contract upon giving one month's notice to NDMA.
  • Individual Sr Consultants will be engaged for three years initially, which may be extended up to five years based on his/her performance and as per requirement of the Division. However, their continuation in their respective position beyond the first and second year would be contingent on a satisfactory Annual Performance Review based on clearly defined Key Performance Indicators. However, no extension will be given beyond the age of 65 year.
  • Retired Govt. employees engaged as a Consultant shall be regulated as per MoF, DoE OM No. 3-25/2020-E.III.A dated 09/12/2020
  • Remuneration, Allowances, Leave entitlements, Maximum term of appointments in respect of retire Central Government employees engaged as Consultant on Contact basis in NDMA shall be regulated as per provisions laid down in MoF, DoE OM No. 3-25/2020,E.III.A Dated 09/12/2020.

How to Apply

  • Interested individuals may apply for the position online through NDMA website within 20 days from the date of publication of advertisement on NDMA website.

Selection Process

There will be 125 objective type questions carrying one mark each for a duration of 2.5 Hours. There will be no negative marking system applicable and therefore, no marks will be deducted in case of an incorrect answer. Candidates belonging to PwBD Category are eligible for an compensatory time of 50 minutes.

A minimum of 50% marks for UR/ EWS (45% for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts) in written test will be required to enable the candidate to be considered for further consideration.

Based on the result of the written test and no. of vacancies, the documents submitted by candidates will be scrutinized by RITES Limited and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview preceded by verification of original documents. It will be the candidates’ responsibility to upload supporting documents substantiating the claims submitted in the application form.

In case of deficiency in documents scrutinized by RITES in establishing the claim made in the application, the same shall be notified on the website along with the list of candidates to be called for the interview preceded by document verification. The candidates called for the interview shall bring all the required documents in original, including the original copies of such documents which fulfill the deficiency notified (as applicable). It shall be the responsibility of the candidate to produce all the documents establishing their eligibility and claim made in the application, and inability to produce the documents fulfilling the deficiency at the time of document verification before the interview will render their candidature ineligible.

The documents fulfilling the deficiency must be submitted at the time of document verification and the same must be issued in relation to the deficiency notified, with the purpose of substantiating the claim made in the application by such candidate; however, the date on the same shall not be later than the of date of document verification (submission of documents with regard to category status including OBC-NCL and EWS will continue to be governed as per the ‘Relaxation & Concessions’ section of this advertisement, to be read along with clause 8 under ‘How to Apply’ section of this advertisement).

Candidates will be called for interview in the ratio of 1:6 to the number of vacancies.

If any of these shortcomings is/are detected even after appointment, his/her services are liable to be terminated.

Candidates are requested to superscribe the words "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF......................." on the top of the envelope while sending the application form. Candidate to ensure that valid E-mail ID and Aadhaar linked Telephone number are mentioned in the application form.

Eligibility Criteria (as on 31.12.2025)

Educational Qualification:

  • Deputy Manager (CSR) - Code 25-26/15/A1: Post Graduate (Full Time) in Social Work/Sociology/Economics/Social Sciences with minimum 65% marks. Experience: 4 years in Government or established industry managing community projects/CSR initiatives.
  • Deputy Manager (CSR) - Code 25-26/15/A2: MBA (except obtained through correspondence) with Specialization in HR/Social Welfare/Sustainability Management with minimum 65% marks. Experience: 4 years in managing community projects/CSR initiatives.
  • Deputy Manager (Corporate Planning) - Code 25-26/15/B1: Engineering Graduates with MBA (except obtained through correspondence) with minimum 65% marks. Experience: 4 years in corporate planning or project management or marketing in the energy Sector.
  • Deputy Manager (Corporate Planning) - Code 25-26/15/B2: Post Graduate in Economics/Business Economics/Commerce with MBA (except obtained through correspondence) with minimum 65% marks. Experience: 4 years in corporate planning or project management or marketing in the energy Sector.
  • Engineer (Projects) - Code 25-26/15/C: BE/B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.) in Civil/Electrical/Mechanical/Instrumentation with minimum 65% marks. Experience: Minimum 1 year relevant Post Qualification experience.
  • Officer (Library) - Code 25-26/15/D1: B.Sc. (Physical Science) and Post Graduate Degree in Library Science or equivalent. Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience of working in a Library, preferably in a library attached to a PSU/Govt. Department/large corporate house/company/institution/college with knowledge on computers.
  • Deputy Manager (Library) - Code 25-26/15/D2: B.Sc. (Physical Science) and Post Graduate Degree in Library Science or equivalent. Experience: Minimum 9 years of experience of working in a Library, preferably in a library attached to a PSU/Govt. Department/large corporate house/company/institution/college with knowledge on computers.
  • Officer (Finance) - Code 25-26/15/E: Graduate in any discipline with CA/CWA (with minimum 55% marks). Experience: Minimum 1 year relevant Post Qualification experience.
  • Officer (Rajbhasha) - Code 25-26/15/F: Master's degree from a recognized University in Hindi with English as a main subject at the degree level OR Master's degree in English with Hindi as the main subject at the degree level OR Master's degree in any discipline with Hindi and English as main subjects at degree level. Experience: 5 years relevant experience in implementation of the Official Language Policy including translation work.
  • Assistant-HR - Code 25-26/15/G: Full Time Graduate in any discipline other than Fine arts with minimum 60% marks. Candidate with Post Graduate Diploma in Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Labour Laws/HRD shall be preferred. Experience: Minimum 9 years relevant Post Qualification experience in Personnel & General Administrative functions.
  • Junior Assistant-HR - Code 25-26/15/H: Full Time Graduate in any discipline other than Fine arts with minimum 60% marks. Candidate with Post Graduate Diploma in Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Labour Laws/HRD shall be preferred. Experience: Minimum 5 years relevant Post Qualification experience in Personnel & General Administrative functions.

Essential Qualifications:

  • The specified qualification should have been acquired in minimum number of years except in case of CA/CWA
  • Candidates are required to specify the percentage marks of the qualification
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA/CPI or letter grade is awarded, equivalent percentage of marks should be indicated as per the norms adopted by University/Institute
  • The applicant should essentially have proficiency in computer

Desirable:

  • For CSR positions: Knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), communication skills
  • For Corporate Planning: Analytical skills and macro understanding of the energy sector and economic development issues
  • For Rajbhasha: Knowledge of Official Language Act/Rules is essential, knowledge of local Indian language is desirable
  • For HR positions: Post Graduate Diploma in Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Labour Laws/HRD

Experience Requirements:

  • Deputy Manager (CSR): 4 years in Government or established industry managing community projects/CSR initiatives
  • Deputy Manager (Corporate Planning): 4 years in corporate planning or project management or marketing in the energy Sector
  • Engineer (Projects): 1 year relevant post qualification experience
  • Officer (Library): 5 years of experience in Library work
  • Deputy Manager (Library): 9 years of experience in Library work
  • Officer (Finance): 1 year relevant post qualification experience
  • Officer (Rajbhasha): 5 years relevant experience in Official Language Policy implementation
  • Assistant-HR: 9 years in Personnel & General Administrative functions
  • Junior Assistant-HR: 5 years in Personnel & General Administrative functions

Salary/Stipend (as on 31.12.2025)

CTC (Cost to Company) calculated on basic pay at the lowest of the scale:

  • Deputy Manager: Pay Scale Rs.70,000-200,000 | Total CTC approximately Rs.23.41 Lakhs per annum
  • Engineer/Officer: Pay Scale Rs.60,000-180,000 | Total CTC approximately Rs.19.99 Lakhs per annum
  • Assistant: Pay Scale Rs.32,000-128,000 | Total CTC approximately Rs.10.50 Lakhs per annum
  • Junior Assistant: Pay Scale Rs.29,000-120,000 | Total CTC approximately Rs.9.56 Lakhs per annum

CTC Components:

  • CTC shall include Basic Pay, DA, HRA, Other Perks & Allowances, encashment of earned leaves and Retirement benefits as applicable
  • Post-Retirement Medical Coverage Scheme is applicable to candidates who are 45 years of age or below as on date on which they come on the regular rolls of the Company
  • However, this condition shall not be applicable in case of candidates who join after resigning from any CPSE, provided the total of past service in the CPSE and future service in the company till the date of normal retirement is 15 years or more

Age Limit (as on 31.12.2025)

  • Deputy Manager (CSR): Maximum 42 years
  • Deputy Manager (Corporate Planning): Maximum 42 years
  • Engineer (Projects): Maximum 38 years
  • Officer (Library): Maximum 45 years
  • Deputy Manager (Library): Maximum 49 years
  • Officer (Finance): Maximum 38 years
  • Officer (Rajbhasha): Maximum 45 years
  • Assistant-HR: Maximum 46 years
  • Junior Assistant-HR: Maximum 42 years

Age Relaxation:

  • The upper age limit mentioned includes age relaxation for Persons with Disability candidates
  • Further relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST candidates
  • Relaxation of 3 years for Other Backward Classes (OBC – Non Creamy Layer)
  • Upper age limit is relaxable for Ex-Servicemen
  • Upper age limit is relaxable for Departmental candidates
  • Post-graduates in engineering (relevant to the post) will be given relaxation in experience by one year where minimum requirement is B.E/B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.)
  • Ph.D in Engineering (relevant to the post) will be given relaxation in experience by four years where minimum requirement is B.E/B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.)

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Online Application Start Date 21/01/2026 (00:00 hrs)
Online Application Last Date 04/02/2026 (23:59 hrs)

Selection Process

  • The prescribed qualification/experience are the minimum and mere possession of the same does not entitle a candidate for participating in the selection process
  • EIL may restrict the number of candidates to be called for interview/skill test by raising the percentage of marks obtained in qualifying examinations and/or relevance of experience required for the post
  • Only short-listed candidates will be informed for interview/skill test through email
  • For Deputy Manager, Engineer and Officer positions: Selection will be through Interview at New Delhi/Gurugram or through video conferencing
  • For Assistant-HR and Junior Assistant-HR positions: Selection will be through Skill Test
  • Venue/Mode of interview/skill test shall be intimated separately to the shortlisted candidates
  • Screening and selection will be based on the details provided in the on-line application form

General Information/Instructions

  • This is a Special Recruitment Drive for Persons with Disabilities
  • Persons with 40% or more permanent nature of disability only are eligible to apply
  • If sufficient number of applicants of the prescribed category do not apply or not fulfil the laid down criteria then applicants of all other categories of PwDs can be considered for the same post
  • A candidate can apply for one position only in the subject advertisement. In case of multiple applications, the latest one shall be considered as final
  • The cut-off date for educational qualification, required experience and upper age is 31.12.2025
  • Candidates applying against OBC-NCL category should have a valid caste certificate valid as on 31.12.2025
  • List of castes included in the Central list of OBC as given in the official website of National Commission for Backward Classes only will be considered
  • Rounding off of marks is not allowed. Fill exact percentage upto two decimal places
  • The e-mail address specified in the application should be valid/functional for at least 24 months from the date of the submission of application
  • Any change in advertisement (including extension of the last date) shall be published in EIL's website only
  • Applications once submitted cannot be withdrawn
  • Court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Delhi
  • EIL reserves the right to cancel the advertisement and/or the selection process without assigning any reason

Place of Posting:

  • The place of posting shall be anywhere in India and abroad
  • Head Office: New Delhi/Gurugram
  • Regional Offices: Chennai, Vadodara, Kolkata
  • Branch Office: Mumbai
  • Inspection Offices and Construction Sites etc. depending upon organizational requirement

Travel Allowance:

  • Outstation Candidates called for skill test for Assistant/Junior Assistant shall be entitled to IInd sleeper rail fare
  • Outstation Candidates called for interview for Officer/Engineer & Deputy Manager shall be entitled to IInd AC sleeper rail fare
  • Travel allowance from mailing address to venue of interview/skill test by shortest route as per rules

For PSU/Govt. Employees:

  • Candidates working in PSU/Govt. Sector/Govt. Institution shall be required to forward their application through proper channel or submit NOC from their present employer at the time of interview/skill test
  • Submission of NOC is applicable also for candidates working on Contractual/Fixed Term Basis
  • In case NOC is not applicable as per Company Policy, they shall produce a Certificate/Letter to that effect from their present employer

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the career link on EIL website at www.engineersindia.com
  • Step 2: Read CAREFULLY all the instructions given on the website
  • Step 3: Fill in the online form with all the relevant correct details
  • Step 4: Before starting online registration, keep the following properly scanned documents ready for uploading:
    • Latest Passport size colour photograph in .jpg/.jpeg format of not more than 75 KB size
    • Signature in .jpg/.jpeg format of not more than 25 KB size
    • Document in support of date of birth proof - Class X Certificate/Class X Marksheet in .jpg/.jpeg format
    • All experience certificates
    • Disability certificate (PwD) of not more than 500 KB in .jpg/.jpeg/.pdf format
    • Caste certificate OBC/SC/ST/EWS certificate, if applicable, of not more than 500 KB in .jpg/.jpeg/.pdf format
  • Step 5: Candidates are not required to send the print out of the registered application form. Retain a copy for interview/skill test if shortlisted
  • Step 6: Online submission permitted between 00:00 hrs on 21.01.2026 till 23:59 hrs on 04.02.2026
  • Step 7: Copy of the online application is not to be sent by post. Print out should be retained and submitted at the time of personal interview/skill test

Documents Required at Interview/Skill Test:

  • Proof of Age - Certificate issued for passing Matriculation/Higher Secondary mentioning date of birth
  • Educational Qualifications (All year/semester Mark sheets & Certificates)
  • Proof of Experience - Service Certificate, Pay slips/Salary certificate for past 3 months
  • Persons with Disability Certificate with photograph issued by competent authority satisfying minimum 40% disability
  • SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS certificate from Competent Authority (if applicable)
  • Aadhaar Card
  • Apprenticeship Training certificate (if applicable)

Note: In absence of any of the documents mentioned above, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for interview/skill test.

Indian Army invites applications for Short Service Commission (Technical) - 67th Course (Men) for approximately 350 posts in various engineering streams including Civil, Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, and others. Unmarried male candidates aged 20-27 years (born between 01 Oct 1999 and 30 Sep 2006) with B.E./B.Tech in notified disciplines (final-year students eligible) can apply. Note: The vacancies mentioned are tentative and may be changed or re-appropriated by the Army depending on organizational requirements during any stage of the selection process.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Essential Qualification: B.E./B.Tech degree in the notified Engineering streams from recognized Universities/Institutions by an Act of Central or State Legislature in India or other educational institutions established by an Act of parliament or declared to be deemed as Universities/Autonomous Universities under UGC Act 1956, IIT Act 1961, AICTE Act 1987, NITSER Act 2007 and IIIT Act 2024.
  • For Final Year Students: Candidates studying in the final year of Engineering degree course are eligible to apply. They must submit proof of passing Engineering Degree Examination alongwith marksheets of all semesters/years by 01 October 2026 and produce the Engineering Degree Certificate within 12 weeks from the date of commencement of training at PCTA.
  • Important Note: Candidates with graduation from foreign countries are not permitted to apply for this course.
  • Stream Requirement: Only the Engineering streams and their acceptable equivalent streams as strictly notified in the official notification will be accepted. Any variation between the nomenclature of Engineering stream on degree parchment/marksheet and online application will result in cancellation of candidature.

Nationality

  • A citizen of India, or
  • A subject of Nepal, or
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka and East African countries with the intention of permanently settling in India (certificate of eligibility required)

Marital Status

  • Only unmarried male candidates are eligible to apply
  • Candidates will neither be allowed to marry during the period of training nor be allowed to live with Parents/Guardians
  • A candidate who marries subsequent to the date of application, though successful at SSB interview and medical examination, will not be inducted for training

Physical Standards

  • 2.4 Km Run: 10 Minutes 30 Seconds
  • Push-Up: 40
  • Pull-Up: 06
  • Sit-Up: 30
  • Squats: Two sets of 30 repetitions
  • Lunges: Two sets of 10 repetitions
  • Swimming: Should know fundamentals of swimming

Salary/Stipend

During Training Period

  • Stipend: ₹56,100 per month (Starting pay in Level-10 of Pay Matrix)
  • Pay and allowances will be paid after successful completion of training

After Commissioning - Pay Structure

  • Lieutenant (Level-10): ₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500
  • Captain (Level-10B): ₹61,300 - ₹1,93,900
  • Major (Level-11): ₹69,400 - ₹2,07,200
  • Lieutenant Colonel (Level-12A): ₹1,21,200 - ₹2,12,400
  • Colonel (Level-13): ₹1,30,600 - ₹2,15,900
  • Brigadier (Level-13A): ₹1,39,600 - ₹2,17,600
  • Major General (Level-14): ₹1,44,200 - ₹2,18,200
  • Lieutenant General HAG Scale (Level-15): ₹1,82,200 - ₹2,24,100
  • Lieutenant General HAG+ Scale (Level-16): ₹2,05,400 - ₹2,24,400
  • VCOAS/Army Commander/Lieutenant General (NFSG) (Level-17): ₹2,25,000 (Fixed)
  • COAS (Level-18): ₹2,50,000 (Fixed)

Other Allowances

  • Military Service Pay (MSP): ₹15,500 per month (Fixed) - for officers from Lieutenant to Brigadier rank
  • Dearness Allowance: Admissible at the same rates and under same conditions as applicable to civilian personnel from time to time
  • Para Reserve Allowance: ₹2,625 per month
  • Technical Allowance (Tier-I): ₹3,000 per month
  • Technical Allowance (Tier-II): ₹4,500 per month
  • Transport Allowance (TPTA): ₹7,200 + DA (Higher TPTA Cities) / ₹3,600 + DA (Other Places)
  • Dress Allowance: ₹20,000 per year
  • Children Education Allowance: ₹2,250 per month per child for two eldest surviving children (Nursery to 12th class)
  • Hostel Subsidy: ₹6,750 per month per child for two eldest surviving children (Nursery to 12th class)
  • Ration in Kind: Provided in peace and field areas
  • Field Area Allowances: Risk and Hardship allowances depending upon rank and area of posting (maximum up to ₹42,500)

Additional Benefits

  • CTC (Cost to Company): Approximately ₹17-18 lakh per annum (excluding free medical cover and travel to hometown once a year)
  • Army Group Insurance Fund (AGIF): Insurance coverage of ₹1.25 Crore
  • Academic Degree: Post Graduate Diploma in Defence Management and Strategic Studies upon successful completion of training

Age Limit (as on 01 October 2026)

  • Minimum Age: 20 years
  • Maximum Age: 27 years
  • Date of Birth: Candidates must be born between 01 October 1999 and 30 September 2006 (both dates inclusive)
  • Age Proof: The date of birth recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate or equivalent examination certificate on the date of submission of application will only be accepted. No other document relating to age will be accepted and no subsequent request for its change will be considered or granted.

Application Fee

  • No application fee mentioned in the official notification
  • Candidates need to apply online through the official website only

Important Dates

Event Date
Online Application Start Date 07 January 2026 at 1500 hours
Online Application Closing Date 05 February 2026 at 1500 hours
Publication of Cut-off % for Shortlisting First week of March 2026
SSB Interview Period April - June 2026 (Five day SSB)
Choice for SSB Dates and Centre Open Two weeks in March 2026
Proof of Passing Engineering Degree Submission Deadline (for final year students) 01 October 2026
Training Commencement October 2026
Training Completion September 2027

Selection Process

  • Step 1 - Online Application: Candidates must apply online through www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  • Step 2 - Shortlisting: Applications will be shortlisted based on cumulative percentage of marks obtained by candidates upto final semester/year. Cut-off will be applied for each Engineering stream based on vacancy to call up ratio.
  • Step 3 - Allotment of Selection Centre: After shortlisting, centre allotment will be intimated via email. Candidates will select their SSB dates on first come first serve basis.
  • Step 4 - SSB Interview: Two-stage selection procedure conducted at one of the Selection Centres - Prayagraj (UP), Bhopal (MP), Bengaluru (Karnataka) and Jalandhar Cantt (Punjab). Duration is maximum five days.
  • Step 5 - Medical Examination: Candidates who get recommended after Stage-2 of SSB will undergo medical examination. Validity of SSB medical examination is 270 days.
  • Step 6 - Merit List: Merit list will be prepared engineering stream/subject wise based on SSB interview marks.
  • Step 7 - Joining Letter: Candidates in merit list who come within stipulated stream-wise vacancies and are medically fit will be issued joining letters for pre-commissioning training at PCTA, subject to meeting all eligibility criteria.

Note: Mere qualifying at SSB interview does not confirm final selection. Selection is based on merit, medical fitness and availability of vacancies.

General Information/Instructions

  • Type of Commission: Short Service Commission (SSC)
  • Training Duration: 49 weeks at Officers Training Academy, Gaya, Bihar
  • Rank After Training: Lieutenant
  • Commission Grant: Selected candidates will be granted Short Service Commission on probation in the rank of Lieutenant from the date of commencement of the course
  • Ante Date Seniority: One year ante date seniority from the date of commission will be granted to Engineering Graduates
  • Tenure of Engagement: Officers shall be liable to serve for ten years
  • Option for Release:
    • First option - After 5 years of service (with Army HQ approval)
    • Second option - After 10 years of service
    • Third option - After 14 years of service
  • Option for Permanent Commission: Officers desirous of seeking Permanent Commission may be considered in the 10th year of service based on eligibility and suitability
  • Service Extension: Ten year service tenure may be extendable by further four years subject to eligibility
  • Arms/Services Allocation: Primary Arms/Services are Corps of Engineers, Corps of Signals and Corps of Electronics and Mechanical Engineers. Candidates may get commissioned in other Arms/Services as well based on organizational requirements
  • Training Cost: Entire cost of training at PCTA is at Government expense
  • Cost Recovery: Candidates withdrawn from training academy for personal reasons will be liable to refund cost of training at ₹16,260 per week (as on 2023) or as notified from time to time
  • Promotion Criteria: Promotion to Captain after 2 years, Major after 6 years, Lieutenant Colonel after 13 years of reckonable commissioned service
  • Liability of Service: Officers may be granted commission in any Arm/Service and will be liable for service in any part of the world
  • Marriage Restriction: Candidates must not marry until they complete full training at Officers Training Academy. Marriage during training will result in discharge and recovery of expenditure

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official website www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  • Step 2: Click on 'Officer Entry Apply/Login' and then click 'Registration' (if not already registered)
  • Step 3: Fill the online registration form carefully after reading instructions
  • Step 4: After registration, click on 'Apply Online' under Dashboard
  • Step 5: A page 'Officers Selection - Eligibility' will open. Click 'Apply' shown against Technical Graduate Course
  • Step 6: Fill Application Form with details under various segments - Personal information, Communication details, Education details and details of previous SSB
  • Step 7: Click 'Save & Continue' each time before moving to next segment
  • Step 8: After filling all details, review on 'Summary of your information' page
  • Step 9: After ascertaining correctness of all details, click on 'Submit'
  • Step 10: Take out two copies of application having Roll Number, 30 minutes after final closure of online application

Documents Required for SSB Interview

  • One copy of printout of application duly signed and affixed with self-attested photograph
  • Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate or equivalent certificate and Marksheet issued by concerned Board of Education
  • 12th class marksheet and certificate or equivalent certificate/Diploma marksheet and certificate (for Diploma holders)
  • Engineering Degree/Provisional Degree issued by recognized university (Provisional Degree should not be more than six months old at time of joining Academy)
  • Marksheets of all semesters/years
  • Certificate issued by Controller of Examination/Registrar regarding formula for conversion of CGPA/Grades into marks
  • Certificate regarding cumulative percentage of marks upto 6th semester/3rd year (for final year appearing candidates)
  • Certificate from Principal/Head of Institution stating candidate is studying in final year and result will be declared by 01 October 2026 (for final year students)
  • Declaration by final year candidate about submission of degree proof by 01 October 2026
  • Documents related to civil verification
  • All original certificates must be carried for verification (DIGILOCKER certificates not accepted)

Important Notes

  • Applications will only be accepted online - no offline applications
  • Candidates must submit only one online application. Multiple applications will result in cancellation of candidature
  • No changes to details submitted in online application can be made after closure of application
  • CGPA/Grades must be converted into marks as per formulae adopted by concerned University
  • Candidate's name/Parent's name/Date of Birth in profile and online application must match Matriculation Certificate exactly
  • Aadhaar number and Matriculation Certificate are mandatory for registration on website

Selection Process

  • The recruitment methodology is structured into a two-stage process: a Computer based online written test, called Computer Based Test (CBT) and a Coaching Ability Test (CAT).
  • The final composite weightage in the recruitment methodology shall be 60% for the Coaching Ability Test and 40% for the Computer based online written test.
  • The candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria shall be called for an online written examination called the Computer Based Test (CBT).
  • The candidates appearing in the written examination i.e CBT shall be shortlisted for the Coaching Ability Test (CAT) in the ratio of 1:3 i.e. the number of candidates to be shortlisted for the coaching ability test will be 3 times the number of vacancies in each sport and in each category.
  • The selection will be made on the basis of merit list prepared by the Selection Committee based on the written Computer Based Test (CBT) and Coaching Ability Test (CAT).
  • Written Examination (CBT): The Computer Based Test (CBT) is designed to assess the candidate’s sports-specific knowledge, understanding of sports sciences and familiarity with general awareness, reasoning and aptitude, which are essential competencies for the post of Assistant Coach.
  • The written test (CBT) shall be for two (02) hours with a total of 100 multiple choice questions (MCQs). There shall be negative marking of one-fourth of the marks assigned to a question for each incorrect answer.
  • The written test shall include the following broad topics: Sports-specific knowledge 65 marks, Sports Science 25 marks, General Awareness, Reasoning, Aptitude 10 marks.
  • Coaching Ability Test: The Coaching Ability Test shall have 60 % weightage in the final merit list. The Coaching Ability Test is designed to measure a candidate’s capacity to apply foundational coaching knowledge in a way that builds a positive, effective, and transformative coaching relationship.
  • The candidates appearing in the Computer Based Test (CBT) will be shortlisted for the coaching ability test in the ratio of 1:3 i.e. the number of candidates to be shortlisted for the coaching ability test should be 3 times the number of vacancies in each sport and in each category.
  • The Coaching Ability Test shall have 40 assessment parameters.
  • Candidates must secure the minimum qualifying marks/standards, if any, as prescribed by SAI in the Coaching Ability Test. Failure to do so shall result in disqualification, irrespective of performance in the CBT.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals can apply for the above posts.
  • The online test will be held at the Delhi, Lucknow, Chandigarh, Bhopal, Gandhinagar, Mumbai, Kolkata, Bhubaneswar, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Thiruvananthapuram, Guwahati and Imphal. The number of centres can be reduced or increased, depending upon the number of candidates.
  • Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC will have to produce the original caste certificate from the competent authority, along with attested copy of the same, at the time of physical verification of documents failing which his candidature shall be cancelled and he will not be admitted for further selection process.
  • OBC Candidates availing reservation will have to produce latest OBC CERTIFICATE with “NON-CREAMY LAYER STATUS” in the prescribed format by the Government of India for Government services at the time of physical verification of the documents.
  • A candidate will be eligible to get the benefit of community reservation only in case the particular caste to which the candidate belongs is included in the list of reserved communities issued by the Central Government.
  • A candidate will be eligible to get the benefit of the Economically Weaker Section reservation only in case the candidate meets the criteria issued by the Central Government and is in possession of the certificate issued anytime during this Financial Year of recruitment shall be treated as valid, but not later than the closing date of the Online Application Form for this recruitment.
  • Candidates seeking reservation/relaxation benefits available for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Ex-servicemen must ensure that they are entitled to such reservation/relaxation as per eligibility. They should also be in possession of all the requisite certificates in the prescribed format in support of their claim for such benefits by the closing date of the online application.
  • Only those candidates who are fulfilling the eligibility criteria will be allowed to appear in the online test. The candidates shall appear for the Computer Based Test (CBT)/Coaching Ability Test for the above posts at their own expenses.
  • The qualification must be obtained from Govt. Recognized institutions/Universities.
  • Canvassing in any manner and bringing outside influence shall make the candidature liable for rejection.
  • The authority reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates to be called for test and change of exam centre on the basis of any other norms decided by the Authority at a later date.
  • The decision of the selection committee is not liable for challenge and same shall stand final and binding on each candidate.
  • Before applying for the post, the candidate should ensure that he fulfills the eligibility and other norms mentioned in the Advertisement. Furnishing of wrong/false information shall result in disqualification and SAI will not be responsible for any consequence of furnishing of such wrong/false information.
  • The eligibility of new applicants with respect to age, experience etc. will be determined as on the date of advertisement. For Educational qualification, candidates whose result for final year examination is awaited are also allowed to appear in the written examination subject to the condition that they will have to produce the final results before appearing in the further selection process.
  • Candidates employed in Govt. Departments/PSUs/Autonomous bodies must produce No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of verification of documents from their employer. In case, the candidate fails to produce the NOC, his candidature will not be considered.
  • Mere fulfilling of the minimum qualifications and experience will not vest any right on candidates for being called for online exam. No interim correspondence will be entertained.
  • Selected candidates are liable to be posted anywhere in India.
  • Candidature is liable to be cancelled at any stage of recruitment process or after recruitment or joining if any information provided by the candidates is found false or is not found in conformity with eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Decision of SAI in all matters regarding eligibility of the candidate, the stages at which such scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, the documents is to be produced for the purpose of the conduct of selection and any other matter relating to recruitment will be final and binding on the candidate. SAI reserves the right to fix the standard and specifications for screening and calling the number of candidates for online exam and/or CAT, etc.
  • SAI reserves the right to modify, alter, restrict, enlarge, cancel, or discontinue the recruitment process, without assigning any reason or issuing further notice. No appeal shall lie against such decision.
  • Appointment shall be subject to the candidate being found medically fit as per the standards prescribed by SAI.
  • Inclusion of a candidate’s name in the merit list does not confer any right to appointment unless a formal offer of appointment is issued by SAI.
  • Candidates from Government organisations applying for the post are required to intimate their parent department/office immediately upon submission of the online application, in accordance with the consolidated instructions issued by the Department of Personnel & Training (DoPT).
  • Further notifications/corrigendum in this regard, if any, shall be published on SAI website only. You are advised to visit the SAI website regularly for further updates.
  • All communications, including call letters, examination intimation and selection-related information, shall be made through the registered e-mail ID and/or SAI website only. SAI shall not be responsible for non-receipt of information due to incorrect or inactive e-mail ID.
  • In case of any ambiguity or dispute regarding interpretation of any provision of this notification, the decision of SAI shall be final and binding.
  • Any dispute arising out of or relating to this recruitment shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of courts at Delhi.
  • In case of any dispute, English version of the Employment notice shall prevail and be treated as final.

How to Apply

  • Eligible applicants/candidate are required to apply through ‘online application Format’ to be available on SAI’s website on www.sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in. No application through other mode will be accepted. Candidates are not required to send any hard copy or supporting documents to SAI at the application stage.
  • Before registering/submitting applications on the website the candidates should possess the following: a) Valid E-mail ID: The e-mail ID entered in the online application form should remain active until the recruitment process is completed. No request for change in the e-mail ID shall be entertained once it has been registered. b) While applying online candidate should keep the scanned copy of their passport size color photograph and their signature in digital format for uploading with the online application. The files must be in jpg or jpeg file/format only, with photograph not exceeding 80kb and signature not exceeding 30kb .
  • The candidate can access the online application form at our website. The registration would be open from 1st February, 2026 to 15th February, 2026.
  • After applying online, candidate is required to download the registration slip generated by the System with unique registration number and password, which may be retained for future reference.
  • Following documents are compulsory to be uploaded with the application:- (a) Certificate for the proof of age (b) Any valid ID proof issued by the Government of India (c) Certificates to support the essential qualification (d) Certificates of SC/ST/OBC/Ex-serviceman/EWS/meritorious sports person, etc. issued by Competent Authority for availing relaxation. (e) Certificates showing the period of contract with SAI issued by the Competent Authority.

  • Pay Scale: E4 Level IDA pay scale Rs. 70,000–2,00,000 (IDA).
  • Deputation – Emoluments: Pay and allowances regulated as per DoPT rules; in addition, HRA/Lease, Transport, Laptop, Mobile Phone, Headset, Uniform, Briefcase etc., subject to limits and other allowances as per Company policy.
  • Immediate Absorption – Emoluments: Basic Pay as applicable in the grade, HRA/Lease, Variable Dearness Allowance (VDA) at applicable rates and Perks and Allowances under Cafeteria Approach; other benefits like Transport, Laptop, Mobile Phone, Headset, Uniform, Briefcase etc. as per extant Company Rules.

Age Limit (as on 24-12-2025)

  • Maximum age for the post of Deputy General Manager (Human Resource) is 45 years as on 24/12/2025.
  • Only Indian Nationals above 18 years of age are eligible to apply.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the vacancy notice.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Vacancy Notice Date / Notification Date 24/12/2025
Opening of website link for applying online 24/12/2025
Closing date for applying online 23/01/2026
Last date for receipt of printed application and supporting documents by hand / post 23/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Based on the eligibility, candidates meeting the criteria will be called for Interview.
  • The venue, date and time of Interview will be informed in advance.
  • Any request for change in date or venue shall not be entertained.
  • Document verification will be done before the Interview; candidates must carry their original certificates for verification, failing which they will not be allowed to attend the Interview.
  • Merit list will be prepared based on score of Interview.
  • The minimum qualifying marks/percentage for determining suitability shall be 60%.

General Information/Instructions

  • The eligibility criteria for Deputation of Central/State Govt. employees shall be as per DoPT guidelines.
  • Before applying, candidates must ensure that they fulfil all eligibility criteria mentioned in the Vacancy Notice; eligibility will be verified with original documents at the time of interview.
  • Applicants who do not fulfil the age and minimum education qualification as on closing date of receipt of applications need not apply.
  • Essential educational qualifications as indicated are mandatory; only full-time regular courses will be considered, and all essential qualifications must be from UGC recognized Indian University/Deemed University or AICTE approved courses/concerned statutory councils.
  • Candidates claiming equivalence in qualification must produce an equivalence certificate; in case of dual specialization in Management, one specialization must be function specific for which the post has been advertised.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA/CPI/grade is awarded, equivalent percentage must be indicated as per norms of University/Institute and documentary proof must be produced at interview.
  • Experience will be counted from date of assumption of charge; for combined Government and Private sector experience, private sector experience will carry 80% weightage and Government sector 100% for overall experience computation.
  • Candidates once selected but not joining for any reason shall be debarred from applying for any positions in NCRTC for two years from date of Offer of Appointment.
  • No person previously dismissed, removed or compulsorily retired from service of a Government department/PSU/autonomous body/Corporation, or previously convicted for an offence involving moral turpitude, shall be eligible.
  • Conditions regarding more than one spouse and marriage shall follow Central Government rules; teaching or freelancing experience shall not be considered as qualifying experience.
  • The prescribed qualification/experience criteria are minimum and mere possession does not entitle a candidate for participation; NCRTC’s decision is final.
  • Candidates from Government entities/CPSEs/SPSEs will be considered for pay protection; candidates on contract in regular pay scales will not get pay protection and their pay will be fixed at minimum of the pay scale.
  • NCRTC reserves the right to raise minimum eligibility standards, to fill or not to fill positions, and to cancel/modify the recruitment/selection process without notice.
  • Any revision, clarification, addendum, corrigendum or time extension will be hosted only on Career section of www.ncrtc.in; candidates should visit website regularly.
  • Canvassing directly or indirectly will result in disqualification; disputes will be settled under jurisdiction of Delhi High Court only.
  • In case of query, candidates may write to [email protected] mentioning “POST–DGM(HR) (Post Code ) - 63/2025” in subject line or contact 011-24666700 (10:00 AM to 4:30 PM).

How to Apply

  • Candidates shall apply online through NCRTC website (www.ncrtc.in) under ‘Career Section’ as per eligibility criteria.
  • Separate application shall be filled for Deputation and Immediate Absorption.
  • Before registering/applying online, candidates should go through detailed instructions and keep ready: valid E-mail ID and Mobile Number, scanned self-attested recent passport size colour photograph (3.5 x 4.5 cm, up to 100 kb, .jpg/.jpeg) and scanned signature (up to 100 kb, .jpg/.jpeg).
  • While applying online, candidates need to upload self-attested copies of: 10th Certificate/Birth Certificate; Degree Certificate of Graduation and/or Post-Graduation highlighting stream/specialization; appointment letter, joining order and latest salary slip of present organisation; experience certificates and duty allocation orders; copies of APARs of last three years; office orders indicating promotions; experience/service/relieving orders from previous organisations; last three months’ salary slips.
  • Applications without supporting certificates/documents will be summarily rejected.
  • After submitting online application, candidate must download the system-generated Application Form with Unique Registration Number, take a print, attach supporting documents and send to the specified address by hand/post latest by 23/01/2026.
  • The envelope containing printed application and supporting documents should be superscribed as: “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF DEPUTY GENERAL MANAGER (HUMAN RESOURCE) ON DEPUTATION BASIS – 63/2025” OR “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF DEPUTY GENERAL MANAGER (HUMAN RESOURCE) ON IMMEDIATE ABSORPTION BASIS – 63/2025”. Candidates applying for both modes must submit separate applications.
  • For Deputation: Application should be routed through Administrative Officer (HQ/Board etc.) for forwarding to NCRTC with No Objection, Vigilance/DAR clearance etc. as per prescribed proforma (Annexure-I).
  • Candidates must have valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number active during entire recruitment process; all communications will be sent to registered e-mail ID.
  • Candidates should take utmost care to furnish correct details; they can edit information before submission, but once submitted, the form cannot be edited.
  • Printed applications with documents are to be sent to: Career Cell, HR Department, Gatishakti Bhawan, National Capital Region Transport Corporation, INA Colony, New Delhi – 110023.
