Post Name No of Posts
Director, CSIR-Central Electronics Engineering Research Institute (CSIR-CEERI), Pilani 1

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: Ph.D. in Natural Sciences or Master’s Degree in Engineering (for Engineering, Ph.D. is desirable).
  • Essential Qualification: Ph.D. in Natural Sciences or Master’s Degree in Engineering (for Engineering, Ph.D. is desirable).
  • Desirable Qualification: Ph.D. is desirable for Engineering.
  • Experience: At least 16 years of experience in Research and Development (with focus on translational research) in the areas of activities of the laboratory/Institutes/Centre and demonstrated excellence in leadership therein. Years of experience shall be computed from the beginning of candidate’s research career.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Level 15 of Pay Matrix (Rs.1,82,200- 2,24,100) with allowances as admissible.

Age Limit

  • 45 years or above but not exceeding 56 years.

Important Dates

Last Date 28 February 2026

General Information / Instructions

  • Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) established in 1942, is an autonomous R&D organization under the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR), Ministry of Science and Technology. Being a premier R&D organization of the country, CSIR has been contributing to the techno-socio-economic development through its varied S&T and Innovation-based interventions since its inception. With 37 state-of-the-art constituent laboratories, today CSIR is amongst the largest publicly funded innovative scientific and research organizations in the world. CSIR's expertise and experience is embodied in its nearly 3,500 Scientists and 4,000 scientific and technical support personnel apart from about 9,000 JRF/SRF/RA and project staff. CSIR publishes more than 5,000 papers annually in peer-reviewed International journals (SCI). Presently, CSIR has a patent portfolio of 1,331 unique patents in force in India, out of which 139 patents have been licensed/assigned to industry. CSIR also has 927 granted in-force patents abroad in multiple countries.
  • According to the Scimago Institutions Ranking World Report 2025, CSIR is ranked 74th among 2123 government institutions worldwide and is the only Indian organization among the top 100 global government institutions. Further, CSIR holds 7th rank in research and 4th rank in societal category in Asia among 636 government organizations. CSIR leads the country at the 1st position in overall research and societal categories among government institutions. CSIR has ushered India into a knowledge economy while grooming and nurturing talent in various streams of Science and Technology. CSIR has the distinction of having the Hon'ble Prime Minister of India as the President of its Society. CSIR, over the period has developed numerous technologies and is presently working on various cutting-edge technological fronts to lead the nation for its dream of Atma Nirbhar Bharat.
  • CSIR-Central Electronics Engineering Research Institute (CSIR-CEERI), Pilani - a constituent national laboratory of Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), is a premier institution in the country, established in 1953 for the advancement of Research and Development (R&D) in the field of Electronics. The Institute has engaged in carrying out R&D inter-alia in semiconductor electronics (MEMS based sensors & devices, GaN/GaAs based devices, optoelectronics, diamond devices & LTCC technology devices), microwave electronics (magnetrons, klystrons, gyrotrons, travelling wave tubes) and allied integrated electronics systems (process automation, food & agri systems, electric vehicle, bio-medical instrumentation, intelligent systems and electronics systems for societal applications). Over the years, the institute has developed and commercialized several technologies and has helped industry to create desired product/technological niches. The institute’s contributions for the development of industry-ready specialized human resources for the nation in the domains of semiconductor process technologies, microwave technologies & embedded electronics are noteworthy. CSIR-CEERI offers several training and skill development programmes designed to suit the requirements of different target groups. CSIR-CEERI has two outreach centres located at Chennai and Jaipur.
  • For more details about the institute, visit http://www.ceeri.res.in
  • Relaxation: The qualifications, age and experience can be relaxed in case of exceptionally meritorious candidates with the approval of DG, CSIR.
  • Candidate: Should be creative, innovative and a well-recognized scientist/technologist having a demonstrated ability to manage multidisciplinary R&D teams with excellent interpersonal relations. The candidate should have made significant contributions in terms of technology development apart from creation of IP and publications. He/ She should be able to create a conducive environment for nurturing high class research and development.
  • Responsibilities: The Director shall supervise and exercise administrative control on the staff of the Institute and shall be responsible for (i) realizing the mission of the Institute, and (ii) creating an environment conducive to nurture innovation and high class R&D and other S&T activities of the Laboratory/Institute in keeping with societal/industrial priorities.
  • Appointment: The appointment to the post of Director will be made for a tenure of six years or till superannuation, whichever is earlier, in level 15 of Pay Matrix (Rs.1,82,200- 2,24,100) with allowances as admissible. The tenure period will be renewable only in exceptional cases. Director can be considered for absorption/placement in CSIR as Director’s Grade Scientist i.e. Scientist ‘H’/Outstanding Scientist, as per rules.
  • Benefits: The provision to share money realized from external contract R&D, consultancy and rendering of S&T services is also available as per extant rules. Residential accommodation and transport are provided as per rules. In addition, medical and other facilities are provided as per CSIR rules.

How to Apply

  • The application/nomination for the post with detailed bio-data highlighting scientific and translational contributions in details alongwith list of publications/patents etc. may be sent through email on email ID [email protected] or by post to Director Recruitment Cell, Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), Anusandhan Bhawan, 2, Rafi Marg, New Delhi-110001. A brief bio-data in the proforma given below may also be sent. The last date of the receipt of applications is 28th February, 2026.

Note: Total vacancies include 62 positions broken down as: 9+24 (backlog from 2024 roster) + 29 (backlog carried forward from last two recruitment cycles). The vacancies may undergo changes depending upon actual requirement. Candidates selected under PwBD category will be adjusted against their main category of UR, SC, ST, OBC and EWS.

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications

  • A recognised MBBS degree qualification included in the First Schedule or Second Schedule or Part-II of the Third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (102 of 1956).
  • Holders of educational qualifications included in Part-II of the Third Schedule should also fulfill the conditions specified in sub-section (3) of section 13 of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (102 of 1956).
  • Completion of Compulsory rotating internship. Candidates who may not have completed rotating internships shall be eligible to apply provided that, if selected, they shall have satisfactorily completed the compulsory internship before appointment.

Desirable

  • Candidates whose names appear in the details of candidates of CMSE-2024 on the Pratibha Setu Portal of UPSC, as on closing date i.e. 17.02.2026 are eligible to apply.
  • Registration with National Medical Council or State Medical Council is mandatory.

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: Level-10 in the Pay Matrix Rs. 56,100 - 1,77,500 per month
  • Non-Practicing Allowance: As admissible to analogous post in the Central Government
  • Additional Benefits: DA (Dearness Allowance), NPA (Non-Practicing Allowance), HRA (House Rent Allowance) and Transport Allowance as per rules of Government of India in force from time to time

Age Limit (as on 01.08.2024)

  • Maximum Age: Not exceeding 35 years as on 01.08.2024
  • Age Relaxation: Relaxable up to five years for employees of the Employees' State Insurance Corporation and Government servants in accordance with the instructions or orders issued by the Central Government from time to time
  • Upper Age Relaxation: Upper age limit is also relaxable to SC/ST/OBC/PWD/Ex-Servicemen and other categories of persons as per rules/instructions of Government of India
  • SC/ST/OBC/Ex-Serviceman Relaxation: As per DOPT OM No. 15012/2/2010-Estt(D) dated 27.03.2012

Application Fee

  • No application fee mentioned in the official notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 13/01/2026
Closing Date of Submission of Applications 17/02/2026
Last Date for candidates from Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Manipur, Nagaland, Tripura, Sikkim, Lahaul and Spiti district, Pangi Sub-Division of Chamba district of Himachal Pradesh, and Union territories of Ladakh, Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep 24/02/2026
Cutoff Date for Eligibility (CMSE 2024 closing date) 30/04/2024
Age Limit Reference Date 01/08/2024

Selection Process

  • Based on the details of candidates of CMSE-2024 available on the Pratibha Setu Portal of UPSC, as on closing date i.e. 17.02.2026, a communication will be sent to the candidates, inviting applications, on the given email id and on the communication address.
  • Minimum qualifying standard for the respective category of the candidate will be considered for considering the candidates of reserved category as mentioned in the UPSC application form.
  • It is mandatory for the candidates to give their consent for sharing their marks of CMSE 2024 by UPSC with ESIC as per the declaration provided in the application form.
  • Based on the applications received, a merit list will be prepared based on the marks of the respective candidates obtained in CMSE-2024, conducted by UPSC.
  • Applications received without the consent regarding sharing of marks of CMSE 2024 by UPSC with ESIC shall be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates selected will be posted in ESIC Hospitals/Dispensaries anywhere in India as per requirement of ESIC.

General Information/Instructions

Nationality/Citizenship

  • A candidate must be either: (a) a citizen of India, or (b) a subject of Nepal, or (c) a subject of Bhutan
  • A Tibetan refugee who came over to India before 1st January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, East African Countries with the intention of permanently settling in India
  • Candidates belonging to categories (b), (c), (d) and (e) shall require a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India

Person with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) Eligibility

  • Category C: Locomotor Disability (One Arm, One Leg, Both Leg, One Arm and One Leg), Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims (Non-Surgical Jobs)
  • Category D: Specific Learning Disability (SLD)
  • Category E: Multiple Disabilities (MD) from amongst persons under categories C and D above
  • Physical Requirements: Sitting, Standing, Walking, Reading & Writing, Seeing, Hearing, Communication

Important Instructions

  • Incomplete or unsigned applications or applications not in the prescribed proforma shall be rejected.
  • Applications received without self-attested copies of mark sheets/certificates in support of educational qualification, proof of age, caste certificate, photographs may be rejected.
  • Applications received after last date shall be rejected without any communication to the candidate.
  • Wrong declarations/submission of false information shall lead to cancellation of the candidature at any stage.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate.
  • All candidates whether in Government service or in private employment should submit their applications directly to the ESI Corporation.
  • Persons already in Regular Government service are required to submit a declaration that they have informed their Head of Office/Department about applying for the selection.
  • They have to submit the NOC from the present employer at the time of document verification.
  • The decision of ESIC in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection, and posting will be final and binding.

Disqualification

  • No person who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having spouse living shall be eligible for appointment.
  • No person who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person shall be eligible for appointment.
  • The Director General of ESIC may grant exemption if such marriage is permissible under the personal law applicable to such person.

How to Apply

  • The duly filled and signed Application Form in the prescribed Performa along with self-attested copies of certificates is to be sent in a cover super-scribed "Application for the post of IMO Gr. II in ESIC" by Speed Post.
  • Address to send application: The Joint Director (Recruitment), ESI Corporation, Panchdeep Bhawan, CIG Marg, New Delhi-110002
  • Applications must reach by 17.02.2026
  • Candidates are advised to submit the application well in advance without waiting upto the closing date.
  • Applications received after the last date by any mode will not be accepted.
  • ESI Corporation will not be responsible for postal delays.
  • Application forwarded through email will not be accepted.
  • Applications submitted by candidates whose names do not appear in the details of candidates of CMSE-2024 on the Pratibha Setu Portal of UPSC, as on closing date i.e. 17.02.2026 shall be summarily rejected.

Documents/Certificates to be Submitted

  • One recent self-attested passport size photograph firmly pasted on the application form
  • Matriculation/10th Standard or equivalent certificate indicating date of birth
  • Degree certificate along with marksheets pertaining to all academic years as proof of educational qualification (provisional certificate acceptable in absence of degree certificate)
  • Caste certificate by candidate seeking reservation as SC/ST/OBC/EWS from competent authority
  • Declaration by OBC candidate that he/she does not belong to the creamy layer on the closing date i.e. 17.02.2026
  • Certificate of Disability in prescribed proforma for PwBD candidates
  • Documentary support for any other claims made
  • Documents for name change after matriculation (if applicable)
  • Certificate/Document in respect of Age relaxation for Ex-Servicemen and other categories
  • MBBS registration certificate with National Medical Council or State Medical Council
  • Certificate of completion of compulsory rotating internship
  • UPSC CMSE 2024 Roll Number and Final Marks details
  • Consent declaration for sharing CMSE 2024 marks by UPSC with ESIC

The contract may be further extended after one year as per the requirements of the company, if the services of the candidates are found to be satisfactory.   4. For Medical Coverage, the Medical Health Insurance Policy of Rs Three Lakhs for self with the ceiling of premium of Rs 4000/- per annum shall be taken by the Contract Employees themselves covering Covid-19 and other diseases. The premium amount shall be reimbursed to the contract employees subject to submission of copy of health insurance policy and original receipt of premium paid.
  5. Minimum PF as prescribed under the EPF & MP Act 1952 will be deducted from the salary and a matching contribution will be made by IRCON. The accumulations will be paid at the time of cessation of contract.
  6. One leave for each calendar month of service can be availed during the contract period. Leave can be carried forward and accumulated but no leave encashment for un availed leave is allowed during the contract or on resignation or termination of contract.   7. One weekly off and other public holidays when the project office remains closed would be available.

  10. No other perks or benefits would be admissible except the above.
  11. All information submitted in the application will be verified with original documents at the time of interview. If any information provided by the candidate is found to be false or incorrect or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria, then his/her candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at any stage of the recruitment process.
  12. The ex-contract employees of IRCON, whose services were terminated due to closure of projects, can also apply for the post if they fulfil the required qualifications and experience. Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: Minimum 60% aggregate marks / equivalent Cumulative Grade Points Average (CGPA), in Graduation. The graduation course should be of a minimum 3-year full time duration.
  • Essential Qualification: Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade or Chartered Accountant (CA). Post Graduation course should be of a minimum 2-year full time duration, with a specialization in Finance with minimum 60% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA. In case of CA, passing the professional examination is sufficient. Membership of ICAI is mandatory. The University / Institute should be recognised / approved by Government / AICTE / UGC. The candidates having completed their graduation and postgraduation courses through correspondence/part-time/open university/open learning/external/distance learning are not eligible.
  • Experience: Minimum 01 year of Post Qualification (Post Graduation or Chartered Accountant) work experience in a reputed commercial bank/financial institution/state level term lending institution, with skills in project finance, credit appraisal, term lending, analysis of cross-border risks and financing of overseas joint-ventures.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Deputy Manager (I): ₹ 48480-2000-62480-2340-67160-2680-85920
  • In addition to the pay, officers will be eligible for allowances, perquisites and benefits, as applicable to the Grade as per Bank’s rules, prevalent at the time of joining. Residential accommodation may be provided subject to availability or alternatively leased accommodation scheme is in place. Schemes for granting loans for housing, vehicle, personal computer, children education etc. are also available.

Age Limit (as on 31-12-2025)

  • Not below 21 years and not above 28 years as on December 31, 2025.
  • Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe (SC/ST): 33 Years
  • Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer): 31 Years
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - PwBD (SC/ ST): 43 Years
  • PwBD (OBC-NCL): 41 Years
  • PwBD (UR/ EWS): 38 Years

Application Fee

  • ₹ 600/- for General and OBC candidates
  • ₹ 100/- (Intimation charges) for SC/ST/ PwBD /EWS and Female candidates

Selection Process

  • The Selection Process will comprise Written test and Personal Interview.
  • Candidates who are shortlisted based on the performance in the Written test will be called for Personal Interview.
  • Final list shall be drawn based on overall performance of the candidate in Written examination and interviews. The marks obtained in written examination out of [Out of 100 with 70% weightage] and Interview [Out of 100 with 30% weightage] shall form the basis for final selection.

How to Apply

  • Candidates need to apply online only from January 26, 2026, up to February 15, 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Scan their: Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm), Signature (with black ink), Left thumb impression (on white paper with black or blue ink), A handwritten declaration (on a white paper with black ink) (text given below), The consolidated Mark Sheets of Graduation and Post-Graduation, Graduation and Post-Graduation Degree, Caste Certificate (if applicable) Ensuring that all these scanned documents adhere to the required specifications as given in this Advertisement.
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted.
  • The left thumb impression should be properly scanned and not smudged. (If a candidate is not having left thumb, he/she may use his/ her right thumb for applying.)
  • The text for the handwritten declaration is as follows – “I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.”
  • The above-mentioned handwritten declaration has to be in the candidate’s handwriting and in English only. If it is written and uploaded by anybody else or in any other language, the application will be considered as invalid.
  • Keep the necessary details/documents ready to make Online Payment of the requisite application fee/ intimation charges.
  • Have a valid personal email ID and mobile no., which should be kept active till the completion of this Recruitment Process. Bank may send intimation to download call letters for the Examination etc. through the mentioned e-mail ID and / or SMS. In case a candidate does not have a valid personal e-mail ID, he/she should create his/her new e-mail ID and mobile no. before applying on-line and must maintain that email account and mobile number.
  • Candidates to visit Online Application and click on the option "APPLY ONLINE" which will open a new screen.
  • To register, choose the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the Provisional Registration Number and Password. An Email & SMS indicating the Provisional Registration number and Password will also be sent.
  • In case the candidate is unable to complete the application form in one go, he / she can save the data already entered by choosing "SAVE AND NEXT" tab. Prior to submission of the online application, candidates are advised to use the "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to verify the details in the online application form and modify the same if required. Visually Impaired candidates should fill the application form carefully and verify/ get the details verified to ensure that the same are correct prior to final submission.
  • Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/ entertained after clicking the COMPLETE REGISTRATION BUTTON.
  • The Name of the candidate or his /her father/ Husband etc. should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the Certificates/ Mark sheets/Identity proof. Any change/alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Validate your details and save your application by clicking the 'Validate your details' and 'Save & Next' button.
  • Candidates can proceed to upload Photo & Signature as per the specifications given in the Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Photograph and Signature detailed under point "C".
  • Candidates can proceed to fill other details of the Application Form.
  • Click on the Preview Tab to preview and verify the entire application form before COMPLETE REGISTRATION.
  • Modify details, if required, and click on 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' ONLY after verifying and ensuring that the photograph, signature uploaded and other details filled by you are correct.
  • Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment.
  • Click on 'Submit' button.
  • The application form is integrated with the payment gateway and the payment process can be completed by following the instructions.
  • The payment can be made by using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/ Mobile Wallets.
  • After submitting your payment information in the online application form, PLEASE WAIT FOR THE INTIMATION FROM THE SERVER. DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH BUTTON IN ORDER TO AVOID DOUBLE CHARGE.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, an e-Receipt will be generated.
  • Non-generation of 'E-Receipt' indicates PAYMENT FAILURE. On failure of payment, Candidates are advised to login again using their Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the process of payment.
  • Candidates are required to take a printout of the e-Receipt and online Application Form containing fee details. Please note that if the same cannot be generated, online transaction may not have been successful.
  • For Credit Card users: All charges are listed in Indian Rupee. If you use a non-Indian credit card, your bank will convert to your local currency based on prevailing exchange rates.
  • To ensure the security of your data, please close the browser window once your transaction is completed.
  • There is facility to print application form containing fee details after payment of fees.
  • While filling in the Online Application Form the candidate will be provided with separate links for uploading Photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
  • Click on the respective link “Upload Photograph / signature / Upload left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant documents”.
  • Browse and select the location where the Scanned Photograph / signature / left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant document’s file has been saved.
  • Select the file by clicking on it
  • Click the ‘Open/Upload’
  • If the file size and format are not as prescribed, an error message will be displayed.
  • Preview of the uploaded image will help to see the quality of the image. In case of unclear / smudged, the same may be re-uploaded to the expected clarity /quality.

The total number of vacancies for CSIR-CIMFR Security Officer Recruitment 2026 is 01 post.

Post Name Total Posts
Security Officer 01

Note: CSIR-CIMFR strives to have a workforce that reflects gender balance and women candidates are encouraged to apply.

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification & Experience

Candidates must possess the following essential qualification and experience for the Security Officer post:

  • Ex-Servicemen JCO (Subedar or higher rank) OR equivalent rank in other Para-military forces with minimum of 10 years’ experience in security.
  • For Short Service Commissioned Officers and incumbents holding the position of Assistant Commandant in CRPF/BSF/ITBP etc. in pay scale Rs. 8000–13500 (Pre-revised) – minimum 05 years’ experience in security.
  • For Inspector from Para-Military Forces – minimum 10 years’ experience in security.

2. Age Limit & Relaxation

  • Maximum Age: 35 years as on 02-02-2026 (last date of receipt of application).
  • The date for determining age limit, experience and qualifications is 02-02-2026 up to 5:30 PM.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against UR vacancy are not eligible for age relaxation.
  • Relaxation in age limit is available only for eligible Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules under Ex-Servicemen (Re-employment in Central Civil Services and Posts) Rules, 1979 as amended.
  • Not applicable to serving Armed Forces personnel (except those being released after earning pension) and Paramilitary Forces personnel.

3. Nationality

The applicant must be a citizen of India. All applicants must fulfill the essential requirements and conditions as on 02-02-2026.

Job Description

The Security Officer will be responsible for overall security management of CSIR-CIMFR campus and its units, including supervision of security measures, record maintenance, and handling security-related emergencies.

  • Supervising security measures for safety of CSIR-CIMFR properties and units.
  • Maintaining records related to movement of men and materials, deployment of security personnel in all shifts, handling visitors, security cameras, and enforcement of security rules and procedures.
  • Working round the clock (24x7) as required and attending in person to security-related emergencies.
  • Conducting investigations into theft, pilferage, accidents, sabotage or subversive activities and coordinating with local law and order authorities; knowledge of local language is an added advantage.
  • Use and maintenance of firearms.
  • Firefighting and combating fire in emergencies.
  • Any other duty assigned by the competent authority.

Age Limit

  • Upper age limit not exceeding 35 years as on the last date of submission of application (02-02-2026 at 5:30 PM).
  • Date for determining age limit, experience and qualifications is the closing date for receipt of applications.
  • No age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against UR vacancy.
  • Age relaxation available only for eligible Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules under Ex-Servicemen (Re-employment in Central Civil Services and Posts) Rules, 1979 as amended.

Application Fee

  • Candidates are required to pay a non-refundable Application Fee of Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only).
  • Payment must be made through SBI payment gateway available at CSIR-CIMFR website (www.cimfr.nic.in) via SBI Collect.
  • Web generated e-receipt of SBI payment must be enclosed with the application form.
  • No other mode of payment is accepted.
  • SC/ST/Women candidates are exempted from payment of application fee (as mentioned in the “How to apply” section).

Selection Process

Candidates will be selected through the following stages:

  • Physical and Personality Assessment Test (qualifying in nature).
  • Written Test (for candidates who qualify the physical and personality assessment test).
  • Final merit list based on performance in competitive written examination (primarily Paper-II as per syllabus).
  • Tie cases will be resolved as per CSIR Letter No. 5-1(211)/2014-PD dated 30.05.2023 and any subsequent amendments.

Physical Standards

Physical Test Details

1600 m Running 6 min 30 sec Not applicable
Long Jump 3.65 m in 3 chances 2.70 m in 3 chances
Chin-ups Minimum 06 Not applicable
Push-ups Minimum 12 Not applicable

800 m Running Not applicable 4 min

Written Test Pattern

Candidates who qualify the physical test will be allowed to appear for the written test, consisting of two papers:

  • Paper-I: OMR-based or Computer Based Objective Type Multiple Choice Test.
  • Paper-II: Subjective type.
  • Paper-I (Mental Ability and Personality Assessment Test): 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes, no negative marking.
  • Threshold marks for Paper-I: 30%. Only candidates securing at least 30% in Paper-I will have Paper-II evaluated.
  • Paper-II: Total 100 marks, 2 hours duration – Comprehension (25), Report Writing (25), Security Regulations & Firefighting (25), General Awareness (25).
  • Minimum threshold marks for Paper-II shall not be less than 35% (to be notified before test).
  • Final merit list based on Paper-II marks only for candidates who secure more than minimum threshold marks.
  • Medium of exam: English and Hindi (bilingual question papers; exam can be taken in either language).
  • Standard of exam: Graduation level.

Salary / Stipend

  • Scale of Pay: Level-7 as per 7th CPC, Rs. 44,900–1,42,400.
  • Approximate total emoluments: Rs. 78,000/- per month at minimum of scale, including House Rent Allowance as admissible in Dhanbad.
  • Benefits include DA, HRA (if accommodation not provided), Transport Allowance and other allowances as per CSIR/GoI norms.
  • New entrants governed by New Pension Scheme (NPS) 2004 as adopted by CSIR; those from Government/Autonomous Bodies/PSUs with Govt. pattern pension continue under CCS (Pension) Rules 1972 (now 2021), as applicable.

How To Apply

Candidates must submit applications only in offline mode using the prescribed format.

  1. Visit CSIR-CIMFR website: www.cimfr.nic.in.
  2. Go to “Vacancies” section (http://cimfr.nic.in/vacancies.html) and download the prescribed Application Form (A4 size).
  3. Read the advertisement completely before filling the form. All columns are mandatory; write “Not Applicable (NA)” where not relevant.
  4. Fill the application form in English/Hindi, affix recent self-attested passport size colour photograph and sign the form.
  5. Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/- (if applicable) through SBI Collect via SBI payment gateway available at CIMFR website and take a print-out of the e-receipt.
  6. Attach self-attested copies of required documents (age proof, educational qualifications, experience, discharge certificate, caste certificate, NOC if applicable, etc.) along with web generated SBI e-receipt.
  7. Place the application and enclosures in an envelope superscribed:
    “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF __________ (Post Code: _______), Advt. No. _______”
  8. Send the envelope by Registered/Speed Post only to:
    The Controller of Administration, Central Institute of Mining & Fuel Research, Barwa Road, Dhanbad – 826001 (JHARKHAND)
  9. Ensure that the application reaches on or before 02-02-2026 by 5:30 PM. Applications received after the closing date/time will not be entertained.
  10. Applications without photograph, signature, application fee (if applicable), or required enclosures will be summarily rejected.

    • Paper I: General Hindi - 200 marks, 100 questions, 2 hours (Qualifying - 30% minimum, marks not counted in merit)
    • Paper II: General Studies, General Science, Civics, Indian History, Indian Geography, Mathematics and Mental Aptitude - 200 marks, 100 questions, 2 hours
  • Stage 3 - Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Candidates selected will be 6 times the vacancies based on Main Exam marks
    • Running: 1 mile (1.6 km) in 6 minutes 30 seconds for men; 1 km in 6 minutes for women
    • High Jump: Minimum 4 feet for men; 3 feet for women
    • Long Jump: Minimum 12 feet for men; 9 feet for women
    • Shot Put: 16 pounds shot minimum 16 feet for men; 12 pounds shot minimum 10 feet for women
    • Maximum 3 attempts allowed for High Jump, Long Jump and Shot Put
  • Negative Marking: 0.2 marks will be deducted for each wrong answer in both stages
  • Final Merit List: Based on Main Examination marks with minimum qualifying marks - SC/ST/Women: 32%, EBC: 34%, BC: 36.5%, General: 40%
  • Normalization: Equi-Percentile Method will be used for multi-session/multi-set examinations

Physical Standards

  • Height Requirements:
    • Unreserved (UR) and BC Male: Minimum 165 cm
    • EBC, SC, ST Male: Minimum 160 cm
    • All category Females: Minimum 155 cm
  • Chest Measurement (Male only):
    • UR/BC/EBC Male: Unexpanded - 81 cm, Expanded - 86 cm (minimum 5 cm expansion required)
    • SC/ST Male: Unexpanded - 79 cm, Expanded - 84 cm (minimum 5 cm expansion required)
    • Not applicable for females
  • Weight: Minimum 48 kg for all category female candidates
  • Third Gender: Physical standards same as Backward Class category
  • Candidates not meeting prescribed standards will be declared unsuccessful

General Information/Instructions

  • Only one online application per candidate is allowed. Multiple applications will lead to rejection of all applications
  • Candidates must have a valid and active mobile number and email ID registered in their name for the entire recruitment process
  • Registration ID and Password will be sent via SMS and email after successful registration
  • Candidates must upload recent color photograph (white background, 15-25 KB, .jpg/.jpeg/.gif format) taken within 2 months
  • Signature required in both English and Hindi (black/blue ink, white background, 15-25 KB, .jpg/.jpeg/.gif format)

  • Reservation benefits applicable only to Bihar State domicile candidates

BPSC Project Manager Recruitment 2026 Overview

BPSC (Bihar Public Service Commission) is a government body in the state of Bihar, India, established by the Constitution of India, to recruit candidates for various state government jobs in Bihar through competitive examinations and it is currently hiring Project Managers for its 2026 recruitment drive. This is a fantastic opportunity for individuals who have completed their engineering degrees and are looking to work in a prestigious public sector organization. How to Apply for BPSC Project Manager Recruitment 2026

The application process for BPSC Recruitment 2026 is straightforward. Follow these steps to submit your application:

2. Register:
Provide your name, date of birth, email, mobile number, etc. Set a password and complete the registration process. Verify your account via OTP received on your email or phone

  • Written Examination and Practical Test.
  • A. Written Examination- The written examination will be objective in nature. This examination will have one paper on General Knowledge, which will include the following subjects:-
  • (a) General Studies - Number of questions-50
  • (b) General Science and Mathematics - Number of questions-50
  • (c) Mental Ability Test (Comprehension/Logic/Reasoning/Mental Ability) - Number of questions-50
  • The questions will be objective and multiple choice. Total number of questions-150. 4 marks are fixed for each correct answer and 1 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer. The duration of the examination will be 2 hours 15 minutes. The question papers in the written examination will be in Hindi/English language. If there is any difference in the Hindi and English question papers, then the English questions will be valid.
  • Note: In the light of resolution memo no. 2374 dated 16.07.2007 of Personnel and Administrative Reforms Department, Bihar and resolution memo no. 962 dated 22.01.2021 of General Administration Department, 40 (forty) percent for general category, 36.5 (thirty-six and a half) percent for backward class, 34 (thirty-four) percent for extremely backward class and 32 (thirty-two) percent minimum qualifying marks for scheduled caste/scheduled tribe/women and disabled candidates is mandatory.
  • Through the written examination, candidates equal to 05 times the number of vacancies available category-wise will be selected for the Practical Test (Skill Test).
  • B. Practical Test Examination:-
  • (i) In the shorthand test examination, 80 (eighty) words per minute speed for Hindi and English dictation total 320 (three hundred twenty) words have to be written in sign script in the provided notebook in 04 (four) minutes {(1 minute additional time at the beginning for dictation writing)} duration. After the prescribed dictation, 02 minutes additional time will be given for correction. Total 20 (twenty) minutes will be given for typing the shorthand passage.
  • (ii) Typing test examination (Hindi and English) will be taken on computer.
  • (iii) In Hindi typing test examination, Mangal font in Remington Gail Keyboard Layout will be used.
  • (iv) In Hindi typing test examination, candidates have to type total 300 (three hundred) words at a speed of 30 (thirty) words per minute in 10 (ten) minutes.
  • (v) In English typing test examination, “UTF-8” Under English (US) Keyboard Layout will be used.
  • (vi) In English typing test examination, total 300 (three hundred) words have to be typed in 10 (ten) minutes at a speed of 30 (thirty) words per minute.
  • (vii) Candidates should select the appropriate Keyboard Layout at the beginning of Typing, changing Keyboard Layout during Typing may erase the content typed by the candidate.
  • (viii) Compensatory time will be given to benchmark disabled (visually impaired) candidates as per rules.
  • (ix) More than 10 percent error in shorthand speed and 1.5 percent in typing will not be acceptable for success in the practical test examination.
  • (x) Candidates will ensure to follow the instructions displayed on the Computer Screen from time to time during the examination.
  • Note: Detailed information for the practical examination will be published after the written examination and the practical examination will be conducted in the light of the published information.
  • Candidates who have been debarred from examination for specified period by Union Public Service Commission/Bihar Public Service Commission/Bihar Staff Selection Commission/other selection commission in cases of malpractice will not be entitled to appear in the competition examination. The decision of the Commission on the point of eligibility or ineligibility of the candidates to sit in the examination will be final.
  • C. In the light of memo no. 1003 dated 22.01.2021 and letter no. 12897 dated 28.07.2022 of General Administration Department, Bihar, Patna, preference will be given in regular appointment to contractually appointed employees on similar posts.

General Information / Instructions

  • In the light of resolution memo no. 22218 dated 12.12.2022 of General Administration Department, 05 (five) years relaxation in the maximum age limit prescribed for participation in competitive examinations is permissible for government servants regularly appointed by the Bihar Government, but the relaxation in the said age limit will be allowed only when they have not availed more than 05 (five) opportunities till then.
  • In the light of resolution memo no. 962 dated 22.01.2021 of General Administration Department, Bihar, 10 years relaxation in maximum age limit is permissible for disabled persons.
  • In the light of the letter of General Administration Department, ex-servicemen will be given concession equivalent to 03 (three) years plus the period spent in defense service in the age limit, provided that their actual age does not exceed 57 years on the date of application.
  • Syllabus:- The syllabus of the written examination is as follows:-
  • Section (a):- General Studies:- The objective of the questions will be to test the candidate's general knowledge of the surrounding environment and its application in society. Questions related to current events and subtle observation of day-to-day events and scientific approach towards them will also be included, about which an educated person is expected to have knowledge. Questions may be asked especially about Bihar, India and its neighboring countries.
  • (i) Contemporary Issues:- Scientific progress, National/International Awards, Indian Languages, Book, Script, Capital, Currency, Sports-Players, Important Events.
  • (ii) India and its Neighboring Countries:- History of Neighboring Countries, History of India, Culture, Geography, Economic Scenario, Freedom Movement, Main Features of Indian Agriculture and Natural Resources and Constitution and Polity of India, Political System of the Country, Panchayati Raj, Community Development, Five-Year Plan and Contribution of Bihar in the National Movement.
  • Section (b):- General Science and Mathematics:- Questions may generally be asked from the following subjects at the Matric level-
  • (i) General Science:- Basic questions related to Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Geography and knowledge of computer basics/word processing.
  • (ii) Mathematics:- Questions related to number system, computation of whole numbers, decimals and fractions, interrelationship between numbers, basic arithmetical operations, percentage, ratio and proportion, average, interest and profit and loss.
  • Section (c):- Mental Ability Test:- Both verbal and non-verbal types of questions may be asked such as- analogy, similarity and difference, space visualization, problem solving, analysis, visual memory, discrimination, observation, relationship concept, arithmetical reasoning, arithmetical number series, code writing and code interpretation, series, classification, mirror image, hidden figure, picture matrix, paper cutting, group images, shape construction and dice, analogy, analytical reasoning, water image, pattern completion, paper folding, rule detection, dot situation, picture formation and analysis.
  • 7. Merit List:-After passing the practical test examination, the merit list will be prepared by the Commission by adding the marks obtained in the written examination and the preference marks obtained on the basis of contract. In case of equal marks in the written examination, the merit list will be determined on the basis of marks obtained in General Studies subject. In case of equal marks in General Studies subject also, priority will be given to the marks obtained in General Science and Mathematics subject. If the marks in General Science and Mathematics subject are equal, the candidate with higher age will be placed higher in the merit order on the basis of date of birth and if the date of birth is the same, the candidate whose name comes first according to the alphabet in Devanagari script will be placed higher in the merit order. In this way the final merit list will be prepared.

  • Without any prejudice to the above condition, the candidate will be terminated from his services with immediate effect without any obligations, in case the candidate is found guilty of violating any of the conditions contained in the terms of employment or is guilty of any misconduct including negligence of duties, unauthorized absence, etc.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: The qualification and other terms and conditions of appointment of academic staff as specified under Schedule ‘E’ of NIT Statutes (Amended 2017) (Ref.   • Essential Qualification: For Engineering Disciplines: B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent and M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent and Ph.D. in relevant/ equivalent discipline with first class in the preceding Degrees. BE/B.Tech. with direct Ph.D. with first class in preceding Degree will also be considered.
  • Essential Qualification: For Architecture Department: B. Arch. or equivalent and M.Arch./M.Plan. or equivalent. Further following shall also be essential qualification without insisting on credit point requirements at Assistant Professor level: (i) M.Arch. or M.Plan. or equivalent with one-year professional experience: Assistant Professor at Academic Grade Pay of Rs. 6000 (ii) M.Arch. or M.Plan. or equivalent with two-year professional experience: Assistant Professor at Academic Grade Pay of Rs. 7000 (iii) For higher cadres the educational qualifications and credit point requirement shall remain same as given in the Table of Schedule‘E’ for Engineering and Sciences
  • Essential Qualification: For Non-Engineering Departments: Ph.D. degree in the relevant or equivalent discipline with first class in preceding Degrees.
  • Desirable Qualification: In case, first class is not mentioned in the preceding Degrees by the University / Institution, then the candidates should have secured at least 6.5 CGPA (on a 10-point scale) or 60% marks in aggregate.
  • Desirable Qualification: In case the candidate has secured CGPA under any other point scale (other than 10-point scale), then certificate issued by the authorized signatory (not the Mentor/Supervisor/Head of the Department) of the Institute / University to the effect of having secured first class in such Degree must be attached. Alternately, the CGPA may be equivalently converted on 10- point scale for determination of eligibility.
  • Desirable criteria for Professor (Level 14A): (a) Good quality publications with at least 20 papers in SCI/SCIE/SSCI Journals. (b) At least three, in combination of ongoing/ completed externally sponsored research project AND/OR patent granted. (c) Supervised at least two Ph.D. completed and one ongoing. (d) Organized three activities in cumulative of Conference(s) OR at least 5 days Workshop/ STTP/FDP course(s).
  • Desirable criteria for Associate Professor (Level 13A2): (a) Good quality publications with at least 10 papers in SCI/SCIE/SSCI Journals. (b) At least two, in combination of ongoing/ completed externally sponsored research project AND/OR patent granted. (c) Supervised at least one Ph.D. completed and one ongoing. (d) Organized two activities in cumulative of Conference(s) OR at least 5 days Workshop/ STTP/FDP course(s).
  • Desirable criteria for Assistant Professor (Level -12): (a) Good quality publications with at least 5 papers in SCI/SCIE/SSCI Journals. (b) At least one ongoing/ completed externally sponsored research project OR one patent granted. (c) Supervised at least one Ph.D. completed/ ongoing. (d) Organized one Conference OR at least 5 days Workshop/ STTP/FDP course.
  • Desirable criteria for Assistant Professor (Level -10): (a) Good quality publications with at least 3 papers in SCI/SCIE/SSCI Journals.
  • Experience: Experience as per Clarification no. 7, GoI, Ministry of Education(MoE, erstwhile MHRD), F.No.33-9/2011-TS.III, Dated 16th April, 2019, (including prior to implementation of NIRF) shall be considered if acquired in any of the following Institutions: • Fully Funded Central Educational Institutions. • IIMs, Other Management Institutions and Research institutions ranked by NIRF up to 50 for any two years. • State Educational Institutions funded by respective State Government. • Other Educational Institutions (Universities and Engineering institutes) ranked by NIRF up to 100 in Overall, and 10 for Architecture, for any two years.
  • Experience: Experience as mentioned above and as per RRs in an Institution/ Organization will only be considered for calculating total experience.
  • Administrative Experience: Contributions to Institute/Department Administration shall be recommended by concerned Head and approved by the Head of the Institution. Otherwise, weightage of administrative experience for evaluating the credit points may not be considered for determining the eligibility. No correspondence shall be entertained in this regard. [As prescribed in Note 1, Point no. 4 of Schedule ‘E’ of NITs Statutes (vide Gazette of India No. 651, Dated, July 24, 2017)].
  • Experience: Less than six months of individual (independent/discrete) experience in different Organizations with gaps in-between even in relevant regular position in any Organization will be ignored in computing total experience.

  • The short-listed candidates may be required to appear for written exam/presentation/seminar in the respective Departments, in addition to facing the Selection Committee.

General Information / Instructions

  • This being an advertisement governed by the four-tier flexible Faculty Recruitment Rules, relevant instructions from MoE issued till the date of interview will be applicable to this recruitment process.
  • The Institute reserves the right to increase/decrease number of vacancies including those in the Reserved Categories without notification.
  • Since all the posts are to be filled-in by open advertisement, candidates working in NIT Raipur who are aspiring for higher Pay levels are required to submit their application even if the posts in the concern Department are not advertised.
  • For the Departments which are not having any vacancy, movement in higher Pay Level or Cadre will be carried out as per specified selection process but restricted to only for serving faculty members of the respective Departments of the Institute (as per Note 1(5) of Schedule ‘E’ of Statutes 23[5](a) of the First Statutes of the National Institute of Technology (Amendment) Statutes, 2017) and as directed by MoE, Government of India, from time to time.
  • The Institute reserves the right to modify/ defer or cancel full / part of the advertisement / recruitment process at any stage of processing without assigning any reason whatsoever and no communication in this regard will be made.
  • Financial assistance for attending national/international conferences for presenting research papers or Chairing sessions, for sponsored training in India and abroad, for membership of professional Societies etc. under the Scheme of Cumulative Professional Development Allowance [CPDA] limited to Rs.1.00 lakh per annum subject to the maximum limit of Rs.3.00 lakh in a block period of three years or as per rules.
  • An initial Research Grant (Seed Grant) up to Rs. 5.00 Lakh for new Faculty as per Institute norms.
  • Provision for undertaking consultancy and testing work as per Institute norms.
  • On campus residence [depending on availability].
  • Medical Facilities to Faculty and their dependent family members as per rules.
  • Reimbursement of expenses on telephone as per approved norms.
  • Group Insurance Scheme for Faculty as per Institute norms.
  • Provision of Child care Leave, Children Education Allowance and maternity/paternity Leave as per Government of India (GoI) norms.
  • LTC as per Government of India (GoI) norms.
  • HRA as per the Government of India (GoI) norms.
  • New entrants will be covered under the New Pension Scheme [NPS-2004] as per Ministry of Education Guidelines, GoI norms, NIT Act and Statutes. The existing Faculty members, if selected, shall be governed by their current Pension Scheme.
  • Leave will be granted as per CCS Leave Rules, 1972.
  • The appointees will be granted ‘No Objection Certificates’ and applications of such appointees for outside job can be forwarded only after completion of two years of services and as per the NIT Statutes.
  • Candidates are required to go through the details of Posts and instructions available on the Institute Website carefully before applying to ensure their eligibility for the post.
  • All recruitment and pay-fixation shall be done by the Appointing Authority, i.e., Board of Governors (BoG) of the Institute only on the recommendations of duly constituted Selection Committees. The decision of the Appointing Authority shall be final. There is no scope for fixing or altering the pay (pay in Level/Cell) outside the Selection Committee for Level10 and 12. The Selection Committee shall be the only entity empowered to consider the past services and qualifications of a candidate. However, higher starting Pay and/or Pay Level may be offered to deserving candidates on recommendation of the Selection Committee upon approval of the Board of Governors for Levels 13A2 and 14A. Selected candidates to the above faculty positions will be fixed in the minimum basic pay as per norm and only the regular service at NIT Raipur, will be counted for any purpose thereafter.
  • As this is a fresh appointment [As per Schedule ‘E’ of Statute 23(5)(a) Note 1(1)], any change in the Pay Level/Cell in 7th CPC, is through direct recruitment through open advertisement. Therefore, the term “promotion” used in RRs/ Guidelines/ MoE (erstwhile MHRD) communications should be read as “Appointment through Direct Recruitment”.
  • The appointee (new entrants)in the contract position should undergo or submit medical fitness certificate and verification of the character antecedent in consonance with; the GoI guidelines.
  • Persons serving in Govt. / Semi Govt. / PSUs / Universities / Educational Institutions should send their applications either THROUGH PROPER CHANNEL or should furnish a NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE from the Competent Authority of the Organization serving, in the prescribed form at the time of interview otherwise they may not be allowed for interview. However, they can submit the advance copy of the Application Form.
  • Applications which are not online/ not in prescribed form / without relevant supporting enclosures and without fee shall be summarily rejected. No correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.
  • The minimum qualification with regard to academic qualification and experience (on credit basis) for all positions advertised shall be governed by the Schedule ‘E’ of NITs Statutes (issued vide Gazette of India No. 651, Dated July, 24th 2017 [As per Schedule ‘E’ of Statute 23(5)(a), Note 1(1)] and the Amendments.
  • Desirable areas of specialization in various Departments are given in Annexure-II. However, candidates with other relevant areas of specialization may also apply.
  • The date for determining the eligibility of candidates in every respect, i.e., qualifications, experience and preferred age limit etc. shall be considered as on the closing date, i.e., the last date of the submission of Online Application Form.
  • Instructions for submission of application are attached in Annexure-III and is required to be followed.
  • Candidates shall indicate two references of Eminent Person(s) in the specialization/ profession who may be contacted by the Institute for their recommendations.
  • Original documents along with one set of self-attested copies will have to be produced at the time of interview for verification.
  • All Degrees and Certificates should have been obtained from recognized Institute/University.
  • Mere possession of minimum qualification/ experience will not entitle the candidate to be called for interview/ selection or appointment.
  • The Institute has the right to set higher norms than minimum and the areas of specialization while shortlisting, taking into account the specific requirements of the individual departments. The short-listing norms may not be uniform across the departments/ posts of the Institute and shall be binding on all the applicants. Priority of shortlisting shall be as under: (i) All three degrees (UG/PG/PhD) from IIT/IISc/IIM/NIT or reputed institute with NIRF ranking within 100 for universities and engineering institutes or 50 for management institutes for three years or foreign university an institute in QS/THE world ranking upto 500. (ii) At least two degrees (UG/PG/PhD) from IIT/IISc/IIM/NIT or reputed institute with NIRF ranking within 100 for universities and engineering institutes or 50 for management institutes for three years or foreign university an institute in QS/THE world ranking upto 500. (iii) At least one degree (UG/PG/PhD) from IIT/IISc/IIM/NIT or reputed institute with NIRF ranking within 100 for universities and engineering institutes or 50 for management institutes for three years or foreign university an institute in QS/THE world ranking upto 500.
  • The decision of the Institute related to all matters pertaining to the recruitment shall be final and binding on the applicants.
  • Note: if the candidate achieves the degree under integrated mode, then it shall be considered as two degrees among UG/PG/PhD.
  • Policy on avoiding ‘In-Breeding’: Candidates who have obtained their most recent Degree (Ph.D.) from NIT Raipur, will not be considered for recruitment, except where there is a 3-year gap between leaving the Institute and last date of the submission of online application.
  • Govt. of India (GoI) norms of Reservations are followed in the Institute. All reserved candidates are required to submit their Caste/Category certificates in prescribed format [Annexure-IV/V/VII] along with the hard copy of application. (Res.), Dated 15.11.1993, GoI, No. 36028/1/2014-Estt (Res), Dated 3rd September, 2015 will only be accepted as sufficient proof in support of a candidate’s claim belonging to Schedule Caste/ Schedule Tribe/ Other Backward Class (NCL).   • Legal disputes if any, with NIT Raipur will be restricted within the jurisdiction of Raipur Courts only.

The information uploaded on the website shall remain for a specific period only. Therefore, the candidates are advised to download the uploaded information and keep with them for future. During ongoing process of recruitment, neither any application under Right to Information Act. 2005 shall be entertained nor information will be provided. Factual information under the R.T.I Act shall be provided only after declaration of final results of the process. Inferential questions or speculative questions shall not be answered in RTI.

  • Please note that application(s) filled only through the official portal (Google Chrome is more friendly for filling the online application) in the institute website (www.nitrr.ac.in) shall be accepted. A print-out of the application form obtained from the Online Portal, duly signed by the candidate, should be sent to the Institute along with self-attested photocopies of the supporting documents, testimonials and the proof(s) of Fee paid. Last date of receipt of Application 20 February 2026 till 5 PM

Selection Process

  • Applications will be scrutinised and eligibility of candidates will be assessed based on qualification, experience, equipment, technical facilities, credibility etc. as per the Assessment Scale in the guidelines.
  • Shortlisted applicants will be asked to provide test coverages using their own equipment and raw material to ascertain the quality of their work.
  • Applicants will have to undergo interview and verification of equipment and documents, including physical verification of equipment by the Empanelment Committee or Technical Committee.
  • A test coverage assignment will be given to all applicants for submission to RNU before their interview date; submission on time is essential for being called for interview.
  • The final panel of Stringers will be drawn by the Committee based on assessment scale, interview and quality of test coverages, and names of selected Stringers will be published and informed in writing.
  • Stringers will be removed from the panel for reasons such as refusal to cover assignments, poor content or technical quality, delay in coverage, subcontracting work, cartel operations, incorrect information or any act causing embarrassment to Prasar Bharati.

General Information/Instructions

  • The Regional News Unit, Doordarshan Kendra, Vijayawada invites applications for Empanelment as Stringers from individuals with experience in news coverages for districts of Andhra Pradesh listed in the notification.
  • Applicants should mention in the application form the name of the district where they wish to be empanelled and must be based in that district.
  • The key person for operation of stringership must be clearly mentioned and he/she must be working in the applied district and must continue to be in the same district once selected.
  • Empanelled Stringers are expected to cover news and short features on news, current affairs, sports, business and other subjects and also alert RNU on major news or breaking stories.
  • Applications should be submitted in sealed cover with superscription “Empanelment of Stringers of DD News-2026” on or before the last date of submission.
  • Proof in duplicate of Academic and Technical Qualifications, Experience and Equipment ownership must be submitted along with the application in the model form provided in the notification.
  • Separate annexures can be given along with the application detailing experience or qualification of the applicant and team, if required.
  • For any clarification, candidates may write to the RNU Email ID – [email protected] as mentioned in the notification.
  • The panel of Stringers shall be revised every two years and existing Stringers will also go through the processes as per revised guidelines.

How to Apply

  • Download and fill the prescribed Application Form for Empanelment as Stringer in Doordarshan (Annexure-A) as given in the notification.
  • Provide details such as district headquarters for empanelment, personal particulars, academic qualifications, technical qualifications, experience, equipment and facilities, and corporate status as required in the form.
  • Enclose attested copies of certificates supporting qualifications, experience, equipment ownership and other information furnished in the application.
  • Attach a Demand Draft of Rs. 1,180/- (inclusive of GST) towards non refundable processing fee in favour of “DDO/ DDK, Vijayawada” payable at Vijayawada.
  • Submit the completed application in triplicate in a sealed cover with superscription “Empanelment of Stringers of DD News-2026”.
  • Send the application to: The Head of News, Regional News Unit, Doordarshan Kendra, Punnamathota, Opp; TTD Kalyanamadapam, Vijayawada – 520010, Andhra Pradesh, on or before 20 February 2026 till 5 PM.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Qualification: 10+2 Examination from a recognized Board of School Education/University.
  • OR Matriculation from recognized Board of School Education with one/two year Diploma/Certificate from an ITI in Information Technology (IT) & Information Technology Enabled Sectors (ITES) as notified by Directorate General of Employment & Training, Government of India, from time to time; OR three years Diploma in Computer Engineering/Computer Science/IT from a Polytechnic approved by AICTE.
  • Provided that the candidate must have passed Matriculation and 10+2 from any School/Institution situated within Himachal Pradesh; this condition shall not apply to Bonafide Himachalis.
  • Computer typing speed of 30 words per minute in English or 25 words per minute in Hindi is required.
  • Visually impaired persons selected/recruited under 1% quota are exempted from acquiring Diploma in Computer Science/Computer Application/IT and passing of typing test; they shall be imparted necessary basic and computer training by designated institutions and must qualify the training within the prescribed chances.
  • Differently abled persons otherwise qualified to hold clerical post, certified as being unable to type by the Medical Board, may be exempted from passing the typing test.
  • Desirable: Knowledge of customs, manners and dialects of Himachal Pradesh and suitability for appointment in the peculiar conditions prevailing in the Pradesh.

Salary/Stipend

  • The post of Junior Office Assistant (IT) (Job Trainee) carries a consolidated fixed amount of Rs. 12,500/- per month.
  • The recruitment and engagement as per this advertisement are governed by Department of Personnel guidelines referred to in the notification.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • Minimum age: 18 years.
  • Maximum age: 45 years.
  • The upper age limit for candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Classes, Persons with Disabilities categories who are domiciles of Himachal Pradesh, employees of Himachal Pradesh Government and Ex-servicemen of Himachal Pradesh is relaxable up to five (05) years as per Government of Himachal Pradesh orders.

Application Fee

  • Examination and other processing fees are prescribed category-wise in the notification under “EXAMINATION AND OTHER PROCESSING FEES”; fee is payable only through online payment (no other mode is acceptable).
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded and will not be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.

Fee structure for an examination process.

  • Total Examination Fee: ₹800.00
  • Fee Breakdown: ₹100/- for examination fee and ₹700/- for processing fee.
  • Correction Fee: ₹100.00
  • Correction Window: Open for seven days, starting three working days after the closing date for submission of Online Recruitment Application (ORAS).

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Date 21-01-2026
Opening date for submission of Online Recruitment Application (ORA) Form 27-01-2026 (10:00 AM)
Closing date for submission of Online Recruitment Application (ORA) Form 27-02-2026 (till 11:59 PM)
Date for determining eligibility (Essential Qualification/Experience) 27-02-2026 (till 11:59 PM)
Correction window for rectifying errors in ORA For 7 days, commencing after 3 working days from closing date of ORA (exact dates as per notification schedule)

Selection Process

  • Mode of Selection: Computer Based Test/Written screening test of 120 marks of 1½ hours duration (or as decided by the Aayog) followed by a Typing Test, which shall be mandatory and qualifying in nature.
  • The objective type screening test will consist of 120 multiple-choice questions, each carrying 1 mark.
  • Scope of syllabus:
    – Subjects of 10+2 level prescribed as per essential qualification and as notified in the advertisement.
    – Syllabus relating to Computer Science/Computer Application/IT/ITES/Information Practices prescribed as essential qualification.
    – General Knowledge including General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh, Current Affairs, Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi of Matric standard.
  • Skill test on computer with minimum typing speed of 30 wpm in English or 25 wpm in Hindi for those who qualify screening test; skill test is of qualifying nature.
  • Minimum qualifying marks in written screening test/OMR/CBT: 45% for General category candidates and 40% for SC/ST/OBC/ Wards of Freedom Fighters; Aayog may relax qualifying percentage by a maximum of 5% if required and record reasons in writing.
  • Where skill/physical test is essential, candidates will be shortlisted for such tests based on merit of MCQ/CBT as per ratios given (up to five times, specific caps for 30–40 and more than 40 posts).
  • In case of multiple-shift CBT examination, scores shall be normalized using Z-Score (Mean and Standard Deviation) method for merit preparation.
  • A category-wise waiting list/panel will be prepared, valid for one year from the date of sending recommendation by HPRCA to appointing authority; size of waiting panel depends on number of advertised posts as specified.

General Information/Instructions

  • Online Applications are invited through the official website of HPRCA (https://hprca.hp.gov.in); no offline application form will be accepted.

Note:

  • The HPPSC SET-2026 will be conducted in Offline mode only
  • Test will be conducted at various examination centers located at Shimla, Solan, Mandi, Kangra at Dharamshala, Bilaspur, Hamirpur, Nahan, Una, Kullu and Chamba
  • This is an eligibility test accredited by University Grants Commission (UGC)
  • The test determines eligibility for recruitment to posts of Assistant Professors in Universities and Colleges within Himachal Pradesh

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

  • General/Unreserved/General-EWS candidates: Must have secured at least 55% marks (without rounding off) in Master's Degree
  • SC of H.P./ST of H.P./OBC (Non-creamy layer) of H.P./PWD of H.P. candidates: Must have secured at least 50% marks (without rounding off) in Master's Degree
  • Master's Degree must be from Universities/Institutions recognized by UGC in Humanities (including languages) and Social Sciences, Computer Science & Applications
  • Candidates pursuing Master's degree or whose result is awaited may also apply provisionally
  • Such candidates must complete their PG Degree examination within two years from the date of SET result with required percentage of marks
  • Ph.D. Degree holders whose Master's level examination was completed by 19th September 1991 are eligible for 5% relaxation in aggregate marks (from 55% to 50%)

Essential Requirements

  • Candidates must appear in the subject of their post-graduation only
  • If Post Graduation subject is not covered in SET subjects list, candidates may appear in UGC-NET/Joint CSIR-UGC Test
  • Candidates qualifying SET in subject other than their Master's Degree subject will not be considered eligible
  • Reserved category candidates must ensure their certificate is on parental lineage issued by competent authority

Desirable

  • Candidates having post-graduate diploma/certificate from Indian/Foreign University should ascertain equivalence with Master's Degree from Association of Indian Universities (AIU), New Delhi
  • Candidates already in Government service must inform their Head of Office/Department in writing that they have applied for SET

Age Limit

  • No Age Limit: A candidate can appear in the SET any number of times and there is no age restriction
  • This allows candidates of all ages to appear for the eligibility test

Application Fee

S.No Category Examination Fee
1 General Category Rs. 1,150/-
2 Gen-EWS / Other Backward Class (Non-Creamy Layer) of H.P. Rs. 600/-
3 SC of HP / ST of H.P. / BPL (General BPL/SC BPL/ST BPL) of H.P. / PWD (General PWD/S.C. PWD/S.T. PWD/OBC PWD) of H.P. / EWS BPL of H.P. Rs. 325/-

Payment Mode:

  • Online payment through Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking via e-Payment Gateway
  • Payment must be made on or before the closing date for submission of online applications
  • Fee once paid shall neither be refunded under any circumstance nor held in reserve for any other examination
  • Payment through any other mode is neither valid nor acceptable
  • Applications without prescribed fee will be summarily rejected

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification/Advertisement Date 03/01/2026
Online Application Start Date 03/01/2026
Online Application Last Date 30/01/2026 (till 11:59 PM)
Examination Date To be notified in due course
Display of Provisional Answer Keys After conclusion of examination
Timeline for Objections to Answer Key 5 days (excluding day of publishing answer key)
Result Declaration To be announced on website

Selection Process

  • The test consists of two papers conducted in two separate sessions
  • Paper-I (General Awareness):
    • Marks: 100
    • Number of Questions: 50 (objective type multiple choice)
    • Duration: 01 Hour
    • Questions of general nature to assess teaching/research aptitude, reasoning ability, comprehension, divergent thinking and general awareness
  • Paper-II (Concerned Subject):
    • Marks: 200
    • Number of Questions: 100 (objective type multiple choice)
    • Duration: 02 Hours
    • Questions based on subject selected by candidate to assess domain knowledge covering entire syllabus
  • Marking Scheme:
    • Each question carries 2 marks
    • 2 marks for each correct response
    • No negative marking for incorrect response
    • No marks for unanswered/unattempted questions
    • If question is dropped/scrapped, 2 marks awarded to all candidates
  • Qualifying Criteria:
    • Top 6% of appeared candidates who appear in both papers will be declared qualified
    • General Category: At least 40% aggregate marks required
    • Reserved Categories: At least 35% aggregate marks required
    • In case of tie at last qualifying cut-off marks, all tied candidates will be considered qualified
    • Candidate must appear in both papers to be considered
  • Provisional Answer Keys will be displayed on website for challenges/objections
  • Candidates can raise objections by paying Rs. 100/- per question online within 5 days
  • Final result will be prepared based on revised answer key

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications invited through Online mode only - no other mode will be entertained
  • Candidates can apply through official website http://www.hppsc.hp.gov.in
  • Closing date for online applications: 30/01/2026 till 11:59 PM, after which link will be disabled
  • HPPSC is the Authorized Nodal Agency accredited by UGC for conducting SET
  • Admission to SET will be purely provisional subject to satisfying prescribed eligibility conditions
  • Mere issuance of admit card does not imply candidature has been finally cleared
  • Candidates neither required to send certificates/documents nor printout of Application Form at time of applying
  • Candidates must ensure their eligibility for the test themselves
  • Wrong information or ineligibility detected at any stage will result in cancellation of candidature
  • HPPSC will not undertake verification of documents/eligibility at any stage
  • SET certificates issued only based on information provided in Online Application Form
  • Information entered in online application form will be treated as final - no changes after closing date
  • HPPSC does not edit/modify/alter any information entered by candidates
  • Candidates must ensure email address and mobile number registered are their own
  • Incomplete applications without requisite fee, photograph and signatures will be rejected
  • Facilitation Counter/Help Line available at Tel: 0177-2629738 and Toll Free: 1800-180-8004 (10:00 AM to 5:00 PM on working days)

Reservation Policy

  • SC of H.P./ST of H.P./EWS of H.P./PWD of H.P./OBC of H.P. (Non-creamy layer) as per State list will be considered for reservation
  • Reserved category candidates of other States will be treated as General category candidates
  • They will be issued SET certificates only if they qualify at par with General category cut-off marks
  • Fee concession applicable only for SC/ST/OBC (Non-creamy layer)/PWD/BPL category candidates of Himachal Pradesh

Exemption/Eligibility for Assistant Professor

  • NET/SET shall remain minimum eligibility condition for recruitment and appointment of Assistant Professors
  • Ph.D. Degree holders (as per UGC Regulations 2022) are exempted from NET/SET requirement
  • Candidates who cleared SET before 1st June 2002 are exempted from NET and eligible anywhere in India
  • SET qualified from 1st June 2002 onwards are eligible only in Universities/Colleges of the State where they cleared SET

Provisions for Persons with Disability (PWD)

  • Applicable for candidates having 40% or more disability
  • Twenty minutes compensatory time for Paper-I and forty minutes for Paper-II
  • Candidates unable to write in own handwriting can avail services of scribe
  • Prior request required at least one week before examination date
  • Candidate may opt for own scribe or request Centre Superintendent for same
  • No provision of Test Booklets in Braille for visually impaired candidates

Examination Conduct

  • Medium of question papers: English and Hindi only (except for language papers, Computer Science and Environment Sciences)
  • In case of ambiguity in translation, English version shall be final
  • Syllabus available on HPPSC website and UGC website (covering entire contents including all electives)
  • No change of examination centre allowed
  • HPPSC may change date/examination centre without assigning reason
  • No TA/DA will be paid to candidates
  • Use of calculators, Log Tables, mobile phones, pagers, electronic devices not permitted
  • Candidate not appearing in Paper-I will not be permitted for Paper-II
  • Candidates not allowed to leave examination hall till expiry of full allotted time
  • OMR Answer Sheets will be provided
  • Candidates allowed to take away Test Booklets of both papers after examination

Any other document(s) in support of your candidature.

Please note that mere submission of documents does not qualify a candidate for an interview. All candidates who submit online applications will be eligible for document scrutiny and verification process. Upon successful completion of documents scrutiny only eligible candidates will be allowed to appear in Interview.

In case your claim is not established from the proofs submitted by you; your application is liable to be rejected. Please check your claims and certificates submitted by you carefully.
