General Information / Instructions

  • Applicants are advised to update their one time registration before filling the application form.
  • The application form together with instructions for filling up the application forms will be available on the website of the commission from 05.01.2026.
  • Applicants are advised to go through the instructions and all the eligibility conditions prescribed for the post, before filling up the online application form.
  • Last date for filling up of online application form complete in all respects (including uploading of the requisite documents) alongwith the requisite fee (online mode only) is 04.02.2026.
  • The last date for receipt of online applications provided in the notification shall be the cut-off date for determining the eligibility as regards acquisition of educational / professional qualification or any other certificate on the basis of which any reservation is claimed, notwithstanding any extension in the last date of submission of applications.
  • The minimum and maximum age will however be reckoned with reference to 1st january, 2025.
  • Applicants can edit some of the fields in their online application form w.E.F 05.02.2026 to 07.02.2026. Instructions in this regard will be separately made available on the website.
  • Applicants are required to upload all the mandatory prescribed/requisite documents alongwith the online application form.
  • An applicant seeking consideration under any reserved category must ensure that he/she possesses the requisite category certificate valid on the cut off date and the same is required to be uploaded while submitting online application. It may be noted that no further opportunity to upload any document shall be provided after the cut off date and action under rules including rejection of application/candidature may be taken.
  • The certificate must be in the format prescribed in the rules as applicable.
  • Applicants will not be required to submit a hard copy of the online application form or any other documents to the commission at the time of filling up online application form.
  • The applicant will however be required to present/produce a downloaded copy of the online application form alongwith the original certificates at the time of document verification.
  • Applicants are advised in their own interest to submit online applications much before the closing date and not wait till the last date to avoid the possibility of disconnection/inability to pay fee or failure to login to the online application portal on account of heavy load on the website during the closing days.
  • An Applicant seeking his/her consideration under Reserved Categories must ensure that he/she possesses a valid Category certificate on the cut-off date in the format prescribed in Rules as applicable.
  • The candidature of the applicants will be provisional till the genuineness of the reserved Category certificate is verified by the Appointing Authority.
  • The Applicants may note that in case a claim for reservation is made on the basis of false/fake/fraudulent certificate, he/she shall be debarred from the examination(s) conducted by the J&K Public Service Commission, in addition to any other penal action as may be deemed appropriate.
  • Submission of multiple applications by way of prefixing Mr./Ms. or through generation of multiple User ID's or any other mode, followed by either non-payment of fee particulars or fee particulars (TID) of one application (RID) being mentioned against another application with a different RID would lead to rejection of the online application. The applicants who are submitting multiple applications should note that only the applications with higher Registration ID (RID) number shall be entertained by the Commission and fee paid against one RID shall not be adjusted against any other RID number. Besides a strict disciplinary action shall be taken including the cancellation of candidature and debarment for future examinations of J&K PSC will be taken against such applicants.
  • The application Form submitted without deposition of the fee, which gets substantiated through reflection of the same on the application form, shall be treated as incomplete and candidature of the said applicant shall be deemed to have been rejected without any notice. No representation against such rejection shall be entertained.

Candidates are advised that they should not furnish any particulars that are false or suppress any material information. A candidate who is, or has been, declared by the Commission, to be guilty of:

i. Seeking his/her candidature by any wrongful means, or

ii. impersonating, or

iii. procuring impersonation by any person, or

iv. submitting fabricated documents or documents which have been tampered with, or

v. making statements which are incorrect, or false or suppressing material information, or

vi. resorting to any other irregular or improper means in connection with his/her candidature for the selection, or

vii. using unfair means during the test, or

viii. writing irrelevant matter including obscene language or pornographic matter, in the script(s), or

ix. misbehaving in any other manner in the examination hall, or

x. harassing or doing bodily harm to the staff employed by the Commission for the conduct of their test, or any other candidate, or

xi. attempting to commit or, as the case may be, abetting the Commission of all or any of the acts specified in the foregoing clauses may, in addition to rendering himself/herself liable to criminal prosecution, shall be liable:

i. to be disqualified by the Commission from selection for which he/she is a candidate; and/or

ii. to be debarred either permanently or for a specified period:-

a) By the Commission from any examination or selection held by them;

b) By the Union Territory Government from any employment under them, and

c) if he/she is already in service under Government, disciplinary action can be taken against his/her under the appropriate rules.

How to Apply

  • a) Candidates are required to apply online through the website of the Commission i.e. http://www.jkpsc.nic.in. No other means/ mode of application shall be accepted.
  • b) Candidates are first required to go to the JKPSC website http://www.jkpsc.nic.in and click on the link "One Time Registration" or click on Login menu if they have already created their profile with the JK PSC.
  • c) After logging into their account, candidates are required to fill all the requisite fields of One Time Registration (OTR) i.e. personal information, contact information & educational qualification, service details etc.
  • d) The candidate shall also be required to upload the image of date stamped recent passport size colour photograph and signature. The photograph should not be taken earlier than 01.01.2025.
  • e) Size of the photograph (passport size) and signature must be between 10kB to 20kB in *.jpeg or *.jpg only.
  • f) After successful submission of all the details in the OTR account, check the eligibility conditions as mentioned in the advertisement notification before applying for the post.
  • g) On Clicking on the "show examination" a window will appear on the computer screen. Select the month of the advertisement notification for which candidate wants to apply, a link(s) for the post(s) will appear on the computer screen.
  • h) An "APPLY" button is shown against the respective post and the candidates will click on the APPLY button against the post he/she is eligible.
  • i) On clicking "APPLY" button, an instruction window will appear. Candidates should read instructions carefully before clicking on "APPLY" button at the bottom of the webpage.
  • j) On clicking "APPLY" button, the system will display all facts/particulars that a candidate may have mentioned while filling up the necessary fields of his/her OTR account. Candidate shall fill up the remaining required fields in the application form and accept the declaration thereof.
  • k) Once the candidate is satisfied about the correctness of the filled in details, then, he or she may click on "SUBMIT" button to finally push the data into server with successful submission report.
  • l) On successful submission of the basic details, the candidates will be required to pay the online fee and uploading of the documents, for final submission of the online application form.
  • m) Candidates can pay the requisite fee through online mode in the "SUBMITTED APPLICATIONS" menu in their account.
  • n) After successful payment of the fee, the fee status will get reflected on the Online Application form. Candidates can check the fee status by clicking on the Print Application Button in the submitted Applications menu in their JKPSC account. In case the payment status shows either "not submitted or under processing or status has not been reflected on the submitted application form", candidates(s) are advised to contact the JKPSC office at Solina Srinagar/ Resham Ghar Colony Jammu immediately for clarification. Further where the online fee is paid through other service providers the candidate must ensure that not only the amount of fee is debited from his/service provider's Account but also credited into the official account of JKPSC.
  • o) After successful submission of fee, the candidates will be required to upload requisite documents as specified in the advertisement/application form.
  • p) The candidate would be able to get the printout of his/her submitted application only after the payment of the requisite fee and uploading of requisite documents.
  • q) Please note that the above procedure is the only valid procedure for applying. No other mode of application or incomplete steps would be accepted and such applications would be rejected.

Qualifications

Applications from candidates found ineligible as per these criteria shall be summarily rejected, and such candidates shall have no entitlement or claim to appointment.

  • Upload recent passport size colour photograph and signature (clear and legible).
  • Pay the application fee through online mode viz. Net Banking, Credit or Debit cards.
  • Candidates are advised to submit online applications much before the closing date and not to wait till the last date.
  • After successful submission, candidates should take printout of the application form for future reference.
  • Do not submit hard copies of the online application form in the office of the Services Selection Board either in person or by post/email.
  • Candidates must carry two passport size recent colour photographs and a valid Photo-ID proof to the Examination Hall.
  • Download Admit Card from the official website about one week before the date of examination.
  • PwBD candidates opting for facility of Scribe must submit required documents as per Annexure-B and Annexure-C at the time of examination.

  • Essential Qualifications: Master degree with 60% marks and above in Physical Education/Sports Science or equivalent with 5 years of relevant experience in pay level 7/8 in any recognized Institutions and should have represented University/Institute at State/National level OR Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed) or equivalent with 60% marks and above with 7 years of relevant experience
  • Essential: Should have specialization in at least one sport such as Hockey, Athletics, Swimming, Football, Basketball, Badminton, etc.
  • Desirable: Preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination

Fire and Safety Officer (Level 8)

  • Essential Qualifications: Bachelor Degree with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA from recognized University/Institute
  • Essential Certification: A diploma/certification for at least one year duration in Fire and Safety Management/Fire Technology & Industrial Safety Management/Safety and Disasters management or equivalent
  • Essential Experience: 05 years experience in capacity of Supervisor or equivalent safety professional in Fire Fighting in Civil/Defence Fire Service department/Public Undertaking/CFTIs or in reputed private organisation
  • Essential: Must be able to handle fire arms with sound health and active habits
  • Desirable: Post Graduate Degree/Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety with 5 years relevant experience, valid driving license for LMVs

Senior Laboratory Officer (Level 8)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master Degree in Engineering/Science or equivalent in appropriate field with minimum 60% marks with 05 year relevant experience in Pay Matrix Level 6 OR Bachelor Degree (four years) in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 07 years relevant experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Science (Three years) with minimum 60% marks with 08 years relevant experience OR Three years Diploma in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 08 year relevant experience
  • Desirable: Proficiency in use of latest office automation tools and applications

Laboratory Officer (Level 6)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master Degree in Engineering/Science or equivalent in appropriate field with minimum 60% marks with 03 year relevant experience in Pay Matrix Level 4 OR Bachelor Degree (four years) in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 05 year relevant experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Science (Three years) with minimum 60% marks with 06 year relevant experience OR Three years Diploma in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 06 year relevant experience
  • Desirable: Proficiency in use of latest office automation tools and applications

Junior Section Officer (Level 6)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master Degree in any discipline from recognized university with 60% marks and above with 03 year experience in Administration/Accounts/Audit/Purchase etc. as Senior Assistant or equivalent in Pay Matrix Level 4 OR Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with 60% marks and above with 05 years experience in Administration/Accounts/Audit/Purchase etc as Senior Assistant or equivalent
  • Desirable: Preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination, Higher Degree/PG Diploma in relevant discipline like HR, Labor Laws, Financial Management, inter ICWA/CA, proficiency in use of latest office automation tools

Assistant Sports Officer (Level 6)

  • Essential Qualifications: Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed) or equivalent with 60% marks and above with 3 years of relevant experience in any recognized Institutions and should have represented University/Institute at State/National level
  • Essential: Should have specialization in at least one sport such as Hockey, Athletics, Swimming, Football, Basketball, Badminton, etc.
  • Desirable: Preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination, N.I.S Coaching Diploma holders and medal winners in inter University/national games, representation at international level, certificate from national/international federation recognized by GoI, at least 02 years experience in coaching at University level

Laboratory Assistant (Level 5)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master's Degree in Engineering/Science or equivalent in appropriate field with minimum 60% marks with 01 year relevant experience at Pay Matrix Level 2 OR Bachelor Degree (four years) in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 02 year relevant experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Science (Three years) with minimum 60% marks with 03 year relevant experience OR Three years Diploma in Engineering with minimum 60% marks with 03 year relevant experience
  • Desirable: Proficiency in use of latest office automation tools, applications and latest trade related softwares

Senior Assistant (Level 5)

  • Essential Qualifications: Master Degree in any discipline from recognized university with 60% marks and above with 01 year experience in Administration/Accounts/Audit/Purchase etc as Junior Assistant or equivalent in Pay Matrix Level 2 OR Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with 60% marks and above with 03 years experience in Administration/Accounts/Audit/Purchase etc. as Junior Assistant or equivalent
  • Desirable: Preference to those with at least 60% marks in all boards/University examination, proficiency in use of latest office automation tools and applications

Salary/Stipend

  • Group A Posts (Public Relations Officer, Assistant Registrar, Sports Officer): Level-10, Pay Matrix ₹56,100 - ₹177,500 per month
  • Group B Posts (Fire and Safety Officer, Senior Laboratory Officer): Level-8, Pay Matrix ₹47,600 - ₹151,100 per month
  • Group B Posts (Laboratory Officer, Junior Section Officer, Assistant Sports Officer): Level-6, Pay Matrix ₹35,400 - ₹112,400 per month
  • Group C Posts (Laboratory Assistant, Senior Assistant): Level-5, Pay Matrix ₹29,200 - ₹92,300 per month
  • Additional Benefits: Usual allowances at par with those admissible under IIT Jammu rules in corresponding Pay Scale as per 7th CPC

Age Limit (as on 03/02/2026)

  • Public Relations Officer: 45 years
  • Assistant Registrar: 45 years
  • Sports Officer: 45 years
  • Fire and Safety Officer: 40 years
  • Senior Laboratory Officer: 40 years
  • Laboratory Officer: 35 years
  • Junior Section Officer: 35 years
  • Assistant Sports Officer: 35 years
  • Laboratory Assistant: 33 years
  • Senior Assistant: 33 years
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 years against reserved posts only
  • Age Relaxation for OBC: 3 years against reserved posts only
  • Age Relaxation for PwD and Ex-Servicemen: As per Government of India norms
  • Age of Superannuation: 60 years

Application Fee

Category Fee Details
General/OBC/EWS Candidates (Group A) ₹1,000/- (₹800 application fee + ₹200 processing fee) - Inclusive of GST
General/OBC/EWS Candidates (Group B & C) ₹500/- (₹300 application fee + ₹200 processing fee) - Inclusive of GST
SC/ST/PwD/Women Candidates ₹200/- (Processing fee only) - Exempted from application fee
Payment Mode Online through link provided inside the portal
Refund Policy Fee once paid will not be refunded or re-adjusted under any circumstances

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 29/12/2025
Online Application Start Date 03/01/2026 (10:00 AM)
Online Application Last Date 03/02/2026 (05:00 PM)
Payment of Application Fee 03/01/2026 to 03/02/2026
NOC Submission (Through Proper Channel) Within 40 days of submitting online application

Selection Process

  • Institute will conduct a multistage assessment process for advertised positions
  • For Group A Posts: May include screening, written test, proficiency test, computer test, presentation and interviews as per requirement
  • For Group B & C Posts: May include screening, written test, proficiency test and computer test as per requirement
  • Each stage will be an elimination round, candidate must qualify each test to appear for next stage
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 50% individually in each stage, however final total qualifying marks shall be 60% of total marks
  • Relaxation/Concession to SC/ST/OBC candidates may be given as per Government of India rules
  • Institute reserves right to reduce or increase stages of recruitment
  • All stages may be conducted on same day without any prior notice
  • Final selection shall depend on merit over and above minimum level as determined by respective Selection Committee

General Information/Instructions

  • Online applications are invited from Indian Nationals only
  • Number of vacancies including those under reserved categories are provisional and may change depending on actual requirement
  • Reservation policy as per Government of India norms is followed
  • One post is reserved for PwD-VH/OH candidate on horizontal basis, one post reserved for PwD-HH candidate on horizontal basis, one post reserved for PwD-VH candidate on horizontal basis
  • Institute reserves right to select any candidate on contractual basis initially for period of 02 years extendable on year-to-year basis maximum upto 05 years
  • OBC (Non-creamy layer) certificate issued on or after 01/04/2025 shall only be considered
  • EWS certificate issued on or after 01/04/2025 shall only be considered
  • Institute reserves right NOT to fill any of post advertised without assigning any reason
  • All candidates irrespective of category may be considered against UR vacancies subject to fulfilment of eligibility criteria
  • Candidates should read carefully requisite minimum essential qualifications, age and eligibility, experience criteria before applying
  • Application once submitted online cannot be altered or resubmitted under any circumstances
  • Incomplete application will be summarily rejected
  • Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification
  • No hardcopy submission of online submitted application required at initial stage
  • Candidates shortlisted shall be required to produce printout of online completed and duly signed application along with all supporting educational and experience certificates duly self-attested
  • Persons serving in Government/Semi-Government/PSUs should submit NOC at time of written test/interview
  • Institute reserves right to verify antecedents and documents submitted by candidate at any stage of recruitment process
  • Decision of Institute in all matters relating to eligibility, written test, interview would be final and binding on all candidates
  • Appointment of selected candidates will be subject to their being found medically fit as per requirements of Institute

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply ONLINE only from 03 January 2026, 10:00 AM till 03 February 2026 upto 05:00 PM
  • Visit official application portal: https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in
  • Fill the online application form carefully with all required details
  • Upload all necessary documents including educational qualifications, experience certificates, category certificates, PwD certificate (if applicable)
  • Upload recent passport size photograph
  • Pay application fee online through link provided inside portal
  • Submit the application form and take printout for future reference
  • Keep printout of online application form for future reference
  • Candidates who desire to apply for more than one post should apply online separately for each post
  • Candidates shortlisted for written test/interview shall produce printout of online application along with all supporting documents in original at time of test/interview
  • No correspondence whatsoever will be entertained from candidates regarding conduct and result of interview
  • Candidates should visit Institute website and portal regularly for status updates in recruitment

JKPSC Medical Officer (Allopathic) Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Total
Medical Officer (Allopathic) 480

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications / Essential qualifications: MBBS or Possession of recognized Graduate Medical Qualification included in the first or second schedule or part-II of the 3rd Scheduled (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956. Holders of education qualifications included in part-II of the 3rd Scheduled should fulfill the conditions stipulated in sub-section (3) of section (13) of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956.

  • Pay Scale: Level-9 (52700-166700)

Age Limit

  • Open Merit (OM): 40 years (Not born after 01.01.2007, Not born before 01.01.1985)
  • PHC: 42 years (Not born after 01.01.2007, Not born before 01.01.1983)
  • SC/ST-1, ST-2, Backward areas, OBC, EWS, ALC/IB: 43 years (Not born after 01.01.2007, Not born before 01.01.1982)
  • In Service Candidate/Government: 40 years (Not born after 01.01.2007, Not born before 01.01.1985)

Application Fee

  • General Category: Rs.1200.00
  • Reserved Category: Rs 700.00
  • Physically Challenged Candidates: Nil

Important Dates

Date Type Date
Notification Date 31.12.2025
Start Date for Online Application 05.01.2026
Last Date for Online Application 04.02.2026
Edit Period for Application 05.02.2026 to 07.02.2026
Tentative Written Examination Date March, 2026

Selection Process

  • In pursuance of SRO No. 325 dated 12.07.2013 read with amendment made vide SRO No. 388 dated 10.09.2018, the candidates will be selected on the basis of written test comprising the Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
  • As far as possible the Multiple Choice Questions will be of the standard as have been prescribed for the National Entrance Eligible Test (NEET) for admission to PG courses.
  • The written examination (MCQ type) will be of two hours duration (120 minutes) having 100 questions.
  • There will be negative marking for incorrect answers (as detailed below) for all questions: a) There are four alternative for the answers to every question. For each question for which a wrong answer has been given by the candidate, one fourth (0.25) of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted as penalty. b) If a candidate gives more than one answer, it will be treated as a wrong answer even if one of the given answers happens to be correct and there will be same penalty as above for that question. c) If question is left blank i.e. no answer is given by the candidate, there will be no penalty for that question.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applicants Are Advised To Update Their One Time Registration Before Filling The Application Form.
  • The Application Form Together With Instructions For Filling Up The Application Forms Will Be Available On The Website Of The Commission From 05.01.2026.
  • Applicants Are Advised To Go Through The Instructions And All The Eligibility Conditions Prescribed For The Post, Before Filling Up The Online Application Form.
  • Last Date For Filling Up Of Online Application Form Complete In All Respects (Including Uploading Of The Requisite Documents) Alongwith The Requisite Fee (Online Mode Only) Is 04.02.2026.
  • The Last Date For Receipt Of Online Applications Provided In The Notification Shall Be The Cut-off Date For Determining The Eligibility As Regards Acquisition Of Educational / Professional Qualification Or Any Other Certificate On The Basis Of Which Any Reservation Is Claimed, Notwithstanding Any Extension In The Last Date Of Submission Of Applications.
  • The Minimum And Maximum Age Will However Be Reckoned With Reference To 1st January, 2025.
  • Applicants Can Edit Some Of The Fields In Their Online Application Form W.e.f 05.02.2026 To 07.02.2026. Instructions In This Regard Will Be Separately Made Available On The Website.
  • Applicants Are Required To Upload All The Mandatory Prescribed/requisite Documents Alongwith The Online Application Form.
  • An Applicant Seeking Consideration Under Any Reserved Category Must Ensure That He/she Possesses The Requisite Category Certificate Valid On The Cut Off Date And The Same Is Required To Be Uploaded While Submitting Online Application. It May Be Noted That No Further Opportunity To Upload Any Document Shall Be Provided After The Cut Off Date And Action Under Rules Including Rejection Of Application/candidature May Be Taken.
  • The Certificate Must Be In The Format Prescribed In The Rules As Applicable.
  • Applicants Will Not Be Required To Submit A Hard Copy Of The Online Application Form Or Any Other Documents To The Commission At The Time Of Filling Up Online Application Form.
  • The Applicant Will However Be Required To Present/produce A Downloaded Copy Of The Online Application Form Alongwith The Original Certificates At The Time Of Document Verification.
  • Applicants Are Advised In Their Own Interest To Submit Online Applications Much Before The Closing Date And Not Wait Till The Last Date To Avoid The Possibility Of Disconnection/inability To Pay Fee Or Failure To Login To The Online Application Portal On Account Of Heavy Load On The Website During The Closing Days.
  • Syllabus Is Available On The Website Of The Commission.
  • Tentatively The Written Examination Will Be Held In March, 2026.
  • The selected candidates shall not be permitted to continue their PG courses or tenure positions such as Senior Residency/ Registrars/Demonstrators. They will be given a one-time option to either accept the selection or continue with their ongoing PG/ tenure.
  • On appointment, the selected candidates shall have to serve mandatorily in peripheral and far-flung areas of the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir, in the interest of equitable healthcare delivery.
  • An Applicant seeking his/her consideration under Reserved Categories must ensure that he/she possesses a valid Category certificate on the cut-off date in the format prescribed in the J&K Reservation Rules - 2005.
  • The candidature of the applicants will be provisional till the genuineness of the reserved Category certificate is verified by the Appointing Authority.
  • The Applicants may note that in case a claim for reservation is made on the basis of false/fake/fraudulent certificate, he/she shall be debarred from the examination(s) conducted by the J&K Public Service Commission, in addition to any other penal action as may be deemed appropriate.
  • Horizontal reservation @4% will be provided to the persons with benchmark disability, in terms of Government Order No. 127 of 2020 dated 20.04.2020 read with G.O. No. 59-JK (SWD) of 2021 dated 15.04.2021.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply online through the website of the Commission i.e. https://www.jkpsc.nic.in. No other means/ mode of application shall be accepted.
  • Candidates are first required to go to the JKPSC website https://www.jkpsc.nic.in and click on the link "One Time Registration" or click on Login menu if they have already created their profile with the JK PSC.
  • After logging into their account, candidates are required to fill all the requisite fields of One Time Registration (OTR) i.e. personal information, contact information & educational qualification, service details etc.
  • The candidate shall also be required to upload the image of date stamped recent passport size color photograph and signature. The photograph should not be taken earlier than 01.01.2025.
  • Size of the photograph (passport size) and signature must be between 10kB to 20kB in *.jpeg or *.jpg only.
  • After successful submission of all the details in the OTR account, check the eligibility conditions as mentioned in the advertisement notification before applying for the post.
  • On Clicking on the "show examination" a window will appear on the computer screen. Select the month of the advertisement notification for which candidate wants to apply, a link(s) for the post(s) will appear on the computer screen.
  • An "APPLY" button is shown against the respective post and the candidates will click on the APPLY button against the post he/she is eligible.
  • On clicking "APPLY" button, an instruction window will appear. Candidates should read instructions carefully before clicking on "APPLY" button at the bottom of the webpage.
  • On clicking "APPLY" button, the system will display all facts/particulars that a candidate may have mentioned while filling up the necessary fields of his/her OTR account. Candidate shall fill up the remaining required fields in the application form and accept the declaration thereof.
  • Once the candidate is satisfied about the correctness of the filled in details, then, he or she may click on "SUBMIT" button to finally push the data into server with successful submission report.
  • On successful submission of the basic details, the candidates will be required to pay the online fee and uploading of the documents, for final submission of the online application form.
  • Candidates can pay the requisite fee through online mode in the "SUBMITTED APPLICATIONS" menu in their account.
  • After successful payment of the fee, the fee status will get reflected on the Online Application form. Candidates can check the fee status by clicking on the Print Application Button in the submitted Applications menu in their JKPSC account. In case the payment status shows either "not submitted or under processing or status has not been reflected on the submitted application form", candidates(s) are advised to contact the JKPSC office at Solina Srinagar/Resham Ghar Colony Jammu immediately for clarification. Further where the online fee is paid through other service providers the candidate must ensure that not only the amount of fee is debited from his/service provider's Account but also credited into the official account of JKPSC.
  • After successful submission of fee, the candidates will be required to upload requisite documents as specified in the advertisement/application form.
  • The candidate would be able to get the printout of his/her submitted application only after the payment of the requisite fee and uploading of requisite documents.
  • Please note that the above procedure is the only valid procedure for applying. No other mode of application or incomplete steps would be accepted and such applications would be rejected.

  • (h) Address proof (Passport/Ration Card/Voter Card/Driving Licence).
  • Candidates on selection are liable to be transferred anywhere across India including field services liability and not necessarily at the choice of location given at time of application.

    • If tie in graduation marks, higher age preference
  • Wait List:
    • Upto 50% of vacancies (State-category wise), minimum 3 candidates

  • Medium: Bilingual (English and Hindi) except English/Hindi language test

  • Biometric data (thumb impression) and photograph capture from Main Examination onwards
  • Pre-recruitment training for SC/ST/OBC/PWBD candidates (free, online mode) - request in application
  • Candidates reporting late after reporting time will not be permitted
  • Photo Identity Proof mandatory (PAN/Passport/Driving License/Voter Card/Aadhar/Employee ID etc.)
  • Ration Card and Learner's Driving License NOT valid ID proof
  • Female candidates who changed name after marriage must produce Gazette notification/marriage certificate/affidavit
  • Government/PSU employees need NOC at interview, proper discharge certificate before appointment
  • Calculators, mobile phones, bluetooth devices strictly prohibited in examination hall
  • Candidates appear at own cost and risk

  • NABARD may shift/cancel/add examination centers depending on response

Eligibility Criteria

  • Refer Official Notification

Important Dates

Date Type Date
Start date of submission of application form 01.01.2026
Closing date for receipt of application 30.01.2026

Selection Process

  • Applicants shall apply for the only one post from which he/she had superannuated. The application of the applicants applying for any other posts will not be considered.
  • Eligible applicants meeting the minimum eligibility criteria as specified under this notification will be assessed based on the specified parameters such as Physical Attendance and Annual Confidential Report (ACR) in the preceding three years of superannuation, excluding the year of superannuation except in case of employees who have superannuated on March 31st.
  • I. Physical Attendance - 15 Marks for 3 years (5 Marks per year) a) For above 90% of physical attendance in a year- 5 Marks, b) For 80% to 90% of physical attendance in a year - 3 Marks, c) For 70% to below 80% of physical attendance in a year - 2 Marks, d) For less than 70% of physical attendance in a year - 0(Zero) Marks
  • Note (b):- i. Physical Attendance would mean the actual attendance put in by an applicant employee excluding all forms of absence from work such as leave, sick etc. However, would include absence from duty by virtue of ‘on-duty’ approved on account of PME, VTC, other Training and release from duty on account of official tour/company events. ii. Percentage would be computed by taking the total number of days of working of the respective mine, including Sundays and holidays in a year, as denominator.
  • II. Annual Confidential Report (ACR) – 15 Marks for 3 years (5 Marks per year) a) For ‘Outstanding’/‘Excellent’ grade in a year- 5 Marks b) For ‘Very Good’ grade in a year- 3 Marks
  • Note (c):- i. ‘Year’ for the selection criteria mentioned above would mean a Financial Year for the calendar month of April to March. ii. The data of physical attendance and ACR earned will be taken from the official record of the employee concerned.
  • III. Other selection/eligibility criteria shall be as provided in the guidelines of CIL for availing the services of superannuated non-executive employees.
  • IV. In cases where more than one applicant secures equal marks for the post, the tie will be resolved by applying the following methods one after another: (i) Marks scored in the ACR (Higher grade will be given preference) (ii) Date of Birth (Younger will be given preference) (iii) Date of Appointment (Junior would be given preference)
  • V. Provisional merit panels of shortlisted applicants for different Posts, who are fulfilling the eligibility criteria, will be derived in the order of marks scored, after resolving tie as prescribed and by giving reservation as applicable.

General Information/Instructions

  • Before submitting the application, the applicant must ensure that he/ she fulfills all the eligibility criteria and other norms mentioned in this Notification. He/ she may cross check the information such as Date of Birth, Caste Category, Contact Details, and Qualifications etc. furnished in the application form before finally submitting the same. The basic details such as date of birth, date of appointment, date of superannuation, caste etc. will be considered as recorded in the service record of the candidate.
  • The decision of NCL management regarding eligibility criteria, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection to the post etc. shall be final and binding on all applicants. No correspondence will be entertained from the applicants found ineligible.
  • Applicants should carefully fill up their category (General/ SC/ ST/ OBC-(NCL) in their Application form.
  • All correspondences with the applicants shall be done either through Speed Post / Registered email id & Mobile number (as may be necessary) and all general information shall be provided through NCL website. Applicants are advised to check/ visit NCL website (www.nclcil.in) regularly for further updates.
  • NCL will not take any responsibility for the applicants not being able to submit their applications within the prescribed closing dates on account of any reasons.
  • Selected applicants could be posted in any of the Area/Unit/Hospital of NCL and transferred to other Area/Unit/Hospital of NCL during the engagement period.
  • No TA/ DA will be paid for joining on being selected.
  • NCL management reserves the right to modify/ alter/ restrict/ enlarge/ cancel the engagement process, and revise the number of vacancies, at its discretion without assigning any reasons whatsoever. The decision of the NCL management will be final and no appeal will be entertained in this regard.
  • Court of Jurisdiction for any dispute will be Honorable High Court of Jabalpur M.P.
  • Reservation of SC/ST/OBC (NCL) CENTRE LIST will be applicable as per Govt. of India rules and guidelines, notifications and amendments from time to time issued in this regard.
  • Applicant(s) who wish to be considered against reserved vacancies and seek other concessions applicable to the reserved categories must submit requisite certificate(s) issued by Competent Authority for availing such reservation.
  • SC/ ST/ OBC (NCL) applicants who are selected on their merit will not be adjusted against the reserved vacancies. Such applicant (s) will be accommodated against the un- reserved vacancies earmarked for UR category. The reserved vacancies will be filled up separately from amongst the eligible SC/ST/OBC (NCL) applicants.
  • Provisional offer of Engagement will be issued, subject to being found medically fit in the Company's Medical Examination (IME) as per the laid down Rules related to Medical Examination of CIL.
  • The candidates offered provisional offer of engagement shall have to report within 7 days from the date of receipt of the letter with all the original and valid educational and technical qualification certificates along with caste certificate, as applicable.
  • The initial engagement of the selected candidate would be for a period of one year from the date of joining subject to the upper age limit of 65 years as provided in the CIL guidelines. It is extendable for another term of one year subject to his performance during the initial term of engagement, medical fitness, mutual consent, norms and other terms and conditions stipulated in the guidelines of CIL mentioned above and also subject to the upper age limit of 65 years. In either case, the engagement period will be limited to the age of 65 years.
  • The engagement of a candidate on the selected post shall stand terminated automatically on the expiry of the initial period of engagement unless and otherwise it is extended for the second term as provided in this notification. In the event of extension for a second term, the engagement shall stand terminated automatically on the expiry of the second term so extended.
  • During the course of engagement, if it is found that the candidate is not fulfilling the eligibility criteria, in any respect, his/her offer of engagement shall be cancelled.
  • Remuneration, Deductions, Medical Facilities and Working Days, Hours of work, Leave, Holidays & Rest Days etc. shall be governed as per the guidelines of CIL issued vide CIL/C-5B/MP & IR/Non Ex./Guidelines/268 dated: 12/10/2020.

How to Apply

  • The interested applicants shall fill the prescribed application form by entering all the relevant details specified in the application form and submit By hand to the Office of the Staff Officer (HR) of the Concerned Area/Unit/Hospital from where the applicant has superannuated.

Eligibility Criteria for MP Apex Bank Recruitment 2026

Selection Process for MP Apex Bank Recruitment 2026

  • Selection will be based on Online Examination conducted by IBPS Mumbai
  • Online Examination will consist of 200 questions for 200 marks with 120 minutes duration
  • Examination subjects include:
    • Computer Knowledge: 40 questions (20 marks) - 20 minutes
    • Reasoning: 40 questions (50 marks) - 25 minutes
    • English Language: 40 questions (40 marks) - 25 minutes
    • General Awareness: 40 questions (40 marks) - 20 minutes
    • Quantitative Aptitude: 40 questions (50 marks) - 30 minutes
  • Question paper will be objective type multiple choice with 5 alternatives in both English and Hindi (except English Language test)
  • Negative marking: 0.25 marks will be deducted for every wrong answer
  • EWS candidates (MP domicile) will get 10% relaxation in cut-off marks
  • Merit list will be prepared based on total marks obtained in online examination
  • Waiting list will be prepared up to minimum 1 and maximum 50% of total vacant posts
  • Validity of merit list: One year from date of result publication
  • Document Verification for shortlisted candidates
  • Medical Examination
  • Final Selection based on consolidated marks of online examination

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates may apply for only ONE district bank and ONE post of their choice
  • Candidates cannot apply for multiple posts; latest application will be considered if applied more than once
  • Reservation procedure as per Government of Madhya Pradesh norms
  • Reserved category candidates can apply for unreserved posts but will not get age/fee relaxation benefits
  • OBC candidates must submit valid certificate (not from Creamy Layer) dated within one year before last date
  • Reservation and age relaxation benefits only for Madhya Pradesh domicile candidates
  • PwBD candidates must have minimum 40% disability to avail benefits
  • Probation period: 12 months (extendable up to 24 months maximum)
  • Minimum service tenure: 5 years from date of appointment
  • Candidates serving in Government/PSU must produce No Objection Certificate at document verification
  • Family members of Board of Directors of respective DCCBs are not eligible to apply
  • Character verification from Police department required within 90 days of joining
  • Medical fitness certificate mandatory before joining
  • Examination centres: Bhopal, Gwalior, Indore, Jabalpur, Sagar, Ujjain, Satna (Madhya Pradesh)
  • Candidates must select 4 examination centre preferences
  • Minimum 10 times applications required for each post to conduct examination
  • For persons with benchmark disabilities using scribe: 20 minutes compensatory time per hour
  • Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are not valid ID proofs
  • Jurisdiction for any litigation: Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh)

How to Apply for MP Apex Bank Recruitment 2026

  • Visit the official website: www.apexbankmp.bank.in
  • Click on "APPLY ONLINE" option
  • For new registration, click "Click here for New Registration"
  • Enter Name, Contact details, and Email ID to generate Provisional Registration Number and Password
  • Login using Provisional Registration Number and Password
  • Fill in the application form with correct details
  • Upload required documents:
    • Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm, 20-50 KB, JPG/JPEG format)
    • Signature with black ink (140×60 pixels, 10-20 KB)
    • Left thumb impression on white paper with black/blue ink (240×240 pixels, 20-50 KB)
    • Handwritten declaration in English on white paper with black ink (800×400 pixels, 50-100 KB)
  • Declaration text: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  • Validate and save your application
  • Preview the complete application form before final submission
  • Pay the application fee online (Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking/IMPS/Mobile Wallets)
  • Click on "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" button
  • Submit the application and take printout of e-Receipt and application form for future reference
  • Download call letter approximately 10 days before examination from the official website
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on interview.
  • If the number of candidates for the advertised post is less than 500, then based on the marks obtained in the qualifying examination, a total of 12 candidates will be invited for interview in the ratio of the total advertised posts 01, provided eligible candidates are available.
  • Full marks for interview are 100 and minimum passing marks are 41.
  • Final selection will be based on the merit of marks obtained in the interview.
  • If the number of candidates for the advertised post is more than 500, a written examination will be conducted.
  • Based on the marks obtained in the written examination, candidates 3 times the advertised posts in different categories/sub-categories and candidates with equal marks will be invited for interview.
  • Final selection will be based on the merit of the sum of marks obtained in written examination and interview.
  • In case of written examination, there will be no minimum passing marks for interview.

General Information / Instructions

  • The date of birth mentioned in the 10th (High School) mark sheet will be valid for age calculation. Therefore, candidates should mention the name, father's name and date of birth as mentioned in the said mark sheet in the online application form.
  • Applications will be accepted only online. Manual or postal applications will not be accepted.
  • Educational qualification and other qualifications like native/local resident, age, caste etc. must be acquired by the last date of online application 9 March 2026.
  • If the applicant applies even without fulfilling the mandatory educational qualifications/other qualifications mentioned in the advertisement and if it comes to the notice of the Commission at any stage that the applicant has applied without fulfilling the mandatory educational qualifications/other qualifications, then the applicant can be debarred from the Commission's examinations.
  • If the candidate gives wrong/false, erroneous information in the online application form in accordance with the advertisement issued by the Commission or makes more than one application, then on coming to the notice of the Commission at any stage of selection, his/her candidature will be canceled and he/she will be debarred from this examination and other examinations / legal action will be taken. The Commission will have full right. If the Commission asks for any document at any stage of the examination, it will be the responsibility of the candidate to provide them. For this, the candidate will not be able to present any court case.
  • The educational qualification / experience / desirable qualification and advertised vacancies reservation classification etc. mentioned for the posts advertised in the published advertisement has been published on the basis of the requisition of the department, in which the Commission has no role. Therefore, the candidates are directed that complaints received in the Commission in this regard will not be accepted. In this regard, the complainant candidates can send their complaint directly to that department.
  • Any amendments / instructions provided by the Government from time to time regarding selection / examination will be included in the selection result and the selection result will be declared. No objection in this regard will be valid.
  • If the Government makes amendments regarding recruitment rules, age, native resident, employment registration reservation, then after issuing amended information as the case may be, the final selection result will be declared in accordance with the instructions issued by the Government from time to time.
  • Even after the publication of the selection result, if any computer error / clerical error comes to notice, the Commission reserves the right to amend the selection result. The list of selected candidates and waiting list and documents of selected candidates will be sent to the concerned departments by the Commission. Appointment process will be done by the concerned departments of the Government. Candidates in the main list / waiting list should not correspond with the Commission regarding appointment.
  • After the recruitment advertisements published by the Commission, many candidates submit unnecessary complaints on factless grounds without any evidence / documents through any medium, such complaints will not be accepted.
  • The final selection result of the said advertisement will be subject to the final court decision of petition no. SLP 8764/2023, WP5596/2024 and other petitions related to OBC reservation. During the period when petitions related to OBC reservation are pending, the examination / selection result will be issued on the basis of main part 87% and provisional part 13% as per letter no. F 07-46/2021/A.P./One dated 29.09.2022 of General Administration Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh.
  • All necessary information, amendments in reference to the advertisement are made available on the Commission's website www.mppsc.mp.gov.in. Therefore, all candidates should regularly visit the Commission's website and take advantage of the available information. No action will be taken by the Commission regarding emails / correspondence / telephone messages received in this reference.
  • The Commission does not maintain educational qualification, caste certificate, native resident certificate and all other documents of the candidates. The Commission only matches the self-attested documents submitted by the candidates with the original documents at the time of interview. All documents of the candidates listed in the final selection result and waiting list are sent to the departments according to the selection list. The work of verification of documents is done by the department before appointment. Therefore, it is not possible to provide information about the candidates' documents by the Commission. Correspondence of any kind in this reference will not be accepted by the Commission. Applications received under the Right to Information in this reference will be transferred to the concerned departments.
  • Any unnecessary inquiries of candidates other than the published recruitment advertisement will not be accepted through any medium.
  • Necessary information and examination results in reference to the advertisement will be published only on the Commission's website www.mppsc.mp.gov.in. Information can be given by email and SMS on the E-mail Address and mobile number given by the candidate while filling the online application form if necessary. Candidates must mention their E-mail Address and mobile number at the marked place on the online application form for necessary information and keep visiting the Commission's website continuously.
  • The Commission's examination and selection system is fair and transparent. There is no possibility of any person defeating this system and benefiting any person. Therefore, if any person claims to benefit directly or through any other means, it is practically impossible. Therefore, do not fall into the trap of such person and immediately provide complete information about that person to the Commission so that appropriate action can be taken against such person. The name and address of the informant will be kept confidential.

How to Apply

Eligibility Criteria

  • Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel:
    • Practice in criminal law for at least 10 years.
    • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
    • Excellent understanding of criminal law and ethical duties of defence counsel.
    • Ability to work effectively and efficiently with others and lead the team.
    • Must have handled at least 30 criminal trials in Sessions Courts (relaxable in appropriate circumstances).
    • Knowledge of computer system preferable and capacity to manage the office.
  • Deputy Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel:
    • Practice in criminal law for at least 7 years.
    • Excellent understanding of criminal law and oral and written communication skills.
    • Skill in legal research and understanding of ethical duties of defence counsel.
    • Ability to work effectively and efficiently with others.
    • Must have handled at least 20 criminal trials in Sessions Courts (may be relaxed in exceptional circumstances).
    • IT knowledge with proficiency in work.
  • Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsel:
    • Practice in criminal law from 0 to 3 years.
    • Good oral and written communication skills.
    • Thorough understanding of ethical duties of defence counsel.
    • Ability to work effectively and efficiently with others.
    • Excellent writing and research skills.
    • IT knowledge with high proficiency in work.
  • Note: Qualifications may be reasonably relaxed in case of exceptional candidates or circumstances with approval of Executive Chairman, SLSA.

Salary / Stipend

  • Honorarium (Retainership fee) for Class-A towns (population more than 10 lakhs):
    • Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel: ₹ 70,000 to ₹ 1,00,000 per month.
    • Deputy Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel: ₹ 50,000 to ₹ 75,000 per month (each).
    • Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsel: ₹ 25,000 to ₹ 45,000 per month (each).
  • Honorarium for Class-B towns (population more than 2 lakhs but below 10 lakhs):
    • Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel: ₹ 65,000 to ₹ 80,000 per month.
    • Deputy Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel: ₹ 40,000 to ₹ 60,000 per month (each).
    • Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsel: ₹ 20,000 to ₹ 35,000 per month (each).
  • Honorarium for Class-C towns (population below 2 lakhs) or rest of the towns:
    • Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel: ₹ 60,000 to ₹ 70,000 per month.
    • Deputy Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel: ₹ 30,000 to ₹ 50,000 per month (each).
    • Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsel: ₹ 20,000 to ₹ 30,000 per month (each).

Application Fee

  • Not mentioned.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Last date for receipt of applications in concerned DLSA (by Speed Post / in person) 23/01/2026, 17:00 Hrs

Selection Process

  • Applications will be invited after due publicity and a fair, transparent and competitive selection process shall be adopted by DLSA under guidance of SLSA.
  • Legal Aid Defense Counsels shall be engaged on contract basis initially for two years with provision of yearly extension on satisfactory performance.
  • Performance of each human resource shall be assessed every six months by SLSA in consultation with concerned DLSA.
  • Selection of Chief, Deputy Chief and Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsels will be purely based on merit considering knowledge, skills, practice and experience.
  • Selection committee will be chaired by Principal District & Sessions Judge (Chairman, DLSA) with at least three senior judicial officers dealing mainly with criminal cases; final approval by Executive Chairman, SLSA.
  • After approval, engagement contract will be executed between Secretary, DLSA and the selected candidate.
  • Services of any counsel can be terminated without prior notice on grounds mentioned in the guidelines (breach of duty, pecuniary gain from legal aid seekers, conviction, political activity, unsatisfactory performance, etc.).

General Information / Instructions

  • Legal Aid Defense Counsel Offices deal exclusively with legal aided criminal matters from pre-arrest stage to appeal, including jail visits; panel lawyer system continues for civil matters and complainant cases.
  • Lawyers engaged as LADC will not be allowed to take any other private cases or retainership.
  • Personnel must follow prescribed Code of Ethics, including no conflict of interest, no disclosure of confidential information, no outside practice, and no acceptance of gifts or advantages.
  • Legal Aid Defense Counsel shall devote full time to LADC duties and not engage in private practice during term of employment.
  • Applications received after due date or sent to Rajasthan SLSA instead of the concerned DLSA will not be considered.
  • Applying for engagement as LADC does not create any right or assurance of selection.

How to Apply

  • Download the Scheme of engagement along with Application Form (Performa) from the official website of SLSA or from the Notice Board of concerned DLSA.
  • Fill the Application Form for Chief/Deputy/Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsel with recent passport size photo and required details.
  • Submit duly filled Application Form along with self-attested copies of required documents to the concerned DLSA through Speed Post or personally in the office of the Secretary, DLSA so as to reach on or before 23.01.2026, 17.00 Hrs.
  • No application should be sent to the office of Rajasthan State Legal Services Authority; all applications must be sent only to the Secretary of the concerned DLSA.

Reservation Policy:

  • 10% reservation shall be admissible to Economically Weaker Section of the State of Rajasthan.
  • Horizontal reservation of vacancies for women shall be 30% category-wise.
  • Out of the 30% reserved posts for women, 8% posts are reserved for widows and 2% for divorced women.
  • 2% reservation for Outstanding Sports Person (horizontal reservation).
  • Reservation for specially abled persons is also horizontal reservation.

Important Points:

  • The benefit of reserved posts of SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS is only admissible to bonafide residents of the State of Rajasthan.
  • Candidates of SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS of a State other than Rajasthan State/Union Territories shall be treated as candidates of General category.
  • According to judgment by Supreme Court and Rajasthan High Court, a woman of a State other than Rajasthan State who becomes bonafide resident of Rajasthan State after marriage, the benefit of reservation in SC/ST/OBC/MBC category shall not be allowed to her for public employment.
  • Married female candidates of BC/MBC are required to submit certificate on the basis of father's name, residence and income. Certificate on the basis of husband shall not be valid.
  • No candidate having more than two children on or after 01.04.2007 shall be eligible for appointment to the service.
  • Registration of marriage has been made compulsory for appointment in the services of state from 22.01.2006.

  • Candidates can save the data by selecting "SAVE & NEXT" tab and can complete it later.
  • Before completing the registration, candidates should click on the Preview tab to preview and verify the entire application form.
  • After verifying all details, click on 'Complete Registration'.
  • Click on the 'Payment' tab and proceed for payment through online mode (Credit/Debit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets).
  • After successful payment, an e-receipt will be generated. Take a printout of the e-receipt and online application form.
  • Candidates should upload:

    • Left thumb impression - Size: 20-50 KB, Dimensions: 240 x 240 pixels

  • All documents should be in JPG/JPEG format only.
  • After successful submission, take a printout of the application form for future reference.

Note:

  • Any change/modification may disqualify the candidate if details don't match with certificates.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Nursing Officer
    • B.Sc Nursing from a recognized university.
    • Registered with Indian Nursing Council with 2 years of experience post qualification.
    • OR 10+2 with Science stream (PCB) from a recognized institute.
    • Approved diploma in GNM Nursing from an institute recognized by Indian Nursing Council (as applicable).
    • Registered with Nursing Council (as applicable).
    • 3 years’ experience post essential qualification as Nurse.
    • Desirable: Working knowledge of computer applications.
  • Technician
    • B.Sc in Radiological Imaging Techniques from recognized institutes with 2 years’ experience post essential qualification as Radiographer.
    • OR Diploma in Radiological Imaging Techniques from recognized institutes with 3 years’ experience post essential qualification as Radiographer.
    • OR B.Sc in Emergency Medical Technology from recognized institutes with 2 years’ experience post essential qualification as Medical Technician.
    • Desirable: Experience in handling radiological equipment.
  • Data Entry Operator
    • Graduate with a Diploma in Computer Applications.
    • At least 2 years of relevant experience in health programme.
    • Working knowledge and experience in computer applications.

Salary/Stipend

  • Nursing Officer: Consolidated remuneration of ₹ 40,000/- per month.
  • Technician: Consolidated remuneration of ₹ 40,000/- per month.
  • Data Entry Operator: Consolidated remuneration of ₹ 30,000/- per month.
  • Emoluments are all-inclusive and subject to deduction of tax at source and other statutory deductions as applicable.
  • No annual increment or percentage increase during the contract period; no travelling or other allowances will be paid for joining the post.

Age Limit 

  • Upper age limit shall be determined as on the last date of receipt of applications.
  • Permissible relaxation of upper age limit for SC/ST: 5 years; OBC: 3 years; PwBD: 10 years; PwBD + OBC: 13 years; PwBD + SC/ST: 15 years.
  • Age relaxation of 5 years for personnel serving in Central/State Government and Autonomous Institutions and regular employees of AIIMS Jodhpur with three years’ regular service.
  • Additional relaxations for Ex-Servicemen, Central Government Civilian Employees and existing contractual/outsourced employees of AIIMS Jodhpur as per detailed conditions in the advertisement.

Application Fee

  • Candidates (except Female/SC/ST/Persons with Benchmark Disability candidates) are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 100/- (Rupees One Hundred only).
  • Payment must be made through Online Mode only via the payment gateway of AIIMS Jodhpur; transaction/processing fee, if any, is payable to the bank by the candidate.
  • Applications without the prescribed fee will not be considered and will be summarily rejected.
  • Application fee, once remitted, shall not be refunded under any circumstances, even if the application is rejected due to ineligibility.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Issue of Advertisement 16 January 2026
Start of Online Application 20 January 2026
Last Date for Online Application Submission 09 February 2026 up to 5:00 PM
Cut-off date for age and qualification Last date of submission of application (09 February 2026)

Selection Process

  • Only Indian citizens are eligible for the posts.
  • Candidates must apply online; incomplete or late applications will not be considered.
  • Candidates shortlisted for interview on the basis of information provided in online applications will be required to send self-attested copies of documents in support of their claims when demanded.
  • The competent authority reserves the right to conduct a screening test depending upon the number of applications received for a particular post.
  • Original documents will be verified at the time of interview; candidature is liable to be cancelled if any information is found false or eligibility conditions are not met.
  • Success in the examination/selection process confers no right of appointment unless the Government is satisfied about the candidate’s suitability in all respects.
  • AIIMS Jodhpur reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process, increase or decrease vacancies and change selection criteria without assigning reasons.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications can be submitted only in online mode through the official website of AIIMS Jodhpur; candidates should keep a copy of the online application and proof of fee payment.
  • Applicants must ensure that their photograph and signature are clearly visible in the online application; unclear images will lead to rejection.
  • Only the date of birth recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary Examination certificate will be accepted.
  • Reservation will be as per Government of India guidelines for SC, ST, OBC, EWS and PwBD candidates; valid certificates in prescribed format are mandatory.
  • OBC (NCL) certificates must be issued between 01.04.2025 and 31.03.2026 and must conform to DoPT formats; EWS certificates must be based on income of financial year 2024–2025 and issued between 01.04.2025 and 31.03.2026.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities must have disability of not less than 40% and produce disability certificate in prescribed format.
  • Candidates in Government/semi-Government/PSU service must produce No Objection Certificate at document verification and relieving certificate at the time of joining.
  • Canvassing of any kind will disqualify the candidate; candidates must not indulge in malpractices, tampering of documents or misbehavior during examinations/interviews.
  • The tenure of the contract shall be till March 2026 or until further extension as applicable; engagement is purely contractual and does not confer any right to regular appointment.
  • Either party may terminate the contract with one month’s notice or salary in lieu thereof; disciplinary violations, misconduct or non-performance may lead to termination without notice.
  • Contractual appointees must maintain confidentiality, avoid conflict of interest, and comply with CCS Conduct Rules and other institutional regulations.
  • All disputes will be subject to jurisdiction of Court of Law at Jodhpur.

How to Apply

  • Visit the official website of AIIMS Jodhpur and access the online application link available under the relevant recruitment advertisement.
  • Register and fill in the online application form carefully, ensuring that all eligibility conditions regarding age, qualification and experience are satisfied as on the closing date.
  • Upload recent photograph and signature in the prescribed format, ensuring they are clearly visible in the preview.
  • Pay the applicable application fee of Rs. 100/- (if not exempted) through the online payment gateway and retain the payment receipt/challan for record.
  • Submit the online application before the closing date and time; no physical copies of the application are to be sent to AIIMS Jodhpur at this stage.
  • Keep a printed copy of the online application and all supporting documents ready for submission/verification as and when called by AIIMS Jodhpur.

  • 2. Selected YP-I will be engaged in activities pertaining to survey, collection and compilation of field data/information for the assigned districts, collection of primary and secondary data from the study area, preparation of presentations and writing of reports.
  • 3. If the candidate intends to apply for more than one location, he/she should clearly mention the location name in the application form. They need not submit multiple applications. Initially, candidates will be placed in the respective district of study area. After completion of field work he/she has to report to CCPI at ICAR-NBSS&LUP, Regional Centre, Udaipur.
  • 4. Candidates are instructed to submit their application as per the attached proforma (annexure-I) on or before the deadline (25th January 2026), preferably through E-mail to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected].
  • 5. Shortlisted candidates will be intimated through E-mail and would bring their complete bio-data/curriculum vitae with one photograph and duly self-attested certificates and mark sheets (From Class X onwards) along with original certificates in support of qualification, age, experience certificate and no objection certificate from their current employer at the time of interview.
  • 6. Shortlisted candidates are required to report for verification of these documents at 10:00 AM on the date of interview which will be informed in due course. Please keep watching our web-site https://nbsslup.icar.gov.in/ and your e-mail regularly for any further updates/corrigendum/ Notifications in this regard.
  • 7. Shortlisted candidates whose near/distant relative(s) is an employee of the ICAR-NBSS&LUP, has to declare it and communicate this office as per format given below (Annexure-II). Such declaration must reach to the undersigned by post or through e-mail to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected] well before the date of interview. Candidates having no near/ distant relative(s) working at ICAR-NBSS&LUP will also furnish a declaration (format in Annexure-II) before the date of interview.
  • 8. No TA/DA will be borne by the Institute for the shortlisted candidates to attend the interview.
  • 9. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification and if shortlisted, the candidate will not be interviewed by the board.
  • 10. Selected candidates will not be entitled to claim for regular appointments/absorption either in this Institute or in ICAR. Non-maintenance of the discipline and failure to perform the assigned duties will make the YP-I liable for termination during the appointment period as per ICAR rules.
  • 11. In case of any disputes, it will be resolved in the jurisdiction of Udaipur court only.

How to Apply

  • Eligible candidates are requested to send their application in the enclosed proforma (Annexure-I) along with declaration form (Annexure-II) and scanned copy of the original documents through email to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected] by 25 January 2026.
  • Original documents will be verified at the time of interview. Therefore, shortlisted candidates will be required to carry their recent bio-data in the enclosed format along with original copies of the relevant documents.
  • If any candidate is found to have submitted false claims during screening or at later stage, their candidature will be summarily rejected.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be intimated through E-mail to appear the interview. The venue of the interview will be the ICAR-NBSS&LUP, Regional Centre, Udaipur - 313001 (Rajasthan).

Application Fee

Important Dates

Last Date 15 February 2026

Selection Process

  • RNU, DDK Dehradun/Prasar Bharati reserves the right to shortlist suitable candidates who apply for various categories of casual assignees based on relevant age, education, experience, and other criteria. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for skill tests/auditions/interviews.
  • RNU, DDK Dehradun/Prasar Bharati reserves the right to conduct any skill tests (written, interview, computer-based test, test through video conferencing, audition, screen test, etc.) in any format—such as multiple choice or descriptive for written exams, group discussion or one-on-one interviews, voice modulation tests, editing software proficiency, etc.—to assess the skills, suitability, and personality of the shortlisted candidates. No TA/DA will be paid to the shortlisted candidates who will be called for the skill tests/audition/interview.

General Information / Instructions

  • The empanelment process is being conducted to identify suitable candidates who may be engaged purely on a casual basis for performing specific assignments in RNU DDK Dehradun. The persons selected through empanelment process shall have no claim, either implicit or explicit, for absorption or regularization in RNU DDK Dehradun/Prasar Bharati.
  • Selection through the empanelment process does not guarantee assignments from RNU DDK Dehradun. Assignments will be provided to empanelled candidates by RNU DDK Dehradun on an ‘as and when required’ basis. Candidates cannot demand assignments as a right and will have no claim to receiving assignments from RNU DDK Dehradun/Prasar Bharati.
  • The empanelment shall commence from the date of issuance of the Doordarshan News order, as approved by the Director General, DD News, listing the names of selected candidates in various categories of casual assignees. If required, the performance of the assignees on the panel may be reviewed through a duly constituted committee.
  • Applicants are required to submit self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents demonstrating their compliance with age, experience, education and other criteria. Applications submitted without the necessary self-attested documents will be summarily rejected, and no further correspondence will be entertained regarding incomplete applications.
  • For determining the age, experience, and education criteria, relevant certificates shall be considered up to and including the date of issuance of this notification.
  • Candidates are requested to keep checking inbox/ spam/junk folders for any communication from email id : [email protected], [email protected].
  • The remuneration fee offered for selected candidates in empanelment process shall strictly follow the prevailing fee structure for casual assignees working in RNU, DD News.
  • If a candidate wishes to apply for multiple causal categories, a separate application form needs to be submitted.
  • Any attempt at canvassing or undue influence will result in the immediate disqualification of the candidate.
  • Director General, DD News, reserves the right to cancel the empanelment process at any time, without prior notice.

How to Apply

  • Candidates who are eligible and willing to adhere to the terms and conditions outlined above may submit their applications in the prescribed format (Annexure I-A), along with self-attested copies of all necessary documents, including certificates of educational qualifications, proof of age, experience certificates, and any other relevant documents. Applications should be addressed to the Head, Regional News Unit (RNU), Doordarshan Kendra, Post – Prasar Bharati Building, Near Rispana Bridge, Haridwar Bypass, Dehradun-248001, and sent by Speed Post only. The envelope must be clearly marked with the heading “Empanelment of (Name of the category) for RNU, DDK, Dehradun.”
  • Applications must be received by RNU, DDK Dehradun by 15th February 2026. Applications submitted in person, by hand, or by any other mode will not be accepted. RNU shall not be held responsible for any delays in postal delivery.
  • A separate detailed CV may also be submitted along with the prescribed application format (Annexure I-A), if candidates wish to provide additional information about their academic and professional skills and achievements. However, the prescribed application format (Annexure I-A) must be submitted without exception.

Eligibility Criteria for IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow 2026

Candidates must possess any of the following qualifications from a recognized university/board to apply for IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow position:

  • B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) or equivalent with GATE/NET qualified
  • M.E./M.Tech. in RF & Microwave Engineering/Communication Engineering/ECE or equivalent with GATE/NET qualified

Candidates must be Indian nationals only to apply for this position.

3. Preference

Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience.

Selection Process 

Candidates will be selected based on the following process:

  • Online Walk-in Interview – Candidates will appear for an interview conducted online.
  • Document Verification – Selected candidates will be required to submit original documents for verification.

Interview Details:

  • Date: 01-02-2026
  • Time: 10:00 AM
  • Mode: Online

Job Description for IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow 2026

The selected candidate will be responsible for:

  • Carry out research work on the project "Design Implementation of Orbital Angular Momentum Antennas with Extremely High Purity for Spectrum Efficiency Enhancement"
  • Demonstrate a good understanding of subjects such as Microwave Engineering, Antenna Theory, and RF Circuits
  • Work with RF simulators such as HFSS or CST
  • Contribute to the research objectives of the Telecom Centre of Excellence project

Salary/Stipend for IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow 2026

  • Emoluments: Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA (as per institute rules)
  • Duration: 1 Year (Extendable based on project requirements and performance)

How To Apply 

Eligible candidates can apply for IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Prepare your application with the following documents:
    • Application in plain paper with detailed CV including chronological discipline of degree/certificates obtained
    • Details of experience including research, industrial field, and others
    • Attested copies of degree/certificate and experience certificate
    • Proof of GATE/NET qualified certificate
  2. Send your application and all documents to the office of the Principal Investigator via email at: [email protected]
  3. Subject line should mention: "Application for Junior Research Fellow Position – SRIC/06"
  4. Ensure all documents are properly scanned and attached
  5. Wait for the interview call from the organization
  6. Appear for the online walk-in interview on 01-02-2026 at 10:00 AM
