Selection Process

  • Specialist Medical Officer (G & O/Pediatrician – full-time)
    • Full Marks: 100.
    • Academic: 100 (MBBS = 80; PG/DNB = 20, proportionate).
  • Medical Officer (GDMO/XVFC)
    • Full Marks: 100.
    • Academic: 100 (proportionate on MBBS marks).
  • Psychiatrist
    • Full Marks: 100.
    • Academic: 65 (PG Degree/Diploma in Psychiatry – proportionate).
    • Experience: 20 (2 marks per completed year).
    • Interview: 15.
  • Part-time Specialist Medical Officers (Medicine/Paediatrics/G & O/Ophthalmology)
    • Full Marks: 100.
    • Academic: 90 (MBBS = 60; PG/DNB/Diploma = 20).
    • Interview: 10.
  • Community Health Assistant (Urban)
    • Full Marks: 100.
    • Academic based on percentage of ANM/GNM marks (normalized as per formula in notice).
  • Multi Rehabilitation Worker
    • Full Marks: 100.
    • Academic, Experience & Interview (details in scoring table).
  • District Manager (Public Health)
    • Full Marks: 100.
    • Academic, Written Test, Computer Test & Interview.
  • Blood Bank Laboratory Technician
    • Written Test (MCQ/True-False): 70 marks
      • General Knowledge: 20.
      • Blood Banking Knowledge: 40.
      • Computer (MS Office, Internet): 10.
    • Academics: 10 marks (M.Sc/PGDMLT = 10; BMLT = 9; DMLT/DLT = 8).
    • Post-qualification Experience: 10 marks (M.Sc/BMLT/PGDMLT – 10 marks for ≥6 months; DMLT/DLT – 8 marks for ≥1 year).
    • Interview: 10 marks.
    • Shortlisting:
      • 1:30 ratio based on weighted educational and experience marks for document verification.
      • After verification, 1:20 for written test; post-written test, 1:10 for interview.

    • Academic: 30 (Secondary/Madhyamik = 15; Yoga-Naturopathy Certificate = 15; proportionate).
    • Experience: 10 (2 marks per completed year from recognized organization; max 10).
    • Demonstration: 10.
    • Interview: 10.

    • Final selection based on interview marks (10).

  • Engagement is purely contractual under NHM & AYUSH Mission, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal.

  • All essential qualifications must be completed by the last date of online application; experience counted only after obtaining required qualification.
  • Caste certificates (with OBC A/B clearly mentioned) and disability certificates must be issued by competent West Bengal authorities before last date of application; revalidated caste certificates to be produced during document verification.
  • No hard copy of application needs to be sent by post; candidates must retain printed copy of online registration form for document verification (without it, verification will not be conducted).
  • Online registration number must be preserved; employer will not provide it later.
  • Marks must be calculated excluding additional subjects; no rounding off; proportionate marks up to two decimal places will be considered.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for document verification/selection test/interview.
  • Applicants must regularly visit www.wbhealth.gov.in (Recruitment section) for updates, corrigendum and instructions.
  • The competent authority’s decision regarding recruitment is final and binding.

How to Apply

  • Visit Departmental Website: www.wbhealth.gov.in.
  • Navigate to “Recruitment” → “Online Recruitment” and select the relevant DH&FWS Jhargram notification.
  • Register online and fill the prescribed application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and experience details.
  • Upload required photograph and signature properly; applications with improper photo/signature are liable to be cancelled.
  • Pay the application fee (Rs. 100/- General; Rs. 50/- reserved) through online mode before midnight of 29/01/2026.
  • Complete final submission of the form by midnight of 30/01/2026.
  • Download and print the registration form from the “Application Print” link (to be produced at document verification).
  • Produce original documents and photocopies at document verification, written test and/or interview stages as instructed later.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications: Ph.D. in any branch of Life Sciences or Statistical Science or Computational Science or Genetic Epidemiological Science of relevance in Biomedical Genomics OR M.D or M.D./MTech. The candidate must have 03 years of post-Doctoral research experience with a track record of high-quality scientific publications.

The candidate must have 03 years of post-Doctoral research experience with a track record of high-quality scientific publications.
  • Desirable: Should have capability to conduct research independently in Cancer Biology/Genome Biology/Microbiology/ Infection & Immunity using Genomics as a central tool. The candidate should have documented expertise and publications in any of the following: Genome editing using human cells or any model organism, Chromosome biology, Infectious disease biology/Single cell/spatial genomics or imaging/microscopic techniques, translational capability, drug screening.
  • Experience: 03 years of post-Doctoral research experience with a track record of high-quality scientific publications.

Selection Process

  • Selection will be made by appropriate Selection Committee
  • NIBMG reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility standards/ criteria and /or to conduct a screening test, to restrict the number of candidates to be called for Personal Interview, if so required.
  • The decision of NIBMG regarding scrutiny of applications and shortlisting shall be final and binding. Appointment of selected candidates will be subject to their medical fitness in the Pre-Employment Medical Examination and as per GOI norms.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals of age 18 years and above are eligible to apply for NIBMG.
  • Before applying, the candidates should ensure that he/she fulfils the eligibility criteria and other norms mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Essential qualification should be recognized in India and from a recognized Institution or University.
  • The experience requirement specified should be the experience acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications required for the post. The traineeship period will not be counted as experience.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA or Letter Grade in a degree/diploma is awarded, its equivalent percentage of marks must be indicated in the application form as per norms adopted by the University/Institute.
  • All computations of age, qualification, experience etc. shall be as on the closing date of receipt of applications.
  • If any certificate etc. is issued in a language other than Hindi/English, Candidates are advised to submit a certified translation of the same in either Hindi or English at the time of the interview, if called for.
  • Applications that are not in conformity with the requirements indicated in the advertisement, incomplete applications, or necessary documents as prescribed or received after the last date of online application will be rejected.
  • Mere submission of Application, fulfilment of the minimum prescribed qualification and experience will not vest any right on a candidate for being called for the selection process. Candidature shall be considered valid only after receipt of the email with CV and work plan as indicated in the ‘How to Apply’ section by the last Date of application for the post. The decision of the Institute regarding the selection process shall be final and binding.
  • Selected Candidate is allowed to apply as PI/Co-PI for Research Grant/s to any of the National/International funding agencies.
  • Candidates working in Govt/ PSU/Autonomous Bodies are required to forward their application through proper channel or produce “No Objection Certificate” at the time of Interview.
  • NIBMG reserves the rights to cancel / restrict /enlarge/modify/alter the recruitment /selection process, if needed, without issuing any further notice or assigning any reason whatsoever.
  • DISQUALIFICATION OF CANDIDATE FOR APPOINTMENT TO THE SERVICE ON REGULAR BASIS OR ENGAGEMENT ON CONTRACT BASIS AT ANY POINT OF TIME IF THE PERSON has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living. or is having a spouse living, has entered in or contracted a marriage with any other person, whose character and antecedents have been objected by the Direct Magistrate & Collector, or whose identity has not been established by the Police.
  • REVOCATION OF APPOINTMENT can be done at any stage during the period (without notice) or during service (after the expiry of a period of 14 days from the issue of a show cause notice and the same received by the employee) if the appointed person at any stage before or after appointment has: I. Withheld information, given any false information, or provided false certificates/testimonials so as to secure an appointment through wrongful means or intent. II. lied under oath. III. has been convicted of a criminal offence under Criminal Procedure Code and awarded punishment under any of the provisions of Indian Penal Code. IV. indulged in activities which are prejudicial to the interests of the STATE.
  • For any further queries regarding the recruitment please send email to [email protected]. Candidates are required to add this email id in their address book in order to avoid any email communication gap.
  • Applications are liable to be rejected at any stage of recruitment /selection process or after joining , if any information provided by the candidate is not found to be in conformity with the eligibility criteria notified or if NIBMG comes across any evidence/knowledge that the qualification /experience/and any other particulars indicated in the application /other forms/formats are not recognized/false/misleading and /or amounts to suppression of information/particulars which should have been brought to the notice of NIBMG.
  • JURISDICTION OF THE COURT: In case of any dispute, the jurisdiction of High Court state of West Bengal shall be recognised.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • All information regarding this recruitment process will be made available in the Career Opportunity Section of NIBMG Website only. Applicants are advised to check the website periodically for important updates.

  • Project Engineer (MEP): BE/B.Tech (Civil/Electrical/Mechanical) with not less than 60% marks from recognised (AICTE) University.
  • Where percentage of marks is not awarded by the university but only CGPA/OGPA/CPI/DGPA is awarded, the same shall be converted into percentage in terms of conversion norms of the university.
  • Rounding off percentage will not be acceptable for considering eligibility; e.g. 59.99% will be treated as less than 60%.
  • Minimum 2 years of post-qualification work experience in MEP in Government organization/Public Sector Undertaking or Public Limited Company as Project Engineer or equivalent as on date of issue of the vacancy notification.
  • An in-depth understanding of MEP System is crucial, including expertise in HVAC components like air distribution and renewable energy systems, electrical systems such as power distribution, and plumbing knowledge for water system, storm drains, and gas piping.
  • Knowledge of tools like AutoCAD, Revit MEP software, MATLAB, and Simulink to create precise system designs and models.
  • Experience certificate issued by Public listed company having average annual turnover of Rs 500 Crore and above in last 3 Financial years (excluding current financial year), listed on National Stock Exchange or Bombay Stock Exchange, incorporated/registered at least 5 years prior to the date of issue of experience certificate, shall also be considered, provided the experience certificate has been issued by a person authorized by the Public listed company.

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: IDA Equivalent E1 grade Rs.40,000-1,40,000.
  • Basic Pay: Rs.40,000/- per month.
  • Pay and perks include Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance, Cafeteria of Allowances, House Rent Allowance, Consolidated Travelling Allowance, Provident Fund (employer's share) etc.
  • Other entitlements like mobile phone, laptop, sodexo etc. are as per the policy of the corporation.
  • Pay protection will be given to candidates working in IDA E1 grade as Project Engineer or equivalent in the relevant field.
  • PF, Income Tax and any other incidental recovery will be deducted from Gross Salary as per extant rules.
  • Medical facility as per the policy of the corporation.
  • Leave: 8 days Casual Leave per annum, 2 days Restricted Holidays per annum, 10 days sick leave for six months (like Half pay leave with provision for commutation), and 12 days special leave per annum.

Age Limit

  • The upper age should not exceed 30 years as on the date of issue of Vacancy Notification (05.01.2026).

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Issue of Vacancy Notification 05/01/2026
Last Date for Submission of Application by Mail 04/02/2026
Cut-off Date for Eligibility 05/01/2026

Selection Process

  • After preliminary screening of the applications received from candidates by mail, the eligible candidates will only be called for document verification and interaction.
  • In case of more number of eligible applications received, candidates equal to 5 times the notified vacancies will only be called for document verification and interaction based on their engineering marks and experience.
  • The candidate will be interviewed by a nominated Committee, and the selection will be finalized on merit based on the performance in the interview, qualification and post qualification experience gained by the candidate.
  • The candidate must qualify with minimum 60% marks in the personal interview.
  • The decision of the Nominated Committee of MRVC shall be final and binding.
  • A panel of standby candidates over and above requirement will be maintained as per merit as decided by MRVC, and such candidates may be engaged as per requirements of MRVC projects within the validity of panel.
  • The period of contract will be initially for a period of two years, extendable on yearly basis on satisfactory performance and mutual consent, and can be renewed as a fresh contract on year-to-year basis if required.
  • The posts notified are not regular establishment posts and the candidates shall not have right to claim for permanent absorption in MRVC.

General Information/Instructions

  • The candidates must bring with them original application, original certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopy in proof of photo identity, age, caste, educational qualification along with mark sheets of all semesters of Degree and experience on the date of document verification and interaction; formula of aggregate percentage calculation of Degree (CGPA/SGPA etc.) to be attached with application.
  • Candidate should bring one character certificate from Gazetted Officers/Executives Officers for certifying that he is bearing good moral character (not older than six months).
  • Incomplete or vague educational qualification will be invalid.
  • Even after contractual agreement, if any document/certificate/information is found incorrect or false in any scrutiny or verification, then the contractual service will be immediately terminated forthwith without assigning any reason and prior notice, besides legal action.
  • The Corporation reserves the right to cancel/restrict/curtail/enlarge the contract engagement process, if need so arises, without any prior notice and without assigning any reasons.
  • No train/bus fare/TA/DA shall be payable by the Corporation to the candidates for appearing document verification and interaction.
  • Selected candidate will have to pass prescribed medical examination before the contract is entered into, for fitness to perform the work awarded.
  • The selected candidates should be able to join at the project site within maximum 45 days after issuing of offer of appointment by MRVC; any deviation will be dealt with on case-to-case basis, based on the merits of the case.
  • The selected candidates will have to serve the Corporation for at least two years for which he/she should execute a Surety Bond of Rs.1 Lakh in favour of Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. on Rs.500/- stamp paper to serve the Company for two years.
  • The candidate should have sound health and before joining will have to undergo medical examination and produce the certificate of fitness for job issued by a doctor (at least MBBS).
  • The contract can be terminated on completion of last day of contract period or any extended period, on breach of any terms of contract, or on the last day of one month notice period of termination issued by either side or payment in lieu thereof.
  • Upon premature termination or expiration of contract, the contract appointee shall return to MRVC any property belonging to MRVC, tools and plants, documents, passwords or user IDs etc., and clear all advances or dues.
  • Selected candidates shall use electronic resources of MRVC in strict adherence to the policies and guidelines issued by MRVC, and misuse may result in termination of employment and legal action.

How to Apply

  • Duly filled in application should be sent to Senior Manager (HR), Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. by email on [email protected].
  • Last date for submission of application by mail is 04.02.2026.
  • The cut-off date for eligibility is 05.01.2026.
  • Applications should be complete in all respects and strictly as per the prescribed format (Annexure-I).
  • Applications not conforming to the prescribed format or having illegible/ambiguous certificates or without certificates or incomplete will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates employed with Government Departments/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies have to produce NOC at the time of document verification, failing which they would not be allowed to appear for document verification.
  • Mandatory documents to be attached with the filled application include: self-attested copies of certificate in proof of qualification (as per the qualification specified in Notification), self-attested copy of Proof of Date of Birth (SSLC/SSC Certificate/Birth Certificate), self-attested copy of Photo ID proof (Aadhar/Pan Card), self-attested copy of document regarding experience, last served and others, and character certificate from Gazetted Officer/Executive Officers for certifying that he/she is bearing good moral character (not older than six months).
  • Recommended documents include: self-attested copy of employment letter issued by previous as well as present employer, self-attested copy of Form 16 issued by previous/present employer, and self-attested document indicating Employees Provident Fund (EPF) Number/PF Number.

The Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) is inviting applications for the Scientific Officer positions through the OCES/DGFS 2026 recruitment. This prestigious program offers engineering graduates and science postgraduates the chance to join the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE) through two distinct training schemes: the one-year Orientation Course for Engineering Graduates and Science Postgraduates (OCES-2026) and the two-year DAE Graduate Fellowship Scheme for Engineering Graduates (DGFS-2026). Successful candidates will undergo intensive training, with a stipend of ₹74,000 per month during the training period. Upon appointment, they will be placed in Group-A posts with an attractive pay scale under the 7th CPC, totaling approximately ₹1,35,000 per month, along with various allowances.

This recruitment offers a unique opportunity to contribute to India's nuclear and atomic energy programs in various DAE units, such as BARC, IGCAR, and NPCIL. Candidates must meet specific educational qualifications, including a minimum of 60% marks in engineering or science degrees, and fulfill the age criteria (18 to 31 years). The selection process includes an online examination, GATE score-based shortlisting, and a final interview. Interested candidates can apply online from 22 December 2025 to 28 January 2026. This is an excellent opportunity for aspiring scientists to be part of a prestigious and impactful sector.

BARC OCES/DGFS Scientific Officers Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Scientific Officer (through DGFS) DGFS-2026: Two-year DAE Graduate Fellowship Scheme for Engineering Graduates Number of fellows not specified; DGFS fellowship awarded as per needs of DAE programmes to best performing candidates in OCES selection interview.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifying degrees and academic requirements for OCES/DGFS-2026 include B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc.(Engineering)/5-year Integrated M.Tech. in eligible engineering disciplines such as Civil, Chemical, Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Metallurgical Engineering with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks, as detailed in the notification.
  • Eligible science disciplines include M.Sc./Integrated M.Sc. in Physics, Chemistry, Biosciences, Geology and Geophysics with specified subject combinations at B.Sc. level and minimum 60% aggregate marks in qualifying degrees, as per the detailed discipline-wise criteria.
  • For screening based on GATE Score, candidates must have valid GATE-2024, GATE-2025 or GATE-2026 scores in the relevant GATE subjects/papers corresponding to their discipline as mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Only regular educational degrees obtained through full-time/on-campus mode are considered; degrees obtained through correspondence, distance education/learning, by research or part-time modes are not eligible.
  • Applicants must satisfy discipline-specific inclusion and exclusion of degree titles as listed, including ineligible specializations for each engineering and science discipline.
  • Candidates graduating in the academic year 2025-26 and awaiting final results may apply, subject to completion of all academic requirements for the qualifying degree before 31 July 2026 and submission of final marksheet by 31 December 2026 (for OCES) or as per DGFS institute requirement.
  • Applicants must be citizens of India and, for those working in Central/State Government units/PSUs/Aided Institutes, a No Objection Certificate from their organization must be produced at the time of selection interview.

Salary/Stipend

  • During training, OCES Trainee Scientific Officers and DGFS fellows are paid a stipend of ₹ 74,000/- per month.
  • OCES Trainee Scientific Officers receive a one-time book allowance of ₹ 30,000/- during the training period.
  • DGFS fellows are reimbursed tuition fee for the M.Tech. programme and receive a one-time contingency grant of ₹ 60,000/- per annum for two years, along with funding up to ₹ 4,00,000 under the BRNS fast track project scheme for project-related equipment/consumables.
  • On appointment, Scientific Officers are placed in Group-A post of Government of India in Level 10 of 7th CPC Pay Matrix with basic pay of ₹ 56,100/-; total monthly emoluments including dearness allowance, house rent allowance and transport allowance are approximately ₹ 1,35,000/- for those posted in Mumbai.
  • Additional allowances include leave travel concession by air (as per conditions), children’s education allowance, annual professional update allowance and Performance Related Incentive Scheme (PRIS) as per government norms, along with a comprehensive Contributory Health Service Scheme for employees and dependent family members.

Age Limit (as on 01-08-2026)

  • Minimum Age Limit: 18 years (Age as on August 1, 2026).
  • Maximum Age Limit for General Category: 26 years.
  • Maximum Age Limit for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 29 years.
  • Maximum Age Limit for SC/ST: 31 years.
  • Maximum Age Limit for Dependents of those who died in the riots of 1984: 31 years.
  • Maximum Age Limit for Persons domiciled in Kashmir Division of Jammu and Kashmir State from 01/01/1980 to 31/12/1989: 31 years.
  • Persons with physical disability with extent of disability 40% or more will be considered for age relaxation and may be permitted a scribe as per rules.

Application Fee

  • A non-refundable Application Fee of ₹ 500/- is chargeable from male applicants belonging to General and OBC categories.
  • Women candidates, transgender candidates, candidates belonging to SC/ST category, Dependents of Defence Personnel Killed in Action (DODPKIA) and physically challenged candidates are exempted from payment of Application Fee.

Selection Process

  • Selection to OCES/DGFS-2026 is a two-step process consisting of screening of candidates followed by a Selection Interview.
  • Screening for Selection Interview is conducted through two alternative channels: an online screening examination and GATE-score-based shortlisting.
  • The online screening examination is conducted in eight engineering OCES disciplines (codes 21-28) and five science OCES disciplines (codes 41-43, 45 and 46) at more than fifty cities across India.
  • Candidates meeting eligibility criteria with valid GATE-2024, GATE-2025 or GATE-2026 scores in prescribed papers may be screened in for Selection Interview on the basis of GATE scores.
  • Cut-off GATE scores for Screening Interview are decided after conclusion of the online exam, and candidates are advised to maximize their chances by availing both screening avenues.
  • Selection Interviews for shortlisted candidates in all disciplines except Geology and Geophysics are conducted at BARC Training School, Mumbai; interviews in Geology and Geophysics disciplines are held in Hyderabad.
  • Outstation applicants travelling for Selection Interview are eligible for reimbursement of to-and-fro AC-III tier normal train fare by shortest route or actual fare, whichever is less, upon submission of original tickets.
  • Final selection is solely on the basis of performance in Selection Interview, subject to medical fitness as determined by DAE doctors.

General Information/Instructions

  • OCES-2026 is a one-year Orientation Course conducted at BARC Training Schools at BARC, Mumbai and AMD, Hyderabad for engineering graduates and science postgraduates, leading to appointment as Scientific Officers in DAE units or Atomic Energy Regulatory Board upon successful completion.
  • DGFS-2026 is a two-year DAE Graduate Fellowship Scheme for engineering graduates who secure M.Tech. admission in designated DGFS institutes and specializations, and who perform well in OCES Selection Interviews.
  • On successful completion of OCES/DGFS training, Trainee Scientific Officers are posted as Scientific Officers in various DAE units such as BARC, IGCAR, RRCAT, VECC, HWB, NFC, BRIT, NPCIL, BHAVINI, AMD, UCIL, DCSEM and AERB, based on programme needs and trainee performance.
  • Selected candidates must execute an agreement and personal indemnity bond to serve DAE for at least three years after completion of training; the bond covers stipend, book allowance, tuition fee and contingency grants as applicable.
  • DAE strives to maintain gender balance and encourages women candidates to apply for OCES/DGFS-2026 programmes.
  • Only online applications are accepted, and applicants are advised to regularly visit the online application portal for important updates and information.
  • Records of applicants for BARC Training Schools OCES/DGFS-2026 programme will not be preserved beyond four months from the date of publication of the final selection result.
  • In all matters concerning OCES/DGFS-2026 recruitment, decisions of the competent authority in BARC, Mumbai are final and binding; disputes are subject to exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Mumbai, India.

How to Apply

  • Only online applications will be accepted for OCES/DGFS-2026 programme.
  • Candidates are required to visit the website https://www.barcocesexam.in during the period specified in the Important Dates table and submit the online application by following the instructions provided there.
  • Applicants should carefully read the Information Brochure and FAQs available on the online application portal before filling the online application form.
  • Candidates must enter accurate details regarding qualifying degree, discipline, GATE score (if applicable) and other required information as per the advertisement.
  • Candidates graduating in academic year 2025-26 and awaiting final results must ensure that all academic requirements for award of qualifying degree are completed before 31 July 2026 and provide necessary certificates at the time of joining.

Eligibility Criteria

Scientific Assistant/B (Civil)

  • Diploma in Civil Engineering with minimum 60% marks from MHRD, Govt. of India recognized institution
  • Diploma should be of 3 years duration after SSC/HSC OR 2 years through lateral entry after HSC approved by AICTE
  • English as one of the subjects either at SSC or HSC level examination
  • Candidates with Diploma through lateral entry after 10th (SSC) + ITI are not eligible

Category-I Stipendiary Trainee/Scientific Assistant (ST/SA) - Engineering Diploma Holders

  • Mechanical: Diploma in Mechanical/Production/Automobile Engineering with minimum 60% marks
  • Instrumentation: Diploma in Instrumentation/Instrumentation & Control with minimum 60% marks
  • Electrical: Diploma in Electrical Engineering with minimum 60% marks
  • Electronics: Diploma in Electronics/Digital Electronics/Electronics & Tele-communication/Electronics & Computer/Industrial Electronics/Electronics & Communication Engineering with minimum 60% marks
  • Diploma should be of 3 years duration after SSC/HSC OR 2 years through lateral entry after HSC approved by AICTE
  • English as one of the subjects either at SSC or HSC level

Category-I Stipendiary Trainee/Scientific Assistant (ST/SA) - Health Physics (Science Graduates)

  • B.Sc. with minimum 60% marks with Physics as principal and Chemistry/Mathematics/Statistics/Electronics & Computer Science as subsidiary
  • OR B.Sc. with Chemistry as principal and Physics/Mathematics/Statistics/Electronics & Computer Science as subsidiary
  • OR B.Sc. with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics as subjects with equal weightage
  • Mathematics at HSC (10+2) level is essential
  • English as one of the subjects either at SSC or HSC level
  • Candidates with Mathematics as principal subject at B.Sc. are not eligible

Category-II Stipendiary Trainee (ST/TN) - Maintainer (Fitter, Turner, Instrument Mechanic, Machinist, Electronic Mechanic, Mason)

  • SSC (10th) with minimum 50% marks in Science subject(s) and Mathematics individually
  • 2 years ITI certificate in relevant trade (Electronic Mechanic/Machinist/Fitter/Turner/Instrument Mechanic/Mason)
  • For trades where ITI course duration is less than 2 years, minimum 1 year relevant working experience required after course completion
  • English as one of the subjects at SSC level
  • One year apprenticeship training after 1 year ITI course shall be considered as one year experience
  • Period of internship will not be counted as experience

Category-II Stipendiary Trainee (ST/TN) - Plant Operator

  • HSC (10+2) or ISC in Science stream (Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate
  • English as one of the subjects at SSC level
  • Relaxation for Project Affected Persons (PAPs): HSC with minimum 40% marks in Science stream with Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and English

  • HSC (10+2) with minimum 60% marks in Science
  • 1 year Medical Radiography/X-Ray Technique Trade Certificate
  • Minimum 2 years relevant post-qualification full-time work experience

Selection Process

For Scientific Assistant/B (Civil) and Category-I Stipendiary Trainee/Scientific Assistant (ST/SA)

  • Stage-1: Online Test (Computer Based Test - CBT)
    • Duration: 1.5 hours (90 minutes)
    • Total Questions: 50 Multiple Choice Questions
    • Maximum Marks: 100 (2 marks for each correct answer, 0.5 negative marking)
    • Syllabus: Questions pertaining to respective discipline (subject knowledge)
    • Qualifying Marks: 40% (UR), 30% (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD)
  • Stage-2: Personal Interview
    • Total Marks: 100
    • Qualifying Marks: 40% (UR), 30% (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD)
    • Shortlisting: 5 times the number of vacancies
  • Final Selection: Based on overall performance in Online Test and Personal Interview (Weightage 50:50)

For Category-II Stipendiary Trainee (ST/TN) - Operator & Maintainer

  • Stage-1: Preliminary Test (Online - CBT)
    • Duration: 1 hour
    • Total Questions: 50 MCQs (Mathematics: 20, Science: 20, General Awareness: 10)
    • Maximum Marks: 150 (3 marks for correct, 1 negative marking)
    • Qualifying Marks: 40% (UR), 30% (Reserved categories)
  • Stage-2: Advanced Test (Online - CBT)
    • Duration: 2 hours
    • Total Questions: 50 MCQs related to academic/professional/technical qualification
    • Maximum Marks: 150 (3 marks for correct, 1 negative marking)
    • Qualifying Marks: 30% (UR), 20% (Reserved categories)
  • Stage-3: Document Verification/Physical Standard Examination
    • Shortlisting: 3 times the number of vacancies based on Stage-2 marks
  • Both Stage-1 and Stage-2 will be conducted on the same day without any break
  • Stage-2 will be evaluated only if candidate qualifies Stage-1

For X-Ray Technician (Technician-C)

  • Stage-1: Preliminary Test (Same as Category-II ST/TN)
  • Stage-2: Advanced Test (Same as Category-II ST/TN)
  • Stage-3: Document Verification and Skill Test
    • Shortlisting: 5 times the number of vacancies
    • Skill Test: Qualifying nature only (Go/No Go basis)
    • Qualifying Marks for Skill Test: 50% (UR), 40% (Reserved categories)

For Assistant Grade-1 (HR/F&A/C&MM)

  • Stage-1: Preliminary Test (Online - CBT)
    • Duration: 1 hour
    • Total Questions: 50 MCQs (General Knowledge: 25, Computer Knowledge: 15, English: 10)
    • Maximum Marks: 150 (3 marks for correct, 1 negative marking)
    • Qualifying Marks: 40% (UR), 30% (Reserved categories)
  • Stage-2: Advanced Test (Online - CBT)
    • Duration: 2 hours
    • Total Questions: 50 MCQs (Quantitative Aptitude: 25, Critical Reasoning: 25)
    • Maximum Marks: 150 (3 marks for correct, 1 negative marking)
    • Qualifying Marks: 30% (UR), 20% (Reserved categories)
  • Stage-3: Document Verification
    • Shortlisting: 3 times the number of vacancies based on Stage-2 marks
  • On selection, candidates will be placed on probation for 1 year
  • Typing Test @ 30 words per minute required after first 6 months
  • 15 days Computer Proficiency Training during probation

General Instructions

  • Online Test will be trilingual (Marathi, Hindi & English) for all posts
  • Candidate must qualify at each stage for final empanelment
  • Tests may be conducted in single/multiple sessions depending on logistics

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals aged 18 years and above are eligible (21 years for Assistant Grade-1 posts)
  • Candidates must ensure they fulfill all eligibility criteria before applying
  • Candidature may be cancelled at any stage if found ineligible
  • For multiple posts, separate applications with separate fees required
  • Only latest application will be considered in case of multiple applications for same post
  • Cut-off date for age, qualification and experience is 04/02/2026
  • Only post-qualification experience will be considered; internship period not counted
  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates must clearly indicate category and submit certificates in prescribed format
  • OBC candidates belonging to Creamy Layer not entitled for any relaxation
  • Category once filled cannot be changed later
  • All prescribed essential qualifications should be full-time, regular from recognized University/Institution
  • Distance learning, part-time, private, open schooling/NIOS qualifications not considered
  • Prescribed essential qualification is mandatory; higher qualification alone doesn't make candidate eligible
  • Percentage of marks calculated without rounding off (59.99% will be treated as 59%)
  • Candidates must have passed qualifying examination on or before 04/02/2026

  • Candidates whose writing speed is adversely affected permanently for any reason can use their own scribe at their cost during the examination. In all such cases where a scribe is used, the following rules will apply:
  • • The candidate will have to arrange his/her own scribe at his/her own cost.
  • • The scribe arranged by the candidate should not be a candidate for the same examination. If violation of the above is detected at any stage of the process, candidature of both the candidate and the scribe will be cancelled. Candidates eligible for and who wish to use the services of a scribe in the examination should invariably carefully indicate the same in the online application form. Any subsequent request may not be favourably entertained.
  • • A person acting as a scribe for one candidate cannot be a scribe for another candidate.
  • • The scribe may be from any academic stream.
  • • Both the candidate as well as scribe will have to give a suitable undertaking confirming that the scribe fulfils all the stipulated eligibility criteria for a scribe mentioned above. Further in case it later transpires that he/she did not fulfil any laid down eligibility criteria or suppressed material facts the candidature of the applicant will stand cancelled, irrespective of the result of the examination.
  • • Those candidates who use a scribe shall be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour of the examination or as otherwise advised.
  • • Scribe should not answer on his/her own. Any such behaviour observed will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • • Only candidates registered for compensatory time will be allowed such concessions since compensatory time given to candidates shall be system based, it shall not be possible for the test conducting agency to allow such time if he / she is not registered for the same. Candidates not registered for compensatory time shall not be allowed such concessions.
  • • During the exam, at any stage, if it is found that scribe is independently answering the questions, the exam session will be terminated, and candidate’s candidature will be cancelled. The candidature of such candidates using the services of a scribe will also be cancelled if it is reported after the examination by the test administrator personnel that the scribe independently answered the questions.
  • A compensatory time of twenty minutes per hour or otherwise advised shall be permitted for the candidates with locomotor disability and cerebral palsy where dominant (writing) extremity is affected to the extent of slowing the performance of function (minimum of 40% impairment).
  • Visually Impaired candidates (who suffer from not less than 40% of disability) may opt to view the contents of the test in magnified font and all such candidates will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour or otherwise advised of examination.
  • These guidelines are subject to change in terms of GoI guidelines/ clarifications, if any, from time to time.

How to Apply

  • Candidates need to apply online only from January 26, 2026, up to February 15, 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Scan their: Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm), Signature (with black ink), Left thumb impression (on white paper with black or blue ink), A handwritten declaration (on a white paper with black ink) (text given below), The consolidated Mark Sheets of Graduation and Post-Graduation, Graduation and Post-Graduation Degree, Caste Certificate (if applicable) Ensuring that all these scanned documents adhere to the required specifications as given in this Advertisement.
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted.
  • The left thumb impression should be properly scanned and not smudged. (If a candidate is not having left thumb, he/she may use his/ her right thumb for applying.)
  • The text for the handwritten declaration is as follows – “I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.”
  • The above-mentioned handwritten declaration has to be in the candidate’s handwriting and in English only. If it is written and uploaded by anybody else or in any other language, the application will be considered as invalid.
  • Keep the necessary details/documents ready to make Online Payment of the requisite application fee/ intimation charges.
  • Have a valid personal email ID and mobile no., which should be kept active till the completion of this Recruitment Process. Bank may send intimation to download call letters for the Examination etc. through the mentioned e-mail ID and / or SMS. In case a candidate does not have a valid personal e-mail ID, he/she should create his/her new e-mail ID and mobile no. before applying on-line and must maintain that email account and mobile number.
  • Candidates to visit Online Application and click on the option "APPLY ONLINE" which will open a new screen.
  • To register, choose the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the Provisional Registration Number and Password. An Email & SMS indicating the Provisional Registration number and Password will also be sent.
  • In case the candidate is unable to complete the application form in one go, he / she can save the data already entered by choosing "SAVE AND NEXT" tab. Prior to submission of the online application, candidates are advised to use the "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to verify the details in the online application form and modify the same if required. Visually Impaired candidates should fill the application form carefully and verify/ get the details verified to ensure that the same are correct prior to final submission.
  • Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/ entertained after clicking the COMPLETE REGISTRATION BUTTON.
  • The Name of the candidate or his /her father/ Husband etc. should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the Certificates/ Mark sheets/Identity proof. Any change/alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Validate your details and save your application by clicking the 'Validate your details' and 'Save & Next' button.
  • Candidates can proceed to upload Photo & Signature as per the specifications given in the Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Photograph and Signature detailed under point "C".
  • Candidates can proceed to fill other details of the Application Form.
  • Click on the Preview Tab to preview and verify the entire application form before COMPLETE REGISTRATION.
  • Modify details, if required, and click on 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' ONLY after verifying and ensuring that the photograph, signature uploaded and other details filled by you are correct.
  • Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment.
  • Click on 'Submit' button.
  • The application form is integrated with the payment gateway and the payment process can be completed by following the instructions.
  • The payment can be made by using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/ Mobile Wallets.
  • After submitting your payment information in the online application form, PLEASE WAIT FOR THE INTIMATION FROM THE SERVER. DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH BUTTON IN ORDER TO AVOID DOUBLE CHARGE.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, an e-Receipt will be generated.
  • Non-generation of 'E-Receipt' indicates PAYMENT FAILURE. On failure of payment, Candidates are advised to login again using their Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the process of payment.
  • Candidates are required to take a printout of the e-Receipt and online Application Form containing fee details. Please note that if the same cannot be generated, online transaction may not have been successful.
  • For Credit Card users: All charges are listed in Indian Rupee. If you use a non-Indian credit card, your bank will convert to your local currency based on prevailing exchange rates.
  • To ensure the security of your data, please close the browser window once your transaction is completed.
  • There is facility to print application form containing fee details after payment of fees.
  • While filling in the Online Application Form the candidate will be provided with separate links for uploading Photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
  • Click on the respective link “Upload Photograph / signature / Upload left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant documents”.
  • Browse and select the location where the Scanned Photograph / signature / left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant document’s file has been saved.
  • Select the file by clicking on it
  • Click the ‘Open/Upload’
  • If the file size and format are not as prescribed, an error message will be displayed.
  • Preview of the uploaded image will help to see the quality of the image. In case of unclear / smudged, the same may be re-uploaded to the expected clarity /quality.

Eligibility Criteria

  • For Project Engineer (RF&MW, Electronics/EXTC):
    • Bachelor Degree in Engineering or Technology (B.E. or B.Tech.) in Electronics & Telecommunications, Electronics, Instrumentation & Controls, Microwave from recognized University
    • Minimum 55% marks required
  • For Project Engineer (CS/IT):
    • Bachelor Degree in Engineering or Technology (B.E. or B.Tech.) in Computer Science/Information Technology from recognized University
    • Minimum 55% marks required
  • For Project Engineer (Safety):
    • B.E. or B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering with minimum 55% marks
    • Degree/PG Diploma in Industrial/Electrical Safety recognized by State/Central Govt as per industrial safety rules
  • For Project Engineer (Electrical):
    • B.E. or B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering from recognized University with minimum 55% marks
  • For Project Engineer (Electrical-HVAC):
    • B.E. or B.Tech. in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering with diploma in HVAC or relevant experience
    • Minimum 55% marks from recognized Institution/University
  • For Project Engineer (Mechanical):
    • B.E. or B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering with diploma in HVAC or relevant experience
    • Minimum 55% marks from recognized Institution/University
  • For Project Engineer (Civil Engineering):
    • B.E. or B.Tech. in Civil Engineering from recognized Institution/University with minimum 55% marks
  • For Project Associate (Electronics):
    • Master's Degree in Engineering or Technology (ME or M.Tech) in Electronics & Telecommunications, Electronics, Instrumentation & Controls, Microwave
    • Minimum 55% marks from recognized University
  • For Project Associate (Physics):
    • Master Degree in Science (MSc) Physics from recognized university OR
    • B.Tech. (Engineering Physics) from IIT/NIT with minimum 55% marks
  • For Project Associate (Atmospheric Science):
    • Master's degree in Science in Atmospheric Sciences/Space Science/Ocean Science/Meteorology/Climate Science/Geophysics (Meteorology)/Physics/Mathematics (specialized in computational applied mathematics) or equivalent with minimum 55% marks
    • Alternatively, Bachelor Degree in Engineering or Technology with specialization in above subjects
  • For Project Scientific Assistant (Electronics):
    • Diploma or Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) in Electronics/EXTC from recognized institution with minimum 55% marks
  • For Project Scientific Assistant (Medical Electronics):
    • Diploma in Biomedical Engineering/Medical Electronics from recognized institution with minimum 55% marks
  • For Project Scientific Assistant (Physics):
    • B.Sc. (Physics) from recognized university with minimum 55% marks
  • For Project Scientific Assistant (Electrical):
    • Diploma in Electrical Engineering from recognized institution with minimum 55% marks
  • For Project Scientific Assistant (Chemistry):
    • B.Sc. (Chemistry) from recognized university with minimum 55% marks
  • For Project Scientific Assistant (Mechanical):
    • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from recognized technical board with minimum 55% marks
  • For Project Technical Assistant (Electronics/Electronics-Mechanic):
    • ITI (Electronics/Electronics-Mechanic) from govt. affiliated board of technical/vocational education
    • NCTVT completed with minimum 55% marks
  • For Project Technical Assistant (Fitter):
    • ITI (Fitter) from govt. affiliated board and completed NCTVT with minimum 55% marks
  • For Project Technical Assistant (Electrician):
    • ITI (Electrician) from govt. affiliated board and completed NCTVT with minimum 55% marks
    • Valid "Government Electrician Supervisor License" required
  • For Project Technical Assistant (Electroplater):
    • ITI (Electroplater/Chemical) from recognised technical board with minimum 55% marks
  • For Project Technical Assistant (Turner):
    • ITI (Turner) from govt. affiliated board and completed NCTVT with minimum 55% marks
  • For Project Technical Assistant (Machinist):
    • ITI (Machinist) from govt. affiliated board and completed NCTVT with minimum 55% marks
  • Essential: Only candidates possessing prescribed degree/certificate with minimum 55% marks or equivalent CGPA awarded on or before closing date of application shall be eligible
  • Desirable: For Project Engineer positions, candidates who appeared in final examinations between April-July for concurrent academic year and awaiting results may apply subject to production of pass certificate at joining with 55% marks in all declared semesters

Salary/Stipend

  • Project Engineer / Project Associate: Rs. 34,000 per month (Consolidated Pay)
  • Project Scientific Assistant (A): Rs. 23,500 per month (Consolidated Pay)
  • Project Technical Assistant (A): Rs. 21,000 per month (Consolidated Pay)
  • Project Technical Assistant (B): Rs. 23,500 per month (Consolidated Pay)

  • No additional allowances or increments beyond prescribed consolidated remuneration

Age Limit (as on 25-01-2026)

    • Upper Age Limit: 28 years
    • Experience Required: NIL
  • For Project Scientific Assistant (A):
    • Upper Age Limit: 25 years
    • Experience Required: NIL
  • For Project Technical Assistant (A):
    • Upper Age Limit: 25 years
    • Experience Required: NIL

Application Fee

Important Dates

Event Date

Selection Process

  • Candidates will be selected through a multi-stage process
  • Stage 1 - Screening Test: Written Test/Interview/Skill Test (Online/Offline) will be conducted as per requirement for respective posts
  • Stage 2 - Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates will undergo document verification
  • Stage 3 - Personal Interview: Candidates shortlisted through screening test shall appear for personal interview
  • Date, time and venue shall be notified online at https://sameer.gov.in/recruitment
  • Final selection based on performance in interview conducted at venue mentioned in admit card
  • Selection purely on merit - mere possession of qualifications does not entitle candidates to be called for test/interview
  • Mere appearance in screening test, document verification or interview shall not confer any right to selection or appointment
  • Selection subject to fulfillment of all eligibility conditions and satisfactory performance at all stages
  • Panel of recommended candidates ordinarily valid for one year from date of interview/skill test or as decided by competent authority
  • Candidates must possess prescribed experience in relevant fields and produce documentary proof
  • Crucial date for reckoning experience: closing date of application
  • Experience acquired prior to obtaining essential qualification shall not be considered
  • Candidates who previously engaged with SAMEER as Research Scientist/PE/PA for aggregate 5+ years not eligible for PE/PA posts

General Information/Instructions

  • SAMEER is a premier RF & Microwave R&D Laboratory under Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India
  • It has 5 Centres across the country
  • Positions are at Mumbai/Navi-Mumbai location
  • Selected candidates may be posted at any project sites in the country as per requirement
  • These are contractual appointments for TWO YEARS or duration of project, whichever is less
  • Appointments shall not confer any right for regularization, absorption or continuation of service in SAMEER
  • Selected candidates shall have no claim or right for continuity of service or automatic extension of contractual term
  • No TA/DA admissible for appearing in screening test and/or interview
  • SAMEER reserves right to accept/reject any candidature at any stage without assigning reason
  • SAMEER reserves right to cancel, restrict, enlarge, modify or alter recruitment process without further notice
  • Candidates must ensure they fulfill all eligibility conditions for post applied
  • Furnishing false/incorrect information, suppressing material facts, or not meeting eligibility criteria will lead to candidature/service rejection/termination without notice
  • All original certificates required for verification at time of interview
  • Selected candidates liable to serve anywhere in the country
  • No right to claim accommodation - may be provided subject to availability on shared basis with monthly license fee and rental charges
  • Canvassing in any form or bringing influence treated as disqualification
  • No interim correspondence or queries shall be entertained
  • Applications of Indian citizens only shall be considered
  • Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/PwD categories must submit valid certificates issued by competent authority as per Government of India format
  • OBC candidates must submit valid Non-Creamy Layer Certificate
  • PwD candidates must submit valid Disability Certificate as per GoI norms
  • Failure to produce requisite certificates shall render candidature liable to rejection

How to Apply

  • Applications for all posts accepted ONLINE ONLY through website https://recruitment.sameer.gov.in
  • Apply up to midnight of 25-01-2026 (closing date)
  • Detailed instructions and deadlines available on the website
  • Candidates may edit application before final submission
  • Upon clicking "FINAL SUBMIT", PDF copy of application will be generated
  • Take printout of submitted application and produce at time of written test/interview along with all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies
  • No candidate permitted to appear for written test/interview without printout of online submitted application (PDF file)
  • Application form should NOT be sent by post
  • Candidates fulfilling prescribed qualifications can download Identity Card (Admit Card) through designated web link
  • Printed copy of admit card must be produced at time of screening test and interview

    • Qualifying exam marks for all years (as per post applied)
    • Experience certificate (duly signed and stamped) as applicable
    • Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL) if applicable
    • Disability Certificate (PwD) if applicable
    • One set of photocopy of all documents for submission with originals
  • Candidates advised to regularly visit https://sameer.gov.in/recruitment for updates

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification:

  • Minimum 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA in Graduation (minimum 3-year full time duration)
  • Post Graduation (MBA/PGDBA/PGDBM/MMS) with specialization in Finance/International Business/Foreign Trade OR Chartered Accountant (CA)

  • Candidates who have appeared for final examination in Post Graduation or Chartered Accountancy during January 2026 and expecting results in 2026 are eligible to apply

  • Candidates having completed graduation and postgraduation through correspondence/part-time/open university/open learning/external/distance learning are NOT eligible

Essential Skills:

  • Excellent communication skills
  • Proficiency in use of computers and information technology

Additional Requirements:

  • Candidates awaiting final results must produce necessary documents evidencing qualification by June 01, 2026 or joining date (whichever is later)
  • For Universities/Institutes awarding degrees based on CGPA/GPA, candidates must furnish conversion formula from Institute/Controller of Examination if percentage is not mentioned in mark sheet

  • Additional Benefits: Allowances, perquisites and benefits as applicable to the Grade as per Bank's rules

Selection Process

  • Written Examination: Professional Knowledge - Subjective (Total 100 marks, 2 hours 30 minutes duration)
    • Part I: Financial Statement - Question 1 (Compulsory) - 40 marks
    • Part II: Attempt any 6 out of 8 Questions - 60 marks
  • Examination will be conducted in Chennai, Kolkata, Mumbai, New Delhi and Guwahati
  • No sectional cut-off for written examination
  • Candidates shortlisted based on written test performance will be called for Personal Interview
  • Personal Interviews will be conducted in Mumbai and/or New Delhi
  • Final Selection: Based on overall performance in Written Examination (70% weightage out of 100 marks) and Interview (30% weightage out of 100 marks)
  • Pre-recruitment training will be organized for candidates from reserved categories (details will be intimated to opted candidates after registration closes)

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply
  • Applications must be submitted online only through the official link - no other mode will be accepted
  • Candidates should apply only if willing to serve anywhere in India
  • Selected candidates may be transferred to offices outside India with their consent
  • Management Trainees will be absorbed as Deputy Manager after successful completion of one-year training
  • Selected candidates must execute a personal bond for ₹3 lakh to serve the Bank for 1 year as Management Trainee and minimum 5 years as employee after absorption
  • Selected candidates already in service must produce proper relieving letter/discharge certificate in original at the time of joining
  • Reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) is available under Section 34 of "The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016"
  • One vacancy reserved for PwBD - Hearing impairment (horizontal reservation within overall 40 vacancies)
  • PwBD candidates must submit Disability Certificate issued by prescribed authority (minimum 40% disability)
  • EWS candidates must produce Income and Asset Certificate issued on or after 01/04/2025 and before document verification at interview
  • OBC candidates must provide Non-Creamy Layer certificate valid as on last date of application (issued within one year prior)
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification
  • Bank reserves the right to cancel/restrict/curtail/enlarge the recruitment process without notice
  • Any legal proceedings can be instituted only in Mumbai courts/tribunals/forums

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online only from January 17, 2026 to February 01, 2026
  • Visit the official website: www.eximbankindia.in/careers
  • Click on "APPLY ONLINE" option
  • For new registration, click "Click here for New Registration"
  • Enter Name, Contact details and Email-ID to generate Provisional Registration Number and Password
  • Complete the application form with all required details
  • Upload scanned documents as per specifications:
    • Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm, 200x230 pixels, 20-50 KB, JPG/JPEG format)
    • Signature (140x60 pixels, 10-20 KB, JPG/JPEG format)
    • Left thumb impression (240x240 pixels, 20-50 KB, JPG/JPEG format)
    • Handwritten declaration (800x400 pixels, 50-100 KB, JPG/JPEG format)
    • Consolidated Mark Sheets of Graduation and Post-Graduation (PDF, 20-500 KB)
    • Graduation and Post-Graduation Degree (PDF, 20-500 KB)
    • Caste Certificate if applicable (PDF, 20-500 KB)
  • Validate and save all details
  • Preview the entire application form before final submission
  • Click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" after verification

CSIR-NEERI Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Sr. No. Name of Position No. of Posts
1 Project Associate-I (PAT-I) 02 (anticipated up to 03)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Educational Qualification (Essential):
    • M.Sc. or Integrated Masters in Microbiology, Biotechnology, or Life Sciences from a recognized university.
  • Job Requirement:
    • Survey and field work.
    • Laboratory work related to the project.
    • Data analysis.
    • Hands-on work with molecular biology techniques.
    • Use of analytical techniques relevant to environmental and bio-based research.
  • Age:
    • Upper age limit: 35 years, reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications.
  • NET/GATE/National Exams for higher emoluments:
    • Higher emolument category (Rs. 31,000/- + HRA) is applicable to candidates who have qualified:
      • CSIR-UGC, ICAR, ICMR NET Lectureship/Assistant Professorship, or GATE, OR
      • National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT, DST, or equivalent and/or their agencies/institutions.
  • General eligibility conditions:
    • Only candidates who have acquired the essential qualification and whose result has been declared (with at least provisional degree certificate) are eligible.
    • Result awaited/final semester appearing/Ph.D. submitted candidates are not eligible.
    • Experience, where applicable in CSIR norms, will be counted only after acquiring the minimum essential educational qualification; dissertation/thesis work will not be treated as experience.

Salary/Stipend

  • Project Associate-I (PAT-I):
    • Category (a): Rs. 31,000/- per month + HRA for:
      • CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET Lectureship/Assistant Professorship qualified, or
      • GATE qualified, or
      • Qualified in equivalent National level exams conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/DST or their agencies/institutions.
    • Category (b): Rs. 25,000/- per month + HRA for others not falling in (a).
  • HRA is admissible as per applicable CSIR/CSIR-NEERI rules and project guidelines.

Age Limit 

  • Upper age limit for Project Associate-I is 35 years, to be reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications (date not separately specified beyond walk-in schedule in this advertisement).
  • No explicit lower age limit is mentioned; general CSIR norms for project staff apply.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is required for this recruitment.
  • The notification clearly states that candidates are not required to pay any application fees.

Important Dates

Event Date/Time
Advertisement Reference Date 16/01/2026 (as per Advt. No. RECRUIT_V7_7A_DO_16012026)
Date of Walk-in-Interview 27/01/2026
Time of Reporting for Walk-in 09:30 AM to 11:00 AM (Gate will be closed at 11:00 AM)
Place of Interview CSIR-NEERI, Nehru Marg, Near Ajni Square, Nagpur – 440020

Selection Process

  • Selection will be done through Walk-in-Interview at CSIR-NEERI, Nagpur.
  • Mere fulfillment of minimum qualifications does not confer any right to be called for interview:
    • If a large number of candidates appear, preference will be as per criteria adopted by the Screening Committee.
  • For offline (walk-in) interviews, no TA will be paid to candidates.
  • Shortlisted candidates for any online interview mode (if used) would be informed through website/portal; however, this notice is explicitly for walk-in interview mode.
  • Final selection and engagement are subject to:
    • Verification of original documents.
    • Completion of pre-appointment formalities such as medical examination and character verification.

General Information/Instructions

  • The engagement is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project “BIOLIFT (GAP-3028)”; it confers no right, implicit or explicit, for regularization or absorption in CSIR/CSIR-NEERI.
  • Total tenure of project staff across CSIR-NEERI and other CSIR labs under contract R&D projects will not exceed six or seven years as per CSIR OM No. 5-1(342)/2017-PD dated 02.09.2024 (clauses 1.6/1.7).
  • Upper age limit is reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications.
  • Time spent acquiring higher qualifications is not counted as experience over essential qualification.
  • No upgradation of project staff is permitted in the same or new project; fresh application and selection is required for any new engagement.
  • CSIR-NEERI reserves the right to cancel or withdraw offer of engagement at any stage in case of any discrepancy in candidature.
  • Selected candidates must sign an undertaking to maintain confidentiality of project findings and associated intellectual property information.
  • Engagement depends on project tenure and requirements; may be extended or curtailed based on project duration and performance/conduct.
  • Engagement may be terminated at any time by giving one month’s notice by either side, or payment of one month’s remuneration in lieu (subject to competent authority’s discretion).
  • Project staff must arrange their own accommodation; HRA will be paid as per rules.
  • Offer letter will initially cover period for which funds are available; extension requires review by project review committee, subject to availability of funds.
  • All terms are governed by CSIR guidelines for project personnel as per OM No. 5-1(342)/2017-PD dated 02.09.2024/18.10.2024 and subsequent amendments.

How to Apply

  • This recruitment is through walk-in interview; no prior online form submission is mandated in this advertisement.
  • Candidates must:
    • Download and fill the prescribed application form attached with the advertisement.
    • Report at CSIR-NEERI, Nehru Marg, Near Ajni Square, Nagpur – 440020 on 27/01/2026 between 09:30 AM and 11:00 AM (gate closes at 11:00 AM).
  • Documents to bring (original and one set self-attested photocopies):
    • Recent passport-size photograph (signed across as indicated in the form).
    • Aadhaar Card.
    • 10th (SSC) marksheet and certificate.
    • 12th (HSC) marksheet and certificate.
    • All Graduate & Postgraduate marksheets and degree certificates (M.Sc./Integrated Masters).
    • Valid proof of NET/GATE or equivalent National exam qualification, if applicable for higher emoluments.
    • Experience certificates, if relevant and required.
  • Fill the application form completely, including:
    • Personal details, category, age as on closing date, qualifications, NET/GATE status.
    • Experience in CSIR labs and other organizations.
    • Details of any close relatives working in CSIR/NEERI.
  • Sign the declaration confirming:
    • Understanding of purely temporary, project-based nature of engagement.
    • Total prior CSIR project staff tenure does not exceed CSIR limits.
    • All information furnished is true; false information can lead to cancellation and action.

Online Registration Of Application & Payment Of Fees: To 23 January 2026

  • Shortlisting & Interview followed by CTC Negotiation

General Information / Instructions

  1. The process of Registration is complete only when fee is deposited with the Bank through online mode on or before the last date for payment of fee / last date of online registrations.
  2. Before applying, candidates are requested to ensure that they fulfil the eligibility criteria for the Post(s) as on the date of eligibility.
  3. Candidates are required to upload all relevant documents including their resume, ID proof, age proof, Caste certificate, PwBD Certificate (if applicable), educational qualifications certifications, experience details, Biodata etc., failing which their application/candidature will not be considered for shortlisting/ interview.
  4. The process of Short-listing will be provisional and without verification of original documents. Candidature will be subject to verification of all details/ documents with the original when a candidate reports for interview (if called).
  5. In case a candidate is called for interview and is found not satisfying the eligibility criteria (Age, Educational Qualification and Experience etc.) he/ she will neither be allowed to appear for the interview nor be entitled for reimbursement of any travelling expenses.
  6. Candidates are advised to check Bank's official website https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings regularly for details and updates (including the list of shortlisted/ selected candidates). The Call (letter/ advice), where required, will be sent by e-mail only (NO HARD COPY WILL BE SENT).
  7. ALL REVISIONS/ CORRIGENDUM (IF ANY) WILL BE HOSTED ON THE BANK'S WEBSITE ONLY.
  8. In case more than one candidate scores same marks as cut-off marks in the final merit list (common marks at cut-off point), such candidates will be ranked in the merit according to their age in descending order.
  9. Hard copy of application & other documents need not to be sent to this office.
  10. TEACHING & TRAINING EXPERIENCE WILL NOT BE COUNTED FOR ELIGIBILITY.
  11. Mere fulfilment of the eligibility criteria (i.e. minimum required qualifications and experiences) shall not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. The shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank will decide the shortlisting parameters and thereafter, adequate number of candidates, as decided by the Bank will be shortlisted and called for interview. the decision of the Bank to call the candidates for the interview shall be final. no correspondence will be entertained in this regard.
  12. Candidates against whom there is / are adverse report regarding character & antecedents, moral turpitude etc. are not eligible to apply for the post. If any such adverse orders / reports against the shortlisted/ selected candidates is found/ received by the Bank post their selection, their candidature/ service will be rejected forthwith.
  13. At the time of interview, the candidate will be required to provide details regarding criminal case(s) pending against him/ her, if any. The Bank may also conduct independent verification, inter alia, including verification of police records etc. The Bank reserves the right to deny appointment depending upon such disclosures and/ or independent verification.
  14. Candidates furnishing false information / suppressing the facts will be disqualified and shall be liable for debarment and legal/criminal action. Candidates who attempt fraud/impersonation shall be liable to be debarred from future recruitment process conducted by the Bank
  15.   • Candidates should fill the application carefully. Once application is filled-in completely, candidate should submit the same. In the event of candidate not being able to fill the application in one go, he can save the information already entered. When the information/ application is saved, a provisional registration number and password is generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the registration number and password. They can re-open the saved application using registration number and password and edit the particulars, if needed. This facility of editing the saved information will be available for three times only. Once the application is filled completely, candidate should submit the same and proceed for online payment of fee.
  • After registering online, the candidates are advised to take a printout of the system generated online application forms.
  • Candidates seeking Age relaxation are required to submit copies of necessary certificates at the time of joining. No change in category of any candidate is permitted after registration of online application.
  • Login to https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings
  • Scroll down and click on the respective advertisement.
  • Download advertisement no. CRPD/SCO/2025-26/19 (Carefully read the detailed advertisement)

Vacancy Details

Name of the Post No of posts
Project Associate-I 05 [SC-2, ST-1, UR-2]
Senior Project Associate 02 [SC-1, OBC-01]
Associate Engineer (Civil) 01 [UR-1]

Eligibility Criteria

  • Project Associate-I (URBMET2024-004): Master’s degree in science (Physics, Chemistry, Atmospheric Physics /Environmental sciences/Atmospheric Sciences/Meteorology) from a recognized University or equivalent.
  • Desirable: Experience with atmospheric data analysis, Numerical Models, Programming skills with Fortran/ Python / C or C++. Experience with simulations of atmospheric flows using mesoscale models.
  • Project Associate-I (MAQWS2025-001): Master’s degree in science with Atmospheric Science / Physics / Meteorology / Atmospheric Physics / Environmental Sciences from a recognized university or equivalent.
  • Desirable: Experience of handling atmospheric chemistry instruments.
  • Project Associate-I (ACRM-001): Master’s Degree in Physics/ Mathematics/ Meteorology/ Oceanography/ Atmospheric Sciences/ Statistics from a recognized University or equivalent. OR Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or Equivalent.
  • Desirable: Good command in English and working knowledge of Hindi.
  • Project Associate-I (NMM2024-001): Master’s Degree in Physics, Applied Physics, Atmospheric Sciences, Meteorology, Oceanography, Climate Science, Geophysics with Meteorology as one of the subject/ Environmental Sciences from a recognized University or equivalent. OR Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent.
  • Desirable: Knowledge in Fortran, software such as GrADS, NCL, etc and background knowledge in monsoon and its variability.
  • Project Associate-I (ART_Bhopal2021-009): Master’s Degree in (instrumentation/ Physics/ Meteorology/ Atmospheric Science/ Electricals) from a recognized University or equivalent. OR Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Technology (Electrical/Electronics) from a recognized University or equivalent.
  • Desirable: Exposure to meteorological data handling and analysis. Exposure to meteorological instruments.
  • Senior Project Associate (CAIPEEX2025-003): Master’s degree in physics/ chemistry/ mathematics/ applied physics/ geology/ applied geology/ atmospheric science/ meteorology from a recognized University or equivalent. AND Four years’ experience with data analysis, instrument handling and maintenance.
  • Desirable: Experience with weather instrument handling such as AWS, Radar, wind profiler, sodar, CCN counter, etc. Programming skills with Fortran/ Python / C or C++.
  • Senior Project Associate (MAQWS2025-003): Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology with Atmospheric Science/ Climate Science/ Earth Science System and Technology/ Geoinformatics/ GIS Remote Sensing or any equivalent subject from a recognized university or equivalent. OR Master’s degree in Science with Physics / Mathematics / Atmospheric Sciences/Environmental Sciences / Geophysics (Meteorology) / Computer Science / Environmental Science or any equivalent subject from a recognized University or equivalent. AND Four years of experience in processing geospatial data.
  • Desirable: Experience in handling large volumes of data & programming using MATLAB / Python / IDL / FORTRAN/ ArcGIS/ QGIS.
  • Senior Project Associate (GA2026-001): Bachelor degree in Engineering & Technology (Civil) from a recognized University or equivalent. ii) Four years of work experience. OR ME/ M. Tech in Engineering & Technology (Civil) from a recognized University or equivalent with 02 years of work experience.
  • Desirable: Knowledge of CPWD works manual and DSR. Work experience on Auto CAD and Microsoft Project.
  • Associate Engineer (Civil): B. E./ B. Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/ Institute with at least 60% marks. AND A minimum of 03 years of work experience in planning, preparing of work estimate, labour management, work supervision and billing for civil contract and maintenance works.
  • Desirable: Work experience on Auto CAD and Microsoft Project. Knowledge of CPWD works manual and DSR.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Project Associate-I: ₹ 31,000/- + HRA # ₹ 25,000/- + HRA
  • Senior Project Associate: ₹ 42,000+ HRA
  • Associate Engineer (Civil): ₹ 28,000/- + 3 % annual increment

Age Limit (as on date of interview)

  • Project Associate-I: 35 years
  • Senior Project Associate: 40 years
  • Associate Engineer (Civil): 40 years

Important Dates

Walk-in Interview for Project Associate-I 29 January 2026
Walk-in Interview for Senior Project Associate and Associate Engineer (Civil) 30 January 2026

Selection Process

  • Walk-In-Interview

General Information / Instructions

  • The appointment is purely on a temporary and contract basis initially for a period of one year or co-terminus with the project period whichever is earlier. The current tenure of the Project is upto 31.03.2026. Extension of tenure is subject to satisfactory performance.
  • Candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria only should attend walk-in-interview along with the duly filled in proforma.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible for these posts.
  • The date of the interview is the cut-off date for all purposes, including age/ qualification/ experience etc. Upper age limit is relaxed as per GOI orders for SC/ST, OBC & physically handicapped and as per rule for ex-servicemen.
  • Desirable qualifications and experience can be relaxed at the discretion of the Director in case of exceptionally good candidates.
  • Selected candidate may have to join the post immediately on being found fit by Medical Authority.
  • Director, IITM reserves the right to fill-up or not to fill up the posts advertised without assigning any reasons thereof.
  • The number of vacancies mentioned in the advertisement may vary depending upon the requirements of the project.
  • The Competent Authority of this Institute reserves the right to terminate the appointment of the above post by giving one month's notice to the appointee without assigning any reason thereof.
  • Candidates must produce all original documents as proof for verification and photocopy of each along with duly filled attached application, at the time of interview/joining.
  • No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in Walk-In-Interview. For SC/ST candidates admissible TA/DA shall be considered as per Government of India orders.

How to Apply

  • Candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria only should attend walk-in-interview along with the duly filled in proforma.
  • Venue for Walk-In-Interview: Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology, Dr. Homi Bhabha Road, Pashan, Pune- 411008
  • Candidates must produce all original documents as proof for verification and photocopy of each along with duly filled attached application, at the time of interview/joining.
  • Candidates who report after 1000 hrs will not be permitted to appear for Walk-In-Interview and will not be allowed to enter the Institute premises.
