Reserved Category (All Women, SEBC, SC, ST, EWS, PwD, Ex-Servicemen) Rs. 400/-

Note: Application fee must be paid online only through Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or Wallets. Transaction fee will be applicable as per rules. The examination fee paid will be refunded to candidates who appear for the examination.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Notification Date 15/01/2026
Online Application Start Date 16/01/2026 (02:00 PM)
Online Application Last Date 30/01/2026 (11:59 PM)
Fee Payment Last Date 02/02/2026 (11:59 PM)
Age Criteria, Educational Qualification, Caste Certificate Date As on 30/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on a one-stage competitive examination through MCQ (Multiple Choice Question) type Computer Based Response Test (CBRT) / OMR method.
  • The examination will be conducted in two parts: Part-A and Part-B.
  • Part-A (90 Marks): Reasoning & Data Interpretation (30 marks), Quantitative Aptitude (30 marks), Constitution of India, Current Affairs, Gujarati and English Comprehension (30 marks).
  • Part-B (120 Marks): Questions related to technical qualification and its applications.
  • Total 210 questions will be asked for 210 marks.
  • Total time allotted: 3 hours (180 minutes) for both parts combined.
  • Negative Marking: 1/4 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Minimum Qualifying Standard: 40% for both Part-A and Part-B separately.
  • Merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in the competitive examination.
  • Candidates equal to approximately two times the number of vacancies will be called for certificate verification based on provisional merit list.
  • Final selection will be made based on merit and category-wise vacancies.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must read the entire advertisement carefully before applying online.
  • Only online applications will be accepted through OJAS website https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in.
  • Candidates must have all original certificates (educational qualification, age, caste, disability, ex-servicemen, etc.) with them while filling the online application.
  • Candidates should carefully verify all details from their certificates and fill accurate information in the online application.
  • Any incorrect or false information may lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage.
  • The Board reserves the right to modify or cancel this advertisement at any stage without assigning any reason.
  • All instructions and updates regarding the recruitment process will be published on the Board's website https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in.
  • Candidates must keep checking the Board's website regularly for updates.
  • The mobile number and email ID provided in the application must remain active throughout the recruitment process.
  • Candidates must upload a recent passport size photograph with white background taken within one year before the last date of application.
  • The same photograph must be used at all stages of recruitment including examination hall ticket and certificate verification.
  • Multiple applications from the same candidate will result in cancellation of all except the last confirmed application.
  • Gujarat Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2023 is applicable to all examinations conducted by GSSSB.
  • Candidates found guilty of unfair means will face legal action as per the Act.

How to Apply

  • Visit the official OJAS website: https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in
  • Click on "Online Application" and select GSSSB.
  • Select Advertisement No. 355/202526 for Work Assistant, Class-3 and click on Apply.
  • Click on "More Details" to read the detailed advertisement.
  • Click on "Apply Now" to open the application form.
  • Fill in Personal Details carefully (fields with red asterisk * are mandatory).
  • Fill in Educational Details accurately.
  • Accept the Assurance (Guarantee) by selecting "Yes" and click "Save".
  • An Application Number will be generated after saving. Note down this number for future reference.
  • Upload recent passport size photograph (white background) and signature in JPG format (not exceeding 15 KB).
  • Photo size: 5 cm height and 3.6 cm width; Signature size: 2.5 cm height and 7.5 cm width.
  • After uploading photo and signature, click on "Confirm Application" and verify all details.
  • Make corrections if necessary before confirming. No changes can be made after confirmation.
  • After confirming, a Confirmation Number will be generated. Save this number.
  • Pay the examination fee online through Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or Wallets by 02/02/2026 (11:59 PM).
  • Take printout of the application form and fee receipt for future reference.
  • Download the Call Letter/Hall Ticket when notification is published on the Board's website.

  • Candidates are not permitted to use or be in possession of calculators in examination premises.
  • Candidates are advised, in their own interest, not to bring any of the banned items including mobile phones to the venue of the examination, as arrangement for safekeeping cannot be assured.
  • The post is also open to the employees of the Bank (staff candidates) who satisfy the eligibility criteria.

  • To make online payment of application fees/ intimation charges candidate should keep the necessary details/ documents ready.
  • Candidate should have a valid personal email ID, which should be kept active till the declaration of result.
  • Candidates satisfying the conditions of eligibility as on January 01, 2026, are first required to visit the URL "Recruitment for the post of Office Attendant - PY 2025" in the advertisement page for filling the 'Online Application'.
  • Candidates will have to enter their basic details and upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and a hand-written declaration in the online application form as per the specifications given.

Eligibility Criteria

  • B.E. / B.Tech. in Civil Engineering with Master's in any Discipline Note – Candidates having Master's degree in Civil Engineering / Environmental Engineering / Public Health Engineering will be preferred.
  • Graduate in Civil Engineering and Masters in Structural Engineering
  • Qualification – Degree in Civil Engineering Preferrable - Post - Graduate Degree in Civil Engineering / Environmental Engineering / Public Health Engineering Note - In case of PG Degree in Civil Engineering, one of the subject(s) should be Environmental Engineering / Public Health Engineering / Equivalent.
  • Essential: Degree in Civil Engineering Preferred: Candidates having PG in Civil Engineering with specialization in Environmental Engineering / Public Health Engineering or equivalent.
  • Total experience of 20 years in the field of Civil Engineering / Environmental Engineering / Public Health Engineering with experience in the following areas - 1. Program/ Project management of Urban Service delivery (Water Supply/ Sewerage/Drainage) and 2. Execution of one or multiple projects with a cumulative capital value Rs 1000 crore in Water Supply / Sewerage / Drainage and 3. Design and implementation of Water Supply projects. 4. Experience of at least 2 projects as Team Leader and 5. Minimum 5 years of experience as Team Leader in above mentioned projects and 6. Comprehensive knowledge and experience in monitoring civil construction works, with proficiency in WaterGEMS software.
  • Total experience of 20 Years in the field of Civil Engineering / Structural Engineering, with - Out of 20 years minimum 10 years’ experience in structure design / proof checking of WTP, STPs, ESRs, GSRs and other water supply & sewerage components.
  • Total Experience of 15 Years in the field of Civil Engineering / Environmental Engineering / Public Health Engineering, with - 1. Minimum 10 years’ experience in quality control within Water / Sewerage sector and 2. Should have handled at least 5 similar projects as QA/QC Engineer and 3. Should be familiar with establishing Quality Assurance Programs in STPD/UGD/WSS project and 4. Experience of working on one or more projects with a cumulative capital value Rs 500 crore related to Water Supply/ Sewerage/ Drainage
  • Minimum 12 years of post-qualification experience required. Area of Experience –  Out of 12 years’ experience, at least 07 years’ experience in quality control of Water/ Sewerage Sector  The candidate should have handled at least 02 similar projects as QA/QC Engineer.  The candidate should be familiar with establishing Quality Assurance Program in Water Supply / UGD Project.

  • Rs. 1,60,000/-
  • Rs. 1,60,000/-
  • Rs. 1,00,000/-
  • Rs. 1,00,000/-

  • Not exceeding 62 years

Application Fee

  • The application fee for all categories of posts is NIL.

Important Dates

Particulars Date
Commencement of submission of online application 14 January 2026
Last date of submission of online application 26 January 2026 (till 09:00 PM)
Venue & Date of Interview: - RITES Corporate Office, Shikhar, Plot No.01, Sector-29, Gurgaon-122001, OR RITES Project Unit office, Ahmedabad Unit-404,4th Floor, Dwarkesh Business Hub, Visat-Tapovan Road, Motera, Ahmedabad, Gujarat-380005 OR Through Video Conferencing/Online (link will be shared to candidates on their registered mail Id/official chat group) 27 January 2026 & 28 January 2026 (Tuesday & Wednesday) Reporting time11:00 AM (Candidates may appear for Document Scrutiny / interview process online or in-person, only shortlisted candidates shall be allowed for further process of interview.)

Selection Process

  • All candidates who successfully submitted their online application form, shall be provisionally allowed to appear for Document Scrutiny/verification process wherein the eligibility of the candidates with respect to the post applied will be verified. Thereafter, the shortlisted/eligible candidates shall be allowed to appear for Interview.
  • The mode of Selection is Interview only.
  • Personal Interview "In selection process, candidates will be evaluated based on a variety of parameters such as Technical skills, subject knowledge, experience, communication and interpersonal skills.”
  • The candidates shall have to produce copies of educational qualification and experience claimed which shall be verified from the original documents at the appropriate stage and shall be subject to verification from the original source.
  • Based upon fulfilling the conditions of eligibility; candidates shall be shortlisted for Interview.

General Information / Instructions

  • Legal Status: The Individual Consultant shall have the legal status of an Independent Consultant vis-a-vis, RITES Limited and shall not be regarded, for any purposes, as being either a "staff member" of RITES Limited, or an "official" of RITES Limited. Accordingly, nothing within or relating to the Contract shall establish the relationship of employer and employee, or of principal and agent, between RITES Limited and the Individual Consultant.
  • Standards of Conduct:
  • In General, the Individual Consultant shall neither seek nor accept instructions from any authority external to RITES Limited in connection with the performance of its obligations under the Contract. The Individual Consultant shall not take any action in respect of its performance of the Contract or otherwise related to its obligations under the Contract that may adversely affect the interests of RITES Limited, and the Individual Consultant shall perform its obligations under the Contract with the fullest regard to the interests of RITES Limited. The Individual Consultant warrants that it has not and shall not offer any direct or indirect benefit arising from or related to the performance of the Contract or the award thereof to any representative, official, employee or other agent of RITES Limited. The Individual Consultant shall comply with all laws, ordinances, rules and regulations bearing upon the performance of its obligations under the Contract. In the performance of the Contract, the Individual Consultant shall comply with the standards of Conduct. Failure to comply with the same is ground for termination of the services or the Individual Consultant.
  • Prohibition of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse: In the performance of the Contract, the Individual Consultant shall- comply with the "Sexual harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013". The Individual Consultant acknowledges and agrees that any breach of any of the provisions hereof shall constitute a breach of an essential term of the Contract, and, in addition to any other legal rights or remedies available to any person, shall give rise to grounds for termination of the Contract. In addition, nothing herein shall limit the right of RITES Limited to refer any alleged breach of the foregoing standards of conduct to the relevant national authorities for appropriate legal action.
  • Title Rights, Copyrights, Patents and Other Proprietary Rights:
  • Title to any equipment and supplies that may be furnished by RITES Limited to the Individual Consultant for the performance of any obligations under the Contract shall rest with RITES Limited, and any such equipment shall be returned to RITES Limited at the conclusion of the Contract or when no longer needed by the Individual Consultant. Such equipment, when returned to RITES Limited, shall be in the same condition as when delivered to the Individual Consultant, subject to normal wear and tear and the Individual Consultant shall be liable to compensate RITES Limited for any damage or degradation of the equipment that is beyond normal wear and tear.
  • RITES Limited shall be entitled to all intellectual property and other proprietary rights, including, but not limited to, patents, copyrights and trademarks, with regard to products, processes, inventions, ideas, know-how or documents and other materials which the Individual Consultant has developed for RITES Limited under the Contract and which bear a direct relation to or are produced or prepared or collected in consequence of or during the course of, the performance of the Contract, and the Individual Consultant acknowledges and agrees that such products, documents and other materials constitute works made for hire for RITES Limited. Subject to the foregoing provisions, all maps, drawings, photographs, mosaics, plans, reports, estimates, recommendations, documents and all other data compiled by or received by the Individual Consultant under the Contract shall be the property of RITES Limited, shall be made available for use or inspection by RITES Limited at reasonable times and in reasonable places, shall be treated as confidential and shall be delivered only to RITES Limited authorized officials on completion of work under the Contract.
  • Confidential Nature of Documents and Information: The Individual Consultant would be subject to the provisions of the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923. The Individual Consultant shall not, except with the previous sanction of RITES Limited or in the bona fide discharge of his or her duties, publish a book or a compilation of articles or participate in radio broadcast or contribute an article or write a letter in any newspapers or periodical either in his own name or anonymously or pseudonymously in the name of any other person, if such book, article, broadcast or letter relates to subject matter assigned to him/her by RITES Limited.
  • Use of Name, Emblem or Official Seal of the RITES Limited: Individual Consultant shall not advertise or otherwise make public for purposes of commercial advantage that it has a contractual relationship with RITES Limited, nor shall the Individual Consultant, in any manner whatsoever, use the name, emblem or official seal of RITES Limited, or any abbreviation of the name of RITES Limited, in connection with its business or otherwise without the written permission of RITES Limited.
  • Insurance: The Individual Consultant shall be solely responsible for taking out and for maintaining adequate insurance required to meet any of its obligations under the Contract, as well as for arranging, at the Individual Consultant's sole expense, such life, health and other forms of insurance as the Individual Consultant may consider to be appropriate to cover the period during which the Individual Consultant provides services under the Contract.
  • Travel, Medical Clearance and Service Incurred death, Injury or Illness:
  • RITES Limited may require the Individual Consultant to submit a Statement of Good Health from a recognized physician prior to the commencement of work in any offices or premises of RITES Limited.
  • In the event of the death, injury or illness of the Individual Consultant which is attributable to the performance of services on behalf of RITES Limited under the terms of the Contract while the Individual Consultant is travelling at RITES Limited expense or is performing any services under the Contract in any offices or premises of RITES Limited, the Individual Consultant or the Individual Consultant's dependents, as appropriate, shall not be entitled to any compensation.
  • Force Majeure and other Conditions:
  • Force Majeure as used herein, means any unforeseeable and irresistible act of nature, any act of war (whether declared or not), invasion, revolution, insurrection, or any other acts of a similar nature or force, provided that such acts arise from causes beyond the control and without the fault or negligence of the Individual Consultant.
  • The Individual Consultant acknowledges and agrees that, with respect to any obligations under the Contract that the Individual Consultant must perform in or for any areas in which RITES Limited is engaged in, preparing to engage in, or disengaging from any peacekeeping, humanitarian or similar operations, any delay or failure to perform such obligations arising from or relating to harsh conditions within such areas or to any incidents of civil unrest occurring in such areas shall not, in and of itself, constitute force majeure under the Contract.
  • Termination: RITES Limited can terminate the contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason for it. However, in the normal course it will provide one month's notice to the Individual Consultant. The Individual Consultant can also seek for termination of the contract upon giving one month's notice to the RITES Limited.
  • Audits and Investigations: Each invoice paid by RITES Limited shall be subject to a post-payment audit by auditors, whether internal or external, of RITES Limited or by other authorized and qualified agents of RITES Limited at any time during the term of the Contract and for a period of two (2) years following the expiration or prior termination of the Contract. RITES Limited shall be entitled to a refund from the Individual Consultant for any amounts shown by such audits to have been paid by RITES Limited other than in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Contract. The Individual Consultant acknowledges and agrees that, from time to time, RITES Limited may conduct investigations relating to any aspect of the Contract or the award thereof, the obligations performed under the Contract, and the operations of the Individual Consultant generally relating to performance of the Contract. The right of RITES Limited to conduct an investigation and the Individual Consultant's obligation to comply with such an investigation shall not lapse upon expiration or prior termination of the Contract.
  • The Individual Consultant shall provide its full and timely cooperation with any such inspections, post-payment audits or investigations. Such cooperation shall include, but shall not be limited to, the Individual Consultant's obligation to make available its personnel and any relevant documentation for such purposes at reasonable times and on reasonable conditions and to grant to RITES Limited access to the Individual Consultant's premises at reasonable times and on reasonable conditions in connection with such access to the Individual Consultant's personnel and relevant documentation.
  • Settlement of Disputes: RITES Limited and the Individual Consultant shall use their best efforts to amicably settle any dispute, controversy or claim arising out of the Contract or the breach, termination or invalidity thereof.
  • Arbitration: Any dispute, controversy or claim between the parties arising out of the Contract, or the breach, termination, or invalidity thereof: unless settled amicably, as provided above, shall be referred by either of the parties to the Chairman and Managing Director (CMD), RITES Limited for arbitration. The CMD, RITES Limited may appoint an arbitrator for the settlement of the controversy.
  • Conflict of Interest: The Individual Consultant shall be expected to follow all the rules and regulations of the RITES Limited which are in force. He/she will be expected to display utmost honesty, secrecy of office and sincerity while discharging his/her duties. In case the services of the Individual Consultant are not found satisfactory or found in conflict with the interests of the RITES Limited, his/her services will be liable for discontinuation without assigning any reason. Note Below: "Individual Consultant or service provider" means Young Associate/ Young Professional/ Expert/Senior Expert depending upon their experience.

How to Apply

  • Before applying candidates should ensure that they satisfy the necessary conditions and requirements of the position.
  • Interested candidates fulfilling the above laid down eligibility criteria are required to apply online in the registration format available in the Career Section of RITES website, http://www.rites.com.
  • While submitting the online application; the system would generate ‘Registration No.’ on top of online form filled up by the candidate. Note down this “Registration No.” and quote it for all further communication with RITES Ltd.
  • While filling up the required details, candidates are advised to carefully and correctly fill the details of “Identity Proof”. Candidates are also advised to note the same and ensure the availability of the same Identity Proof as it will be required to be produced in original at later stages of selection.
  • After filling up the required details under the “Fill/ Modify Application Form”, candidate should submit the application. The candidates are also advised to keep a copy of Application Form submitted with them and to carry the same at the time of the selection.
  • A copy of online APPLICATION FORM containing the registration number is to be printed, signed, and furnished at the time of document verification/ interview along with SELF- ATTESTED PHOTOCOPY with Original of the following documents in the given order only from top to bottom: a. 1 Passport size Photograph b. High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth c. Certificates of Academic & Professional qualifications and statements of marks of all the qualifications for all semesters/years (Xth, XIIth, Diploma/ Graduation/ Post-Graduation as applicable) d. Copies of experience certificates from your previous employer in respect of claims made by you in your application. e. Proof of Identity & Address (Passport, Voter ID, Driving License, Aadhaar Card etc) f. PAN Card g. Proof of different periods of experience(s) as claimed in the Application Form (if applicable) h. Any other document(s) in support of your candidature.
  • Scanned copies of all above-mentioned documents need to be uploaded on RITES website for successful submission of applications. Candidates need to ensure that scanned copies are clear and visible.
  • Note: All Candidates are required to upload all relevant documents as part of their application. These documents will be scrutinized on the day of the interview, and candidates must be present, either in person or online for document scrutiny and verification procedure. Please note that mere submission of documents does not qualify a candidate for an interview. All candidates who submit online applications will be eligible for document scrutiny and verification process. Upon successful completion of documents scrutiny only eligible candidates will be allowed to appear in Interview.
  • In respect of current employment, experience certificate/ joining letter along with last 3 months’ salary slips or last financial year/latest Form 16 and other documents which clearly prove your continuity in the job are to be produced during document verification. In case your claim is not established from the proofs submitted by you; your application is liable to be rejected. Please check your claims and certificates submitted by you carefully. No claims would be entertained at a later stage. For proof of CTC/ salary, candidates shall have to submit a copy of their last financial year/latest Form No. 16/ Earning Card/ salary slip/ Appraisal letter/ any other suitable document.
  • Hard copies of documents are not to be sent to this office through post/ courier.
  • The original testimonials/documents along with one self-attested copy will have to be produced by the candidate(s) at the time of selection.
  • Mere applying for the post/ submission of documents/ appearing or qualifying in the selection does not confer any right on the candidates for claiming selection. If it is found that a candidate does not fulfil the advertised eligibility criteria, his/her candidature will be summarily rejected. It is emphasized that it is the responsibility of the candidate to check the eligibility for the post before submitting the application.
  • Applications once submitted cannot be altered. A valid e-mail ID is essential for submission of the online application. RITES will not be responsible for bouncing of any e-mail sent to the candidates. However, candidates can apply for any number of vacancies.
  • The candidates must submit all the details pertaining to his candidature viz. personal details, educational qualification details, experience details, category etc. Suppression, in this regard, if any, detected on a future date shall render the candidature liable for forfeiture. If any claim made by a candidate is found to be incorrect, his/her candidature shall be summarily rejected. Incomplete application or insufficient proof would entail rejection of your application.
  • Note: Candidate has to bring/upload duly filled one copy of Annexure A, documents in chronological order and submit at a time of Document verification/Selection process.

BKNMU Finance & Law Officer Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Total Posts Category

Eligibility Criteria

  • Finance and Accounts Officer
    • Master’s Degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed.
    • Nine years of experience as Assistant Professor in Academic Level 10 and above with experience in educational administration OR Comparable experience in research establishment and/or other institutions of higher education OR Five years of accounts cadre experience as an Accounts Officer (Class-I) or equivalent post.
    • A certificate of basic knowledge of computer applications from any recognized institute as per Government of Gujarat resolutions (CRR-10-2007-120320-GS dated 13/08/2008 and 18/03/2016).
    • Maximum age limit: 45 years (with applicable age relaxation as per Government of Gujarat rules).
  • Law Officer
    • LL.B from recognized Indian University/Institution with at least 7 years’ experience of law practice in a court of law in civil/criminal/service matters, duly certified.
    • LL.M from recognized Indian University/Institution with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade point in the grade point scale.
    • A certificate of basic knowledge of computer applications from any recognized institute as per Government resolutions cited.
    • Age limit: 42 years (upper age as stated; relaxation as per Government of Gujarat rules).

Salary/Stipend

  • Finance and Accounts Officer: Pay Level 11 in Pay Matrix, ₹67,700 to ₹2,08,700 per month as per 7th CPC.
  • Law Officer: Pay Level 10 in Pay Matrix, ₹56,100 to ₹1,77,500 per month as per 7th CPC.
  • All allowances, DA and other benefits will be as per Government of Gujarat and University rules applicable to these pay levels.

Age Limit (as on 24-01-2026)

  • Finance and Accounts Officer: Maximum 45 years; upper age limit counted as on the last date of submission of online application, with relaxation as per existing Government of Gujarat rules.
  • Law Officer: Age limit 42 years as mentioned; upper age counted as on the last date of online application, with relaxation as per Government of Gujarat rules.

Application Fee

  • Unreserved (UR) candidates: ₹1,500/- (Rupees One Thousand Five Hundred only) – payable online.
  • SC/ST/SEBC/EWS candidates: ₹750/- (Rupees Seven Hundred Fifty only) – payable online.
  • PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disability): Exempted from payment of prescribed fees upon submission of valid Disability Certificate.
  • Bank charges towards online payment service (if any) will be borne by the candidates.
  • Application fee is non-refundable.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Date of Commencement of Online Application Form 31/12/2025
Last date of Online Application Form 24/01/2026
Last date of receipt of hard copy of online application form with enclosures 31/01/2026 up to 06:00 PM
Upper age limit reference date As on last date of online application (24/01/2026)

Selection Process

  • The University reserves the right to shortlist candidates based on merit, aptitude test, written test or any other method for inviting candidates for interview.
  • The decision of Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University regarding the process of selection shall be final and binding.
  • Candidates must produce original testimonials, certificates and other documents at the time of interview, if called.
  • No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending written test/interview.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted online only; only online applications with required uploaded enclosures will be accepted.
  • Candidates must send two hard copies of the online application along with all self-attested testimonials, certificates and supporting documents by Courier/In Person/Registered Post/Speed Post so as to reach the Registrar by 31/01/2026 up to 06:00 PM.
  • Applications sent through email will not be entertained; incomplete applications, applications without necessary testimonials, or without online payment of prescribed fees will be rejected.
  • Candidates should possess the required educational qualifications by the last date of online submission; no updates/additions will be entertained thereafter.
  • Age relaxation will be provided as per existing Government of Gujarat rules; upper age limit is counted as on the last date of online application.
  • The University reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all advertised vacancies and to amend or modify eligibility criteria, experience and other provisions as per Government of Gujarat rules, Gujarat Public Universities Act-2023 and Gujarat Public Universities Uniform Statutes-2024.
  • Experience as Daily Wager, Trainee, Honorary, Adhoc and Visiting Faculty shall not be considered as experience.
  • Applicants in employment must forward applications through proper channel or submit No Objection Certificate at the time of interview if original application through proper channel has not been received in time.
  • The University will verify antecedents/documents at any stage; if any document is found fake or information suppressed, services may be terminated forthwith.
  • Canvassing of any kind will disqualify the candidature; no TA/DA for written test/interview; any dispute will be under jurisdiction of courts where University headquarters is situated.

How to Apply

  • Apply online through the University’s online application proforma as per instructions on www.bknmu.edu.in.
  • Pay the prescribed application fee online and retain the transaction receipt.
  • After successful online submission, take printout of the duly filled online application form.
  • Attach self-attested copies of all required documents (age proof, educational qualifications, experience certificates, caste/SEBC/EWS certificates, Non-Creamy Layer certificate, Disability Certificate if applicable, fee receipt, etc.).
  • Send two hard copies of the complete application set by Courier/In Person/Registered Post/Speed Post to:
    The Registrar, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University, Government Polytechnic Campus, Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University Road, Khadiya, Junagadh – 362263, Gujarat
    so as to reach on or before 31/01/2026 up to 06:00 PM.
  • Use Annexure-I as checklist for enclosed documents; Annexure-II (Endorsement by Employer) is mandatory for in-service applicants.
  • Regularly check University website www.bknmu.edu.in for any corrigendum/addendum or updates regarding this recruitment.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Basic Pay Rs. 67,700/- in the Level-11 & Index-1 of Pay Matrix (Pre-revised Basic pay Rs. 18,750/- (PB-3) with Grade Pay Rs. 6600/-) and allowances applicable under ESIC rules and Scheme of Senior Residency.
  • a) Full Time - Consolidated amount of Rs 2,00,000/- per month b) Part Time - Consolidated amount of Rs 1,00,000/- per month

Age Limit

  • Not exceeding 45 years as on interview date. Age limit is relaxable by 03 years for OBC & 05 years for SC/ST candidates.
  • Age not exceeding 69 years as on interview date.

Application Fee

  • Candidates belonging to the UR/OBC category have to deposit a Demand Draft (Non-Refundable) of Rs. 300/- in the favour of "ESI Fund Account No. -1" payable to Ahmedabad at the time of interview. Note: - SC/ST/ PWD/Female candidates have been exempted for payment of fee.

Important Dates

Walk-in Interview 2 February 2026

Selection Process

  • Walk-in Interview

General Information / Instructions

1. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PH is as per Central Government rules. The candidate appointed under PWD quota will be adjusted against the vacancy of respective categories of SC/ST/OBC/EWS/General.
2. Candidates seeking reservation benefits under SC/ST/OBC/EWS category must produce original certificate in prescribed format of Govt. of India in support of their claim.
1. This is a rolling advertisement, applicable for filling the vacancies declared above as well as any unfilled and/or newly created posts through subsequent amendment notifications (issued as short notices) to be published only on the official websites, i.e., www.esic.gov.in/recruitments and www.bapunagarhospital.esic.gov.in/recruitments.
2. Walk-in interviews shall be conducted for vacancies that remain unfilled and/or as per the operational requirements of the Hospital as on the date of interview. The number of vacancies available shall be published on the ESIC website (www.esic.gov.in/recruitments and www.bapunagarhospital.esic.gov.in/recruitments) at least 5-7 days prior to the scheduled Walk-in Interview, proposed to be held on the 1st of every month, or on the next working day in case of a holiday, subject to change due to administrative exigencies.
3. Eligible and interested candidates who fulfill the prescribed eligibility criteria in all respects may appear for the Walk-in Interview on the notified date.
4. Applicants applying in response to this advertisement are advised to satisfy themselves regarding their eligibility for the post applied for. They must fulfill the eligibility criteria in all respects as on the date of the Walk-in Interview.
1. The candidate should report at 09:30 AM for verification of documents at Conference hall (2nd Floor) of ESIC Model Hospital, Bapunagar, Ahmedabad. Only candidates clear the document verification will be allowed to appear before the interview panel.
3. The tenure of Senior Residency is for a period of total 03 years (including any service rendered as SR earlier on ad-hoc/ regular basis in government institution). The appointment will be initially for a period of one year, which is extendable for a period of 03 years on an annual basis, subject to satisfactory performance to be reviewed every year.
4. Tenure of Contractual Part/Full time Super Specialist will be for one year (which is extendable only for full time super specialist for a period of 03 years on an annual basis, subject to satisfactory performance to be reviewed every year and requirement), or till faculty is posted in the concerned Super Specialty, whichever is earlier.
5. Candidates claiming reservation/age relaxation on ground of belonging to the OBC should submit the community certificate as prescribed by GOI, DOPT OM No. 36012/12/22/93-ESTT. (SCT) dated 08/09/93 which is modified by GOI DOPT OM No. 36033/3/2004(Res.) dated 09/03/2004 and time to time failing which the benefit of reservation/relaxation will not be given or their application shall be rejected. The OBC-NCL Certificate should be valid.
6. Candidates seeking reservation benefits under SC/ST/OBC/EWS category must produce original certificates in the prescribed format of Govt. of India.
7. The selected candidates shall have to pay Rs. 30,000/- (Thirty thousand rupees only) as Security Deposit (Senior Resident/ Super Specialist) and make an agreement on a Rs. 300/- Non-Judicial Stamp paper to be purchased by the candidate at the time of joining.
8. No claim of any service benefit like PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical allowance, Seniority, Promotion and leave etc., will be admissible.
9. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview and joining purpose.
10. Private Practice of any kind will not be allowed.
11. Candidates working in Govt./ Private Hospital / Institute should produce NOC from their department at the time of Interview.
12. Applicants having completed 3 years of Senior Residency period in any government hospital, are not eligible for applying under residency scheme.
13. The service of SR will be governed by Residency Scheme and terms & conditions of the agreement.
14. Resignation from service will require 01 month of notice period or pay in lieu thereof in case of SR Scheme (03 Year), Specialist and Super Specialist.
15. Vacancies can change depending upon actual requirement at the time of interview.
16. Hostel accommodation / quarters will not be provided.
17. The Medical Superintendent, ESIC Model Hospital Bapunagar Ahmedabad reserves the right to fill up all post / partial post / not to fill up any post without assigning any reason, whatsoever.

How to Apply

  • The eligible and desirous candidates with duly filled in application form (Annexure-A) should appear for walk-in-interview with their application along with original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopy of the relevant documents in support of age, qualifications, attempt, Mark Sheet, Degree, MCI/State Registration, Category & Experience certificate etc. and two recent passport size photographs.
  • Applicants are advised to report to the office of Medical Superintendent, ESIC Model Hospital, Bapunagar, Ahmedabad (Gujarat) on the dates of interview up to 11:00 AM, any application received thereafter will not be entertained.

The decision of NITW with regard to eligibility of the candidate shall be final.

The eligibility criteria including the age, educational qualifications, as prescribed in the advertisement will be determined with reference to the last date of receipt of application. All Certificates/diploma/degrees etc. in support of educational qualification mentioned in the application must be awarded by the Board/Institute/University recognized by the Government/other Statutory Bodies. All candidates, irrespective of their category may be considered against Unreserved positions, subject to fulfillment of parameters / conditions for Unreserved candidates. The candidate selected for the post will be on probation for one year from the date of joining as per NIT Statutes.
  • On appointment, fresh recruits will be governed by the National Pension System as notified by Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance, Government of India vide Notification No.F.No.5/7/2003-ECB & PR dated 22-12-2003, as amended from time to time. In case the Universities/Board, award grades/CGPA/OGPA, the same will have to be indicated in equivalent percentage of marks as per the norms adopted by that University/Board and a certificate to this effect issued by the University/Board should be submitted in the online application. In the absence of the same, the candidature will not be considered. Appointment to the post is subject to being found medically fit by the Competent Authority.
  • In addition to the Pay and allowances as applicable to the employees posted in the Institute, the incumbent would be entitled to the following facilities: a) Reimbursement of Children Education Allowance as per Central Government Rules b) Reimbursement of Medical expenses including referral to outside specialized and reputed hospitals for OP/IP for them and their dependent family members. c) Suitable institute residential accommodation in the campus, subject to availability. d) Leave Travel Concession as per Central Government Rules e) National Pension Scheme for all direct recruits, except those incumbents who are governed under the CCS (Pension) Rules, 1972, as on the date of appointment in the Institute.
  • The competent authority/screening committees of NITW reserve all the rights to set higher standards & parameters, to shortlist the candidates, which may include highest qualification prescribed in the Recruitment Rules, desirable/preferable qualifications and/or experience, and other requirements mentioned in the notification/recruitment rules. The decision of the competent authority in all matters relating to the eligibility of the candidate, scaheme/mode of selection process,i.e., screening/skill/written test would be final and binding on all the candidates.

A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the Provisional Registration Number and Password. Visually Impaired candidates should fill the application form carefully and verify/ get the details verified to ensure that the same are correct prior to final submission.
  • Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/ entertained after clicking the COMPLETE REGISTRATION BUTTON.
  • The Name of the candidate or his /her Father/ Husband etc. should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the SSC Certificates/ Mark sheets/Identity proof. Any change/alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Validate your details and Save your application by clicking the 'Validate your details' and 'Save & Next' button.
  • Candidates can proceed to upload Photo & Signature as per the specifications given in the Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Photograph and Signature.
  • Candidates can proceed to fill other details of the Application Form.

  • Modify details, if required, and click on 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' ONLY after verifying and ensuring that the photograph, signature uploaded and other details filled by you are correct.
  • Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment.
  • Click on 'Submit' button.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The candidate must have passed the 12th grade from any board established by law in India or possess an equivalent qualification recognized by the government.
  • The required educational qualification must be held at the time of application, and the relevant mark sheets or certificates should be available.
  • Candidates who are "Appeared" or "Appearing" are not eligible for the application.
  • The candidate is responsible for providing proof of the educational qualification's authenticity and equivalency, and the board's decision will be final on this matter.
  • Additional qualifications such as an “O” level computer certificate from DOEACC/NIELIT, two years of service in the Territorial Army, or a "B" certificate from the National Cadet Corps will be given preference in case of a tie in marks.
  • These additional qualifications are for preference purposes only and will not carry separate marks, and only one additional qualification can be considered for preference.

Salary/Stipend

  • Rs 21,700 to 69,100

Age Limit 

  • For male candidates: The age should be between 18 to 22 years as of 01-07-2025. This means the candidate should have been born between 02 July 2003 and 01 July 2007.
  • For female candidates: The age should be between 18 to 25 years as of 01-07-2025. This means the candidate should have been born between 02 July 2000 and 01 July 2007.
  • Age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for candidates from SC/ST, OBC, Uttar Pradesh state employees, etc., and for ex-servicemen based on their service period.
  • Detailed age limits for different categories are provided in the official notification.

Application Fee

  • General / EWS / OBC candidates: ₹500/
  • SC / ST candidates: ₹400/
  • The fee is to be paid online via Debit/Credit card, Internet Banking, or UPI and will not be refunded under any circumstances.

Important Dates

Description Start Date End Date
Online Application Start Date 31-12-2025 30-01-2026
Application Fee Payment Date 31-12-2025 30-01-2026
Fee Adjustment Date 31-12-2025 02-02-2026

Selection Process

  • The selection process includes an offline objective type written exam (300 marks, 150 questions, 2 hours, OMR-based) covering General Knowledge, General Hindi, Numerical and Mental Ability, Mental Aptitude, Intelligence, and Logical Ability.
  • The minimum passing marks are: Unreserved 30%, EWS 25%, OBC 25%, SC/ST 20%. Candidates scoring below these marks will be disqualified.
  • Those who qualify the written exam will be called for document verification and physical standard tests (PST), which are qualifying in nature.
  • Physical Standard Test (PST) includes separate minimum height, chest (for males), and weight (for females) standards. A minimum chest expansion of 5 cm is mandatory for males.
  • A Physical Efficiency Test (PET) will follow for qualified candidates. Men must complete 4.8 km in 25 minutes, and women must complete 2.4 km in 14 minutes. Candidates failing to meet these timings will be disqualified.
  • The final selection will be based on written exam marks, reservation policy, Merit-cum-Order of Preference, medical exam, and character verification.

General Information/Instructions

  • The number of vacancies may change before the exam, and the recruitment may be canceled at any level without any reason.
  • Vertical and horizontal reservations are valid only for Uttar Pradesh permanent residents, and reservations for women are applicable as per departmental guidelines.
  • All caste certificates and age relaxation proofs must be issued by competent authorities as per the prescribed format before the last date, otherwise the benefit will not be given.
  • Candidates with criminal records, bigamy, or moral turpitude are disqualified for service.
  • Physically handicapped candidates are not eligible for police services, as per the relevant rules.
  • Any false documents or information will lead to the disqualification of the candidate, and legal action can be taken.
  • All information related to the recruitment will be available only on the official website, and no personal correspondence will be made. The decision of the board will be final and binding.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must complete One Time Registration (OTR) before applying online, requiring a unique email ID and mobile number.
  • OTR will be validated via Aadhaar-based OTP and possibly DigiLocker; candidates are advised to update their Aadhaar and mobile number.
  • After OTR, candidates will log in on the official website and complete the online application form.
  • The application form should be filled accurately with all necessary documents uploaded via scanning or DigiLocker.
  • Government employees must upload a "No Objection Certificate," and only one application per candidate will be accepted.
  • Once the form is completed, candidates should pay the application fee online and take a printout of the preview for future reference.
  • During the online application, the candidate's real-time photograph will be taken, and technical standards for photographs, signatures, etc., must be adhered to.
  • Candidates must choose the order of preference for posts, and no changes will be allowed later.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification (Post Doctoral Fellow - PDF): Ph.D or equivalent degree with relevant experience, and three research papers published in SCI/SCIE journals.
  • Qualification (Research Associate -I - RA-I): Ph.D. OR having 3 years of research, or design and development experience after MSc/MS/ME/M.Tech, with at least one research paper published in a SCI/SCIE journal.
  • Qualification (Junior Research Fellow - JRF): B.E./B.Tech and MSc/M.E./M.Tech. in CSE / IT / Cybersecurity / AI / ML / Data Science or any other relevant branch, both with First Class (minimum 65% marks or 7.0 CGPA on a 10-point scale) from a recognized institution. The candidate must have qualified NET or GATE.
  • Desirable Qualification (for all positions): Candidates having hands-on experience or good knowledge in Two or more of the following areas will be preferred: Computer Network (specially OSI Layer, Traffic Analysis & Communications Protocols), VPN and proxy identification using network traffic (Layer-7) and Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), Applying AI / ML / Deep Learning models for VPN detection and anomaly classification, Using Agentic AI for automated or intelligent decision-making, Graph-based analysis of network data, Working with VPN and proxy repositories, including dark web indicators, Packet capture and analysis using tools such as Wireshark, TShark, or tcpdump, Developing web dashboards for data visualization and alerts, Performing time-series and real-time network analysis using telemetry data, Detecting network anomalies using adaptive thresholds, Following ethical research practices in data handling and analysis, Knowledge of programming in Python and experience with shell scripting or similar tools for data processing and automation will be an added advantage.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Post Doctoral Fellow (PDF): ₹90,000 per month (including HRA) as per institute/project norms.
  • Research Associate -I (RA-I): ₹58,000 per month + HRA (as per institute/project norms).
  • Junior Research Fellow (JRF): ₹37,000 per month + HRA (as per institute/project norms).

Important Dates

Notification Date 05 January 2026
Application Submission Rolling basis (open until filled)

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting based on application and need of the project
  • Interview (Online/Offline Mode)

General Information / Instructions

  • The above post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.
  • The applicant will be responsible for the authenticity of information, other documents and scan copies submitted.
  • The interview will be conducted in Online/Offline Mode. Further details will be sent to only shortlisted candidates.
  • The offer of appointment to the candidates will be purely on contractual basis for one year initially. It may be extended for another year/till the completion of the project, whichever is earlier, based on the satisfactory performance of the candidate.
  • The selected candidates need to join immediately.
  • No TA/DA will be applicable to the candidates for appearing for the interview or joining the duty.
  • The Institute reserves the right to accept applications at any time, and consider candidates of exceptional credentials without applications. Qualification and experience may be relaxed at any point of time for exceptional candidates.
  • Mere possessing the prescribed qualification does not ensure that the candidate would be called for Interview. The shortlisting will be done based on the need of the project.
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail about the interview date. So, the candidate must provide valid E-mail IDs in their applications.
  • The first and foremost responsibility of the candidate is to fulfil the jobs’ requirements to complete the above mentioned project in a timely manner.
  • The JRF can be promoted to SRF after two years of relevant research experience and on the recommendation of the project progress monitoring committee.
  • The RA-I can be promoted to RA-II after one year of relevant research experience and on the recommendation of the project progress monitoring committee.
  • The association between PI and the candidate can be discontinued at any time by giving one month’s notice in writing either by the PI of the project to the candidate, or by candidate to the PI of the project.
  • Candidates selected for this position are encouraged to apply for the regular PhD program at IIIT Allahabad, provided they satisfy the eligibility criterion followed by the selection process laid down by the institute.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must submit the duly completed application in the prescribed format (Annexure-I) along with copies of supporting documents only in soft copy form.
  • The application package should be sent via email to [email protected] with the subject line: “Application for the post of JRF/RA-I/PDF”.
  • In addition, applicants must fill out the appropriate Google Form corresponding to the position they are applying for: For Junior Research Fellow (JRF): https://forms.gle/brW1XC6JbAozGcDh7 , For Research Associate-I (RA-I): https://forms.gle/zr7hZ3gRTGjzrwPf6 , For Post-Doctoral Fellow (PDF): https://forms.gle/7sMSpT2wbK5EPxVR9 .
  • Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for interviews as and when a suitable sufficient number of applications are received, and the position will remain open until filled.
  • For any queries, candidates may contact through email at [email protected] or on mobile at +91-8840071479.

  • Qualifications for each post (Registrar, Dean, Assistant Registrar, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor) are specified under “Qualifications” and “Teaching Positions” sections, including required degrees, marks, experience and, where applicable, veterinary registration.
  • For Assistant Professor (non-Veterinary disciplines): Master’s degree in relevant discipline with at least 60% marks or equivalent, with evidence of NET (ICAR-ASRB/UGC-CSIR), or Doctorate degree in relevant subject with two published research papers (NAAS rating above 4.0).
  • For Assistant Professor (Veterinary disciplines): Recognized veterinary qualification under Indian Veterinary Council Act 1984, B.V.Sc. & A.H. with at least 55% marks, Master’s degree in relevant Veterinary discipline with at least 60% marks and NET, or Doctorate degree with two NAAS-rated research papers.
  • Associate Professor (non-Veterinary): Doctoral degree in relevant subject including relevant basic sciences, eight years’ experience in relevant subject in specified pay bands, and contributions to research / teaching / extension evidenced by publications and innovations.
  • Associate Professor (Veterinary): Recognized veterinary qualification, B.V.Sc. & A.H. with at least 55% marks, Master’s in relevant Veterinary discipline with at least 55% marks, and other qualifications similar to non-veterinary disciplines (doctorate, experience, publications).
  • Registrar: Master’s degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent; at least 15 years of teaching or administrative experience in specified cadres, or 15 years of administrative experience with eight years as Deputy Registrar or equivalent.
  • Dean, College of Veterinary & Animal Science: Recognized veterinary qualification; B.V.Sc. & A.H. with at least 55% marks; Master’s and Doctorate degrees in relevant Veterinary disciplines; minimum 15 years of teaching/research experience with at least 5 years as Professor or equivalent; outstanding research contributions.
  • Assistant Registrar: Master’s degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade and good academic record; experience as per desirable condition for service in administration/establishment in specified grades is preferred.

Salary/Stipend

  • Statutory Positions (Registrar, Dean): Level 14 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
  • Associate Professor: Level 13A as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
  • Assistant Professor: Level 10A as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
  • Assistant Registrar (Non-Teaching): Level 10 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
  • Higher initial pay may be considered for exceptionally qualified and deserving candidates if recommended by the Selection Committee.

Age Limit 

  • Registrar: Preferably below 57 years as on last date of advertisement; tenure of 5 years or till attaining age of 62 years, whichever is earlier.
  • Dean, College of Veterinary & Animal Science: Preferably below 57 years as on last date of advertisement; tenure of 5 years or till attaining age of superannuation (65 years), whichever is earlier.
  • Assistant Registrar: Preferably below 40 years as on last date of advertisement.
  • Associate Professor (all disciplines): Preferably below 47 years as on last date of advertisement.
  • Assistant Professor (all disciplines): Preferably below 40 years as on last date of advertisement (age may be relaxed as per Section 10 of Recruitment Rules for Teaching Employees).
  • Relaxation of age and experience is available for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD and other categories as per UGC/Government of India norms and Section 10 of Recruitment Rules, with possible additional relaxation for women candidates and employees of specified institutions.

Application Fee

  • Application fee is non-refundable and must be paid through online mode only.
  • General and other candidates: Rs. 1000/- (per application form).
  • SC / ST / PwBD candidates: Rs. 500/-.
  • Women candidates are exempted from payment of prescribed fee.
  • No other means of payment (IPO/money order/DD etc.) will be accepted.

Last date for submission of online application 21.02.2026 till 5.00 PM
Last date for receiving printout (hard copy) of online application form with enclosures 28.02.2026 till 5.00 PM

Selection Process

  • Direct recruitment to Statutory, Teaching and Non-Teaching posts will be on the basis of merit through all India advertisement and selection by duly constituted Selection Committees.
  • Screening of applications will be done using post-wise Score-Card Guidelines (Dean, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor) and/or additional criteria decided by the Screening Committee.
  • The ratio of candidates called for interview will generally not exceed 1:20 and not be less than 1:3 for each post, subject to candidates securing at least 60% marks in screening.
  • Weightage of score card and interview will be in the ratio of 70:30 for Associate Professor and above, and 80:20 for Assistant Professor.
  • The University may adopt short-listing criteria such as higher qualifications, experience or desirable qualifications to restrict the number of candidates called for interview.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applicants must apply online through the University website and additionally send hard copies (signed, with all enclosures already uploaded) by Indian postal service to the Registrar within the stipulated time.
  • The envelope of the hard copy must clearly mention “Application for the post ……………….” and “Post Code………”; applications received in any other manner will be rejected.
  • Candidates must pay the non-refundable application fee online and ensure correct contact details (phone number and email) for all communications.
  • In-service applicants and candidates on deputation/Foreign Service must submit applications through proper channel and upload/send No Objection Certificate in the prescribed format within the stipulated time.

  • Any addendum / corrigendum / updates regarding the recruitment will be posted only on the University website; no separate postal communication will be issued.
  • Reservations and relaxations for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/EWS candidates will be as per Government of India/UGC rules, subject to submission of valid certificates in prescribed formats and dates.

How to Apply

  • Applicants must fill the online application form available on the University website: www.rlbcau.ac.in.
  • After completing the online application and uploading all required documents, candidates must take a printout of the hard copy, sign all pages and enclosures, and send it by Indian postal service to the Registrar, Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University, Gwalior Road, Jhansi – 284003.

  • Non-refundable application fee must be paid online only; proof of payment and all supporting documents (qualification, experience, category certificates, NOC where applicable) must be uploaded and enclosed.
  • Applications complete in all respects must be submitted online by 21.02.2026 (5.00 PM) and hard copies must reach the University by 28.02.2026 (5.00 PM); late applications will not be entertained.
  • Applicants are advised to read General Instructions, Special Instructions, Essential Information, Qualification details, Score-Card guidelines and all conditions carefully before filling the application form.

Eligibility Criteria

Genetic Counselor:

  • Post-graduation in Genetics/Human Genetics/Human Genomics/Genetic counseling/Life Sciences with Genetics as major subject.
  • Candidates with at least 1-year clinical genetics observership/post-graduation certificate in genetic counseling will be preferred.
  • Desirable: Board of Genetic Counseling India (BGCI)/Healthcare Sector Skill Council (HSSC) certified Genetic Counsellor.

Bioinformatics Analyst:

  • M.Sc/M.Tech (Bioinformatics/Genomics) with knowledge of Linux operating system.
  • Knowledge of programming languages (Python/Shell script) and familiarity with genomic database/tool/software development and testing open source biological databases.
  • Familiarity with exome sequencing analysis, genomic database, genetic disorders, ACMG guidelines, standard protocols and pipelines; ability to develop custom pipelines and use tools like FASTQC, Trimmomatic and HISAT2.
  • Candidates with at least 2 years’ experience will be preferred.

Genome Analyst:

  • M.Sc (Bioinformatics/Human Genetics/Genomics/Molecular Biology) with 3 years of work experience OR Ph.D in Bioinformatics/Human Genetics/Genomics/Molecular Biology with experience in analyzing genomic sequencing data including exome, RNA, mitochondrial and whole genome sequencing using standard protocols and guidelines with related publications.
  • Familiarity with genomic databases, genetic disorders and ACMG guidelines, standard protocols and pipelines.
  • Ability to filter, shortlist and interpret relevant disease-causing variants from annotated variants using genomic resources (databases, prediction tools, ACMG guidelines etc.) and clinical information.
  • Ability to address suitable techniques for validation of identified variants, primer/probe designing and tracking post-NGS reporting developments.

The engagement on purely contractual basis in IWAI shall be regulated as per the following guidelines:

  • Individuals (Non-Government / Private / Multinational / Consultancy Firms) or from Govt. / Autonomous Bodies with requisite qualifications and experience as prescribed would be eligible for being engaged as Consultant (Business Development).

  • The engagement would be on full time basis, unless specified, and they would not be permitted to take up any other assignment during the period of engagement with IWAI.
  • Working hours would be from 10:00 AM to 05:30 PM at IWAI, Regional Office Varanasi (06 days of the week and Second Saturday weekly off) during the working days including half hour lunch break in between.
  • The Consultant (Business Development) engaged on full-time basis will be required to attend office on all working days and also on holidays, if required.

  • The Consultant (Business Development) shall be responsible and accountable for the services rendered/ advice given by him since such advice/ service is the result of contractual relations between the consultant and the employer.
  • The Consultant (Business Development) may avoid any conflict of interest while discharging contractual obligation and bring, before hand, any possible instance of conflict of interest to IWAI.   • Candidates will have to qualify in each part of the online test separately.
  • Language Proficiency Test (LPT): The candidates provisionally shortlisted from the online test will have to undergo a language proficiency test (LPT). Candidates not proficient in the Official / Local Language as per LPT shall be disqualified.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates can apply for vacancy in one Office only and will have to opt for online test (pre-examination training, if any) centre within the same state/UTs of the office for which he/she is applying.
  • The online test will be bilingual, i.e., available in English and Hindi except for the test of English Language.
  • Candidates will have to visit the Bank's website for downloading call letters for online test. Intimation for downloading call letter will also be sent through email/SMS.
  • Use of MOBILE PHONES and other electronic devices BANNED: Mobile phones or any other communication devices are not allowed inside the premises, where the examination is being conducted. Any infringement of these instructions shall entail disqualification including ban from future examinations.
  • Candidates are not permitted to use or be in possession of calculators in examination premises.
  • Candidates are advised, in their own interest, not to bring any of the banned items including mobile phones to the venue of the examination, as arrangement for safekeeping cannot be assured.
  • The post is also open to the employees of the Bank (staff candidates) who satisfy the eligibility criteria.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement and / or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Mumbai and courts/ tribunals/ forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction to try any cause / dispute.
  • Candidate's admission to the Online Test / LPT is strictly provisional. The mere fact that the call letter has been issued to the candidate does not imply that his candidature has been finally cleared by the Bank.
  • In case it is detected at any stage of recruitment that a candidate does not fulfil the eligibility norms and / or that he / she has furnished any incorrect / false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), his /her candidature will stand cancelled. If any of these shortcomings is / are detected even after appointment, his /her services are liable to be terminated.

How to Apply

  • Candidates satisfying the conditions of eligibility as on January 01, 2026, are first required to visit the URL "Recruitment for the post of Office Attendant - PY 2025" in the advertisement page for filling the 'Online Application'.

  • Candidates must submit an undertaking accepting these conditions.

  • Duties, responsibilities, and working hours as per Central TB Division guidelines.
  • Contract renewable every 11 months based on performance appraisal.
  • Appointment can be terminated with one month's notice by either party.
  • Field duties included as directed by District TB Officer.
  • No part-time/full-time employment or business allowed during contract without permission.

  • Applications received after 23 January 2026 (05:45 PM) will not be accepted.
  • Original documents to be produced at the time of interview.
  • Recent passport-size photo must be affixed on the application.

In this article, you’ll find the DLSA Tiruchirappalli Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel, Deputy Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel And More Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Offline application form.

Vacancy Details

Name of the Post No. of Post
Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel 01
Deputy Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel 01
Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsel 03
Total 05

Eligibility Criteria

  • Must be a citizen of India and Local resident of Tiruchirappalli District
  • Should not be less than 21 years as on the date of Notification

1. Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel

  • Practice in Criminal law for at least 10 years
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Thorough understanding of ethical duties of a defense counsel
  • Ability to work effectively and efficiently with others with capability to lead
  • Must have handled at least 30 criminal trials in Sessions Court
  • 5 Sessions Cases in which judgements were delivered by the court(s), and he/she appeared as defence lawyer
  • 5 Cross-examinations in Sessions cases done by him/her
  • Knowledge of computer system, preferable

2. Deputy Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel

  • Practice in Criminal law for at least 7 years
  • Excellent understanding of criminal law
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Thorough understanding of ethical duties of defense counsel
  • Ability to work effectively and efficiently with others
  • Must have handled at least 20 criminal trials in Sessions Court
  • 5 Session Cases in which judgements were delivered by the court(s), and he/she appeared as defense lawyer
  • 5 Cross-examinations in Sessions cases done by him/her
  • IT Knowledge with proficiency in work

3. Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsel

  • Practice in criminal law from 1 to 3 years
  • Good oral and written communication skills
  • Thorough understanding of ethical duties of defense counsel
  • Ability to work effectively and efficiently with others
  • Excellent writing and research skills
  • IT knowledge with proficiency in work

Salary/ Stipend

  • Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel : Rs.90,000/-
  • Deputy Chief Legal Aid Defense Counsel : Rs.60,000/-
  • Assistant Legal Aid Defense Counsel : Rs.30,000/-

Age Limit (as on 03 January 2026)

  • Minimum age : 21 years (No maximum age limit mentioned)

Important Dates

Date of Notification 03 January 2026
Last date for submission of Application 23 January 2026

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on merit, taking into account the years of practice, handling of criminal cases in sessions courts, legal knowledge, writing skills of candidates
  • The selection shall be carried out by selection committee under the Chairmanship of the Principal District & Sessions Judge (Chairman, DLSA)
  • Initially for a period of two years on contract basis with extension on satisfactory performance

General Information / Instructions

  • Full time work on contract basis for the period of Two Years in "LEGAL AID DEFENSE COUNSEL SYSTEM"
  • Legal Aid Defense Counsel System (LADCS) is established for providing Legal aid, assistance and representation in criminal matters from the early stages of criminal justice till appellate stage, including visits to jails
  • Services include legal advice, trial and appeals in all courts, remand and bail work, pre-arrest stage assistance, and periodic prison visits
  • Services of engaged counsels can be terminated without prior notice in case of breach of duty, accepting fees from aid seekers, conviction, political activities, incapacity, etc.

How to Apply

  • Use the standard form of application annexed with the notification along with two passport size photographs
  • Enclose self-attested photocopies of educational qualification and experience certificate
  • Submit the duly filled application along with documents in person or by post on or before 23 January 2026 (5:00 P.M.) to:
    “CHAIRMAN/PRINCIPAL DISTRICT JUDGE,
    District Legal Services Authority,
    ADR Building, District Court Campus,
    Tiruchirappalli.”
  • Incomplete applications will be rejected
  • No application will be entertained after the last date
  • Eligible candidates list will be published only on https://districts.ecourts.gov.in/tiruchirappalli

  • For Junior Assistant (as per Recruitment Rules extract in the PDF): 27 years; relaxable for Departmental Candidates up to five years in accordance with the instructions or orders issued by the Central Government.
  • For Senior Assistant: 33 years Note:- Relaxable for Departmental Candidates upto five years in accordance with the instructions or orders issued by the Central Government
  • Age limit and other eligibility conditions for all the positions shall be determined on the last date of submission of online application, i.e. 30.01.2026.
  • Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen applicants shall be applicable as per Government of India norms. No relaxation is applicable to SC/ST/OBC/PwD applicants applying for Unreserved (UR) vacancies.
  • Category-wise age relaxation beyond the upper age limit:
    • SC/ST: 5 years.
    • OBC (NCL): 3 years.
    • PwD (UR): 10 years.
    • PwD + OBC (NCL): 13 years.
    • PwD + SC/ST: 15 years.

    • Departmental candidates with three years continuous service in Central Government: 5 years (additional, where applicable).
    • Widows, divorced women and women judicially separated from their husbands and who are not re-married: Up to 35 years (up to 40 years for SC/ST), without relaxation of educational qualification or method of recruitment.
    • Regular staff of NITT who were appointed before 2012: Allowed to participate in the selection process irrespective of age and percentage of marks, as per No.F.35-5/2018-TS.III dated 20th February 2019 – point 4.b.(iii).

  • All details related to recruitment process shall be available on the Institute website only; applicants are advised to keep a regular watch on the Institute’s website.
  • Screening of applications will be done on the basis of requirements mentioned in the Recruitment Rules and as per the conditions laid down by the duly constituted Screening Committee.
  • Selection process may consist of Screening Test (only for the purpose of shortlisting of applicants), Skill Test (qualifying in nature) and Main Written Test.
  • Canvassing in any manner would entail disqualification of the candidature.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applicants applying in response to this advertisement should satisfy themselves regarding their eligibility for the post applied for and must be fulfilling the eligibility criteria as on the closing date of online applications, failing which their application is liable for rejection at any stage.
  • Any requisite experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree will only be taken into consideration.
  • Applicants would be allowed to appear in the selection process on the basis of the information furnished by them in their application form; issuance of letter for the selection process will not confer any right for appointment.
  • If the applicants are found ineligible at any stage of recruitment process, their candidature may be cancelled and, if selected, appointment may also be cancelled. Hiding information or submitting false information may lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage of recruitment and may invite penal action.
  • The applicants are required to apply through Online mode only. Application in any other form will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. Applications which are not in prescribed form / without relevant supporting enclosures may be out rightly rejected.
  • NIT Tiruchirappalli strives to have a workforce which also reflects gender balance and hence eligible female applicants are especially encouraged to apply.
  • The Institute has the right to set higher norms than minimum prescribed in the advertisement and reserves the right to reject or accept the candidature of any applicant at any stage and to cancel/restrict/modify/alter the advertisement / recruitment process, if need arises, without issuing any further notice.
  • The Screening Test and Main Written Test will be conducted in the premises of the Institute. No request for change of venue / date of selection process shall be considered.
  • Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria does not guarantee being called for Screening Test / Main Written Test / Skill Test. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of applicants to be called by short-listing on the basis of higher benchmark.
  • Persons serving in Government / Semi-Government / Autonomous Bodies / Statutory Bodies / PSUs / PSBs should furnish a No Objection Certificate from the designated authority at the time of verification.
  • No vigilance/disciplinary cases should be pending against applicants working in any Govt./Semi-Govt./Autonomous organizations; in such cases, the application shall not be considered.
  • Original documents, along with one set of self-attested copies, must be produced at the time of certificate verification prior to skill test; without original certificates, candidature shall be rejected.
  • Applicants are advised to visit the Institute website regularly. Any addendum/corrigendum shall be published only on the Institute website; list of shortlisted applicants will be displayed only on the Institute website.
  • The Institute reserves the right not to fill up the posts and to cancel the advertisement in whole or in part, without assigning any reason.
  • Applicants should not have been convicted by any Court of Law and must be in sound health; selected candidates must be prepared to undergo medical examination before the District Medical Board and produce fitness certificate.
  • All appointments are subject to verification of academic qualifications, experience, conduct, community certificates, medical fitness and police verification; any discrepancy may lead to removal from service and legal action.
  • Applicants must carry at least one photograph-bearing Identity Proof in original (Driving Licence, Voter ID Card, Aadhaar Card, Passport) to the examination centre.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates attending the Screening Test / Certificate Verification / Skill Test / Main Written Test except PwD candidates, who may avail reimbursement as per Government/Institute norms.
  • All correspondence will be made by the Institute through e-mail only; no separate hard copy letters will be sent.
  • Any dispute with regard to the selection process will be subject to the jurisdiction of the appropriate court/tribunal having jurisdiction over Tiruchirappalli.
  • Applicants are warned not to furnish any false particulars or suppress material information and not to tamper with documents; such actions may result in cancellation/debarment and criminal action.
