  • PICU: DM/DNB/Dr.NB (Paediatric Critical Care) OR MD/DNB (Paediatrics)
  • NICU: DM/DNB/Dr.NB (Neonataology) OR MD/DNB (Paediatrics)

Diagnostic and Interventional Radiology:

  • D.M./DNB/DrNB (Interventional Radiology) OR M.D./DNB (Radio-diagnosis)

Registration Requirements

  • Candidate must be registered with State Medical Council/National Medical Commission as applicable, before joining the post
  • Subsequent to selection, candidate has to register with Tamilnadu State Medical Council not later than 30 days from date of joining if not registered at the time of joining

Experience Requirements

  • Candidates with relevant post qualification work experience will be given preference
  • For ICU positions: Preferably some experience in Intensive Care Units

Who Cannot Apply

  • Candidates who have already worked as Senior Resident under 3 years Central Residency Scheme for 3 years are not eligible
  • Total period of Senior Residency should not exceed maximum period of 3 Years

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Level: Level-11 as per 7th CPC
  • Basic Pay: Rs. 67,700/- per month
  • Total Gross Emoluments: Rs. 1,57,392/- (approximately) for the month of November 2025
  • Allowances: Other allowances as applicable under 7th CPC
  • Revision: Remuneration will be revised whenever there is revision of rates of DA as per ESIC Hqrs. Office in line with Central Government Employees
  • Private Practice: Private practice of any kind will not be allowed

Age Limit 

  • Upper Age Limit for Broad Specialties: 45 years
  • Upper Age Limit for Certain Departments: 50 years for subjects of Anatomy, Biochemistry, Physiology, Pharmacology, Microbiology, Pathology, Forensic Medicine and Community Medicine

Application Fee

Category Fee Amount
SC/ST/PWD/Women Candidates & Ex-Servicemen NIL
All Other Categories Rs. 500/-

Mode of Payment

  • Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- (as applicable) in favour of 'ESI Fund Account No.1'
  • Drawn on any scheduled bank payable at Chennai
  • To be submitted along with application form at the time of document verification cum walk-in Interview
  • The Demand Draft must be issued after the date of issue of this advertisement
  • Only Demand Draft drawn on any Scheduled Bank will be accepted
  • Application fee paid by any other mode will not be accepted
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Date 05/01/2026
Walk-in Interview for Departments (Anesthesiology, Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation, Orthopaedics, Respiratory Medicine, General Surgery, Emergency Medicine, General Medicine, ICUs) 20/01/2026 (Tuesday)
Walk-in Interview for Departments (Anatomy, Biochemistry, Community Medicine, Dentistry, Pathology, Physiology, Dermatology, Psychiatry) 21/01/2026 (Wednesday)
Walk-in Interview for Departments (NICU, Ophthalmology, ENT, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Paediatrics, PICU, Radiotherapy, Radio-diagnosis, Interventional Radiology) 22/01/2026 (Thursday)
Walk-in Interview for Departments (Medical Gastro Enterology, Burns & Plastic Surgery, Cardiology, Cardiothoracic Surgery, Endocrinology, Hematology, Medical Oncology, Nephrology, Neuro Surgery, Neurology, Rheumatology, Surgical Oncology) 23/01/2026 (Friday)
Document Verification Time 09:00 AM - 11:00 AM
Registration Closing Time 11:00 AM (No candidate entertained after this time)

Selection Process

  • Selection will be done through walk-in interview
  • Aspiring applicants satisfying eligibility criteria in all respects can appear for walk-in interview as per scheduled dates
  • Applications submitted on day of walk-in interview with requisite fee will be scrutinized by scrutiny committee
  • Only eligible candidates will be allowed to appear for walk-in interview before the selection committee
  • In case numbers of applicants are large, selection committee may devise criteria for short-listing which may include holding of a Screening Test
  • If turnout of candidates is more than ratio of 1:10 per post, competent authority may conduct screening test to shortlist candidates
  • Screening test will consist of multiple choice questions in concerned discipline
  • Marks obtained in screening test will not be linked to final selection process
  • Performance of candidate in interview will be sole criteria for selecting candidate for respective post
  • Only those candidates whose documents are verified will be allowed to attend walk-in interview
  • Result will be published on website (www.esic.gov.in/recruitments)
  • Selected candidates will have to join immediately after receipt of offer of engagement

General Information/Instructions

Tenure of Engagement

  • The tenure is for 3 years for Senior Residents subject to satisfactory performance evaluation on annual basis
  • No extension beyond 3 years of the tenure
  • The total period should not exceed the maximum period of 3 Years

Terms of Employment

  • The engagement shall not confer any right or preference for regular appointment
  • Senior Resident already working in any Govt. institution/Hospital shall apply through proper channel
  • No claim for any service benefits like PF, Pension, Medical allowances, Seniority, Promotion etc. will be admissible
  • Private practice of any kind will not be allowed

Security Deposit

  • Selected Senior Resident candidates have to deposit security amount of Rs. 30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand)
  • In favour of ESI Fund A/C No. 1 payable at State Bank of India, Ashok Nagar, Chennai-78
  • Submit demand draft at time of joining
  • If candidate resigns/services are terminated within one year, security deposit shall be forfeited

Contractual Agreement

  • Senior Resident so engaged will be required to enter into contractual agreement on stamp paper of Rs. 100/-
  • Contract is liable to be terminated at any time without assigning any reason after giving one month's notice on either side or on payment of one month's emoluments in lieu thereof

Medical Examination and Joining

  • Joining of candidate is subject to medical fitness
  • Senior Resident so selected will be required to submit acceptance/consent letter in writing before appearing for medical examination
  • Selected candidates will have to join duty on or before the date indicated in offer of appointment/engagement

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Required to attend emergency, floor duty and other clinical duty as assigned by Competent Authority
  • Required to perform duties in other departments as assigned by competent authority
  • Medical Officers required to mark attendance manually as well as on Aadhar Enabled Bio-metric Attendance System (AEBAS) daily

Attendance and Discipline

  • Absence from work for period of fifteen days without proper permission will amount to voluntary abandonment of engagement and automatic termination alongwith forfeiture of Security Deposit
  • Doctors at any time found guilty of any gross misconduct or negligence of duties shall be terminated without any notice or payment in lieu of notice period

Reservation Policy

  • Reservation of posts is applicable as per Government of India Guidelines
  • Rules for Reservation will be implemented as per Govt. of India instructions
  • Presidential Directives on reservation will be followed
  • Seventeen Posts are horizontally reserved for PwD category in identified posts
  • Candidates appointed under PWD quota will be adjusted against vacancy of respective categories of SC/ST/OBC and UR quota

Category Certificate Requirements

  • Candidates applying in OBC/SC/ST/EWS/PWD Category must possess certificate issued by competent authority, valid for admission/job in Central Govt. Institutions issued before date of interview
  • Candidates claiming reservation on grounds of belonging to OBC (non-creamy layer) should submit community certificate in prescribed format vide Govt. of India, Department of Personnel and Training O.M No. 36036/2/2013-Estt (Res) dated 30.05.2014
  • Certificate issued in other formats will not be accepted and candidature will be treated as "General Category"
  • EWS candidate must have EWS certificate as per Govt. prescribed format and valid on date of interview
  • Person who suffers from not less than 40% of disability will only be eligible for benefit of reservation and other relaxations under PWD category
  • Applicant must have valid Disability Certificate issued from competent authority i.e, Medical Board duly constituted by Central or State Government
  • Certificate issued by Medical Practitioner, Hospital or any other Institution will not be considered

Important Instructions

  • All candidates advised to appear for document verification along with filled application form within scheduled time (09:00 AM - 11:00 AM)
  • No candidate will be entertained to attend document verification after 11:00 AM on all scheduled dates
  • The Dean reserves right to vary vacancies including increase or decrease or cancellation of filling up of any or all post without assigning any reason
  • Change in date of interview, if any, will be intimated on website only
  • Candidates advised to check website regularly for any updated information
  • The engagement will be subject to outcome in case of recruitment related litigations if any
  • Candidates may contact office of Dean on email: [email protected] along with their contact number
  • Candidates permitted to apply for only one post at a time (with exception for Emergency Medicine, Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation)
  • Separate application form along with Demand Draft should be enclosed for multiple applications
  • ESIC reserves right to cancel recruitment process at any stage at its discretion
  • Wrong declarations/submission of false information shall lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage in addition to suitable legal action
  • Opportunity for appearing in interview is purely provisional
  • Joining will be subject to detailed scrutiny of eligibility conditions/production of prescribed certificates

Chest OL (One Leg) S, SE, ST, MF, KC, C

How to Apply

  • Candidates need to appear for walk-in interview on scheduled dates as per their chosen department
  • Report for document verification between 09:00 AM to 11:00 AM
  • No candidate will be entertained after 11:00 AM
  • Fill the application form in prescribed format (Annexure-C)
  • Applications submitted in any other format OR incomplete applications will be summarily rejected
  • Bring filled application form along with Demand Draft for application fee (if applicable)

Documents Required for Walk-in Interview

Candidates advised to bring all Original Certificates with one set of self-attested photocopies:

  • Identity Proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhar Card etc.)
  • Address Proof (Ration Card, Passport, Driving License, Aadhar Card etc.)

  • Two Recent passport size photographs
  • Photocopies of Aadhar Card/PAN Card and Bank Passbook (At time of joining for selected candidates only)
  • Class 10th & 12th Mark Sheets or Certificates
  • MBBS, MD/MS/DNB and Experience certificate whichever is applicable as per NMC guidelines
  • Registration with National Medical Commission / State Medical Council (For Medical Candidates)
  • Internship Completion Certificate
  • Reservation category Certificate (OBC/SC/ST/PH/EWS) in format prescribed by Govt. of India
  • OBC candidate should belong to non-creamy layer of central lists of OBC
  • NOC (If applicable)
  • Demand draft for Interview Fee of Rs. 500/- in favour of ESI Fund A.C No.1, payable at Chennai
  • Candidate in Government Service should submit "No Objection Certificate" from employer at time of Interview
  • Candidates already employed must produce relieving order from previous employer at time of joining / NOC for taking up engagement with ESIC

Interview Venue and Contact

Eligibility Criteria

  • Level II Tamil Language Test is of qualifying cum scoring nature; candidates must secure at least 40% marks to qualify.
  • Level II Sports General Awareness test comprises MCQs on current affairs in sports, welfare schemes, PoSH Act in sports context, anti-doping, Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act (sports context), sports medicine/physiology/first aid (as in NIS Diploma syllabus) and related topics.
  • Level III performance evaluation includes on-field assessment (talent identification and development, coaching skills, tactics and strategy, techniques, psychological training, error correction, biomechanics) and viva voce on training programme formulation, goal setting, nutrition, performance monitoring, rules knowledge and sports science.
  • For computation of NIS marks in Level I, a specified formula using the candidate’s marks, maximum marks and assigned weightage is given in the notification.
  • Medal scoring uses a detailed table with different scores for medals in Olympics/Paralympics, World Championships, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games, South Asian Games, National Games, National Championships, All India Inter University, Khelo India, SGFI, and State Games conducted by SDAT/Government or recognized associations.
  • Coaching experience scoring is based on experience (as on 01.01.2026) in Sports Departments/Authorities (State/Union Govt/Sports Universities), accredited sports academies/training centres/government recognized commercial sports arms, and sports departments of other universities/colleges/schools.
  • Merit list is prepared based on total score and reservation policy; tie-breaking is done by Level III score, then Level I score, then date of birth (older candidate preferred).

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited through online mode only from eligible candidates who wish to join SDAT as Coach by direct recruitment; candidates registered with Employment Exchange are also eligible to apply online.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply, and candidates must carefully read the notification and ensure they satisfy all eligibility conditions before applying.
  • Selected candidates will undergo a two-year probationary period as per applicable rules.
  • Appointment is subject to verification of character and antecedents, marital status conditions, age compliance and production of physical fitness certificate from a Registered Medical Practitioner not below the rank of Assistant Civil Surgeon.
  • If no qualified suitable women applicants are available for reserved women vacancies, they will be filled by male applicants of the respective communal categories.
  • For vacancies reserved for Arunthathiyars on preferential basis, unfilled posts may be filled by other Scheduled Castes as per prevailing reservation rules.
  • Candidates must furnish correct information regarding arrests, convictions, debarment/disqualification, criminal or disciplinary proceedings, participation in agitations or political organizations, or candidature in elections, if any.
  • Applications with wrong claims relating to basic qualification, eligibility, age or educational qualification will be liable for rejection.
  • SDAT’s decision regarding eligibility, documents, mode of selection, schedule and all recruitment matters is final; announcements/details will be published only on https://www.sdat.tn.gov.in/.
  • Only the latest valid application will be retained if multiple applications are submitted; any attempt to exert undue influence results in disqualification.
  • Candidates must upload a recent recognizable photograph and ensure identical signatures in all documents; they must appear for performance tests at their own expense and final appointment is subject to medical fitness and other requirements.
  • Information/Intimations will be sent by email to the primary email ID provided; candidates must keep email and mobile valid and monitor the SDAT website for updates.
  • Selection is provisional and subject to final orders in any Writ Petitions pending before competent Courts related to this recruitment.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply only through online mode via the SDAT website: https://www.sdat.tn.gov.in/ within 05.01.2026 to 25.01.2026 till 5.00 PM.
  • Candidates must register and fill the online application with accurate personal details, educational qualifications, professional qualifications, sports achievements and coaching experience as required.
  • Candidates must upload a recent passport size photograph and necessary scanned documents as per instructions in the online portal.
  • Copies of documents to be kept ready for upload/verification include: 10th mark sheet, 12th mark sheet, community certificate, special category certificate (if applicable), UG/PG degree certificate, NIS Diploma certificate, experience certificates/pay slips/IT returns and medal certificates.
  • All original documents must be produced for verification as per schedule intimated by SDAT after online application and during subsequent stages.

Vacancy Details

Eligibility Criteria

  • Legal Consultant: Degree in Law, enrolled in the Bar Council and continuously practicing law for three years before the constitutional courts and statutory Tribunals in India.
  • Senior Legal Consultant: Degree in law, enrolled in the Bar Council and continuously practicing law for over five years before the Constitutional Courts and Statutory Tribunals in India.
  • Degree in Engineering in Electrical or Mechanical Discipline, in addition to Degree in law, will be preferred.
  • Applicants who have passed all his/her Examinations within the duration of their Course period in Degree in Law are alone Eligible to apply.
  • Applicants pursuing Post Graduate Degree in Law or any other Degrees or Programs requiring their compulsory attendance elsewhere are not eligible to apply.
  • Applicant shall not be a member of any political party.
  • Applicant shall not hold any post, private or public or whatsoever including as a Member of a Panchayat.
  • Applicant shall have a command over English in reading, writing and speaking/Presenting, besides having a reasonable Knowledge in Tamil.
  • Applicant shall not be a convict in any criminal case including under section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act,1881.
  • Applicant should not have any criminal case pending against him/her, whether charge-sheet is filed or even at the stage of investigation pursuant to registration of a Crime.
  • He/She must be a citizen of India.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Senior Legal Consultant: Rs.1,50,000/- (Rupees one lakh and fifty thousand only) per month consolidated.
  • Legal Consultant: Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One lakh only) per month consolidated.
  • No other allowances or perks except Travelling Allowance (upto II AC by train/AC Sleeper Bus or, in case of travel outside Tamil Nadu, airfare in economy class) whenever required to perform journey in connection with the engagement.

Age Limit (as on date of notification)

  • Legal Consultant: Must not have attained the age of 35 years.
  • Senior Legal Consultant: Must not have attained the age of 65 years.

Important Dates

Event Date
Last Date for Receipt of Application 31 January 2026

Selection Process

  • Selection shall be made by way of Notification inviting applications from willing and eligible Advocates.
  • Applications shall be made in the prescribed form accompanied with copies of documents in complete shape.
  • Meritorious & Eligible Applicants based on academic marks scored in the Degree in Law will be short-listed and informed to appear for Viva-voce at Chennai at their own expenses.
  • Applicants having a Bachelor Degree in Engineering in Electrical or Mechanical discipline, in addition to degree in law, will be preferred.
  • Selection made by a Committee nominated by the Chairman-cum-Managing Director/TNPDCL, with the list placed for approval.
  • Applicants shall produce original Testimonials for verification at the time of Viva-voce and assumption of charge.

General Information / Instructions

  • Engagement is temporary/purely on adhoc basis; initially for two years, extendable one year at a time but not exceeding overall five years, subject to satisfactory performance.
  • Engagement may be discontinued/terminated at any time without prior notice if services are unsatisfactory or need ceases, without compensation except honorarium up to date of termination.
  • On expiry of three years, engagement deemed terminated automatically.
  • Selectees shall take up engagement within the specified period; no extension requests entertained.
  • Not treated as regular employees; no claim for permanency in TNPDCL.
  • To leave, provide one month's prior notice to Chief Engineer/Personnel/TNPDCL through Head of Office.
  • Duties include full-time assistance in legal and para-legal works, preparation of drafts, identifying issues/documents/citations, follow-up, statistical reports, compliance monitoring, etc.
  • Attendance marking required in designated offices (Chennai, Madurai, or New Delhi).
  • Casual Leave: 1 day per calendar month (max 12 days per year), carry forward within the year; excess leads to deduction from honorarium.
  • Bar to practice as Advocate for others or take up any employment during engagement; refrain from accepting briefs related to TNEB Limited and subsidiaries during engagement and for one year after.
  • Maintain high standard of reputation, integrity, absolute confidentiality; no leaking of information/documents.
  • Note: The CMD/TNPDCL may waive any eligibility condition(s) in needy/deserving cases.
  • The Board of TNPDCL reserves the right to fill or not fill or increase/decrease the number of posts without assigning reasons.

How to Apply

  • Application should reach the Chief Engineer/Personnel, TNPDCL on or before 31 January 2026.
  • Use the prescribed application form (Annexure-A) with self-attested photograph.
  • Enclose Educational Certificates and Experience Certificates.
  • Fill details including Name, Address, Date of Birth, Age as on 01.01.2026, Qualifications (starting from Matriculation), Experience, Languages known, etc.
  • Include solemn undertaking declaring information correct.
  • Application and other details can be downloaded from www.tnpdcl.org.

VOC Port Authority Pilot Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Sl. No. Name of the Post & Scale of Pay No. of Posts & Category
1 Pilot – Rs.70,000 – 2,00,000/- (Class-I) ST – 01, UR – 01 (Total 02)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Post: Pilot, Class-I, in the scale of pay Rs.70,000 – 2,00,000/- by Direct Recruitment at V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority, Tuticorin.
  • Educational/Professional Qualification (Essential): Must hold a certificate of competency as Master of Foreign Going Ship issued by the Ministry of Shipping, Government of India, or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Ministry of Shipping, Government of India.
  • Experience (Essential): One year post-qualification experience as Master or Chief Officer of a foreign going ship.
  • All qualifications should be recognized and approved in India by AICTE/UGC/appropriate statutory authority/competent authority.
  • Age Limit: Maximum 40 years; age will be determined as on 04/02/2026, which is the crucial date for qualification, experience and age.
  • Age Relaxation: Applicable to SC/ST candidates as per rules and regulations.
  • Employees working in Central & State Government/Semi-Government/Government Autonomous Bodies/CPSEs must apply through proper channel or submit No Objection Certificate at the time of interview.

Salary/Stipend

  • Basic Pay: Rs.70,000 – 2,00,000/- in IDA scale for Class-I Pilot.
  • In addition to basic pay, benefits include DA on industrial pattern, accommodation or HRA, cafeteria allowance, National Pension System (NPS), group insurance, medical facilities, encashment of earned leave and applicable marine allowances as per rules.
  • The candidate appointed as Pilot will initially undergo training for a period of 6 months and be designated as Trainee Pilot and, on obtaining license after training, will be designated as Pilot.

Age Limit (as on 04-02-2026)

  • Maximum age limit for the post of Pilot (Class-I): 40 years as on 04/02/2026.
  • Age relaxation is applicable to SC/ST candidates as per prevailing rules and regulations.

Application Fee

  • No application fee details are mentioned in the vacancy notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Vacancy Notification 06/01/2026
Crucial date for determining qualification, experience and age 04/02/2026
Last date for receipt of applications 04/02/2026

Selection Process

  • Applications will be scrutinized to ensure that candidates fulfill eligibility norms; if at any stage it is detected that a candidate does not fulfill the norms or has furnished incorrect/false information or suppressed material facts, candidature will be cancelled and services terminated if already appointed.
  • V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority reserves the right to shortlist and restrict the number of candidates for written test/personal interview on the basis of qualification and experience by adopting appropriate selection criteria.
  • Mere submission of application does not bestow the right to be called for written test/interview or to be considered for selection.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.
  • Applications received after due date or not sent through proper channel will not be considered.
  • Vacancy advertised can be cancelled at the discretion of V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority without assigning any reasons.

General Information/Instructions

  • The recruitment is for two posts of Pilot, Class-I, in V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority, an autonomous body under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways, Government of India.
  • Candidates must ensure that they fulfill the eligibility and other norms mentioned in the notification before applying; non-fulfilment at any stage will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • All qualifications must be from institutions recognized and approved in India by AICTE/UGC or other appropriate statutory/competent authorities.
  • Employees from Central/State Governments, Semi-Government, Government Autonomous Bodies and CPSEs should apply through proper channel or submit No Objection Certificate at the time of interview.
  • The crucial date for determining qualification, experience, and age is fixed as 04/02/2026.
  • V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority reserves the right to cancel the advertised vacancies or modify the selection process without assigning any reasons.

How to Apply

  • Applicants must take a printout of the Application Form (Annexure I) available on the V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority website (www.vocport.gov.in).
  • Duly filled application form with recent passport size photograph affixed on the right-hand corner must be prepared as per the prescribed proforma.
  • Self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, age proof and other relevant documents must be enclosed with the application.
  • The complete application must reach on or before 04/02/2026 to the following address: The Secretary, V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority, Administrative Office Building, Harbour Estate, Tuticorin – 628 004.
  • Applications received after the due date or not sent through proper channel will not be considered for the recruitment process.
